arbeitnow:senior-machine-learning-engine.description:
As an ML Engineer (m/f/d), you will be a key contributor within our development team. Your responsibilities include preparing and selecting data, training and validating models, as well as deploying them on real embedded UAVs, UGVs, and USVs to enhance their capabilities.
 
You will work within a world-class team to help push the boundaries of autonomous drone technology.
In this role, you collaborate closely with stakeholders from hardware development, testing, production, and customer operations, driving continuous improvements in the autonomy of our UxV platforms.
 
By advancing intelligent autonomy, you will actively support Quantum Systems’ mission to set the benchmark for next-generation UxV solutions.
Within this advertisment we are open to hiring people with the following profiles:

ML Engineer (Generalist)

• Proven track record designing and training deep learning models for production use

• Experience with model optimization for resource-constrained environments (quantization, pruning, distillation)

• Deep expertise in computer vision architectures or VLAs Architecture

Data Engineer (Geospatial Data & Sensor Fusion)

• Experience managing large-scale datasets, including geospatial, image, or sensor data

• Familiarity with drone-generated data types (imagery, LiDAR, telemetry, flight logs)

• Experience with data quality assurance, annotation workflows, and labelling platforms

• Experience with generation of syntetic data and simulation

What you bring to the team:

• You hold a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related engineering discipline.

• You bring proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Rust, C++)

• You are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and enjoy improving real, hands-on UxV products trough your work.

• Due to your open, communicative, friendly and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered as an internal expert.

• You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

• Communication in English is a matter of course for you.

Why Quantum-Systems:

• We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

• We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

• We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

• We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

• Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

• Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

• Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

• Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

• Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

• Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

• Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

• Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:
Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:
We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.
At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

You’ll collaborate closely with the production team, as well hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, and operations while ensuring that every platform transitions successfully from a physical airframe into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes drone technology and enjoys bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance.

  • Execute End-of-Line (EoL) software validation and functional testing to ensure production readiness and reliability
  • Conduct payload and camera load-seat testing, validating integration stability and operational performance under real-world conditions
  • Troubleshoot embedded system issues spanning firmware, communication interfaces, sensors, and hardware-software interactions
  • Work independently to diagnose integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams
  • Contribute to validation workflows for complete UAV systems, including components, integrated features, and operational flight configurations
  • Support full-stack drone integration activities across hardware, embedded firmware, and flight software layers

  • Drive measurable impact on product quality, manufacturing throughput, and deployment readiness through improved validation and testing processes
  • Partner cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to accelerate batch validation and reduce EoL cycle times
  • Interface with external vendors and equipment providers to support testing infrastructure, hardware integration, and operational readiness

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. in Aviation Technology, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional)

  • Strong technical foundation in embedded systems, firmware debugging, and hardware-software integration

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. 

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

  • Verification: Verify that developer fixes successfully resolve reported issues. 
  • Knowledge Base Management: Maintain and expand the internal Knowledge Base with documentation of new product functionality.

  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence. 

thinkcell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. 

We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

About Neuphonic
Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications.
Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.
We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.
Why we're hiring
As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.
We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.
A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in Australia or New Zealand to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions.
Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale.
What you'll own

• Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

• Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.

• Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements.

• Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours.

• Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

• CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability.

• Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements.

What we're looking for

• Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale , ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic.

• Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python .

• Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response.

• A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.

• Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents.

• A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems.

• Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems.

• Based in Australia or New Zealand and comfortable providing production support during agreed hours that complement our UK and India engineering teams.

Nice to have

• Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM.

• Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications.

• Experience with C++.

• Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks.

• Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments.

Who you'll work with
You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services.
We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world.
You'll collaborate closely with our UK and India teams, with clear handovers between time zones to help ensure our production customers are supported around the clock.

arbeitnow:team-lead-sales-sme-kmu-b2b-sa.description:
Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam aufbauen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane SME (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) in Deutschland gewinnt? Als Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches SME-Segment baust du ein neu geschaffenes Team regionaler Account Executives auf: Du coachst im Kundengespräch – im Berliner Office und vor Ort bei deinen AEs und Kunden –, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. SME geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie Buchhaltung, Rechnungen, Zahlungen und Finanzplanung an einem Ort steuern – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit ihrer Steuerkanzlei.

Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

• 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

• 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

• 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – bei SME sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zur führenden Finanzplattform geworden.

• 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission
Du wirst Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – SME in Deutschland sein und unser neu geschaffenes SME-Team von Grund auf aufbauen. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives SME in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team auf.
In Frankreich nutzen über 900.000 SME Pennylane. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen SME-Markt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team
Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer SME-Kunden.
Im Ausbau: In den kommenden Monaten könnten wir ein eigenes Team für Onboarding und Account Management aufbauen – du gestaltest mit, wie Neukundengewinnung, Onboarding und Bestandskundenbetreuung zusammenspielen, damit deine AEs ihre Zeit wirksam einsetzen.
Regional organisiert: Jede:r Account Executive ist für mehrere Regionen verantwortlich, die von Berlin aus betreut werden – per Inside Sales und Video-Demo, bei wichtigen Kunden auch vor Ort. Rechne mit etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die jeweiligen Regionen.
Im Aufbau: In Deutschland sind bereits zwei Account Executives an Bord, ab Januar kommt ein SDR für die Lead-Qualifizierung dazu. Das Team soll weiter ausgebaut werden: Du stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere AEs ein, arbeitest sie ein und führst sie zum Erfolg – das Team wächst mit dir.
Schneller Vertrieb: Klassischer SMB-Sales: Dein Team gewinnt Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME – kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Schlagzahl, überzeugende Demos. Ihr zeigt konkret, wie Pennylane den Finanzalltag eines Unternehmens vereinfacht.
Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. arbeitnow:remote-gtm-lead-apac-226989.title: GTM Lead, APAC
arbeitnow:remote-gtm-lead-apac-226989.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?
We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.
About the role
Higgsfield AI is looking for a GTM Lead, APAC to build and own our commercial business across Asia-Pacific (excluding Japan, which has its own dedicated lead). APAC is already one of our largest regions by creators and generations; this role turns that usage into agency, brand and enterprise revenue.
You will define the APAC go-to-market, source and close the region's first lighthouse accounts yourself, open the partner routes to market that matter in Asia, and set the playbook that the next wave of APAC hires will follow. You will work closely with our Asia-based Growth team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.
The ideal candidate has sold creative, marketing or AI technology across at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures, knows when a partner is the right route in and when direct is, and is energised by owning a region from zero.
What you'll do
Open the APAC market

• Build and execute Higgsfield's APAC go-to-market strategy, tiered by market: active selling in Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, Korea and Hong Kong; relationship building in Southeast Asia, India and Taiwan; later investment elsewhere.

• Segment the region by readiness to buy: advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers, K-content, gaming and sports media.

• Personally source, run and close the region's first enterprise and agency deals, from first touch through negotiation and signature, adapting to how each market buys: procurement-led in ANZ, relationship-first in Korea and Greater China, partner-led and price-sensitive in Southeast Asia and India.

• Convert high-usage APAC creators, teams and agencies already on the platform into team and enterprise accounts.

Build pipeline and revenue

• Own APAC pipeline, forecast and bookings; keep 3x+ pipeline coverage and report weekly to leadership.

• Run an outbound-first motion in markets where inbound is thin, alongside platform-driven inbound where it is strong: executive outreach, events, partner introductions and creator-community referrals.

• Lead commercial negotiations, enterprise agreements, and multi-year, usage-based and local-currency deal structures.

• Build regional references and case studies that make the next APAC deal easier than the last.

Work the ecosystem

• Build relationships with senior decision-makers at regional agency holding-company offices, independent agencies, consumer brands and media groups.

• Identify and activate the partners that are the primary route to market in Asia (regional agency networks, telcos and platforms, production studios, system integrators, local resellers) with the Head of Partnerships.

• Represent Higgsfield at APAC industry events and in regional media as the leading AI video platform for creative work.

• Localise positioning, pricing packaging and campaigns for APAC buyers with Marketing and Product, and coordinate with our existing APAC content and community efforts.

• Surface market, competitive, platform and regulatory signals from the region to Product, Legal and leadership.

• Define what the APAC team should look like at 5 and 15 people, and help hire it.

What success looks like in year one

• A tiered APAC market plan and sales playbook that leadership has signed off.

• Marquee customers live in production in at least two active-selling markets, with public references.

• Two or more partner channels producing qualified pipeline.

• A forecast that is accurate within 15% quarter over quarter.

Requirements

• 8+ years in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or GTM leadership, including 3+ years selling SaaS, AI, creative technology, marketing technology or media technology in APAC.

• A track record of sourcing and closing six- and seven-figure deals yourself, not only through a team.

• Multi-country APAC experience: you have sold or led commercial efforts in at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures.

• Partner and channel experience in APAC markets where partners are the primary route to market.

• An existing network of senior buyers in APAC agencies, brands, media or entertainment companies.

• Comfortable opening a region alone and far from HQ: no local marketing, SE or RevOps bench on day one, and independent decision-making across time zones.

• Fluent English; Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa or Thai is a strong plus.

• Based in, or willing to relocate to, Almaty; or based in Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong or Korea with the right to work there and able to travel across the region and to Almaty regularly.

• Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI and hands-on fluency with Higgsfield or comparable creative AI tools.

Nice to have

• Experience at an AI-native company, a creator platform, a social or short-video platform, or a usage-based software business.

• Relationships in K-content, gaming, or broadcaster and streamer ecosystems in Asia.

• Prior experience as a first or founding commercial hire in a region.

What we're not looking for

• A strategy-only leader who needs a team before they can produce results.

• Someone whose success has depended on a large inbound brand and a full supporting bench.

• A single-market seller; APAC is too diverse for one-country experience.

What we offer

• Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

• Equity participation through the company's stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield's long-term growth.

• Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

• A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

• Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

Location and working model
We would prefer this person to be based in Almaty, where much of our Growth team sits and which keeps workable overlap with every APAC time zone. We are equally happy with a fully remote hire based in Singapore, Sydney, Hong Kong or Seoul, with regular travel to customers across the region and to Almaty and San Francisco for planning sessions and company events. Team members are expected to maintain sufficient overlap with the Growth team's working hours and to be active, responsive and close collaborators across time zones.

arbeitnow:microsoft-365-intune-administr.description:

Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns baust du IT, die trägt – statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.
Unsere Kund:innen sind Organisationen wie das Deutsche Kinderhilfswerk, die Technologiestiftung Berlin oder die Weltbank Group – Menschen, die mit ihrer Arbeit etwas verändern. Und du sorgst dafür, dass ihre IT verlässlich funktioniert.
Deine Rolle
Du bist bei uns die Person für Microsoft 365 und Intune. Du entscheidest, wie ein Tenant aufgesetzt ist, welche Richtlinien für Konten und Geräte gelten und wie die Daten vom alten Fileserver sauber in SharePoint landen. Bevor bei Kund:innen etwas umgebaut wird, planst du es – von der Bestandsaufnahme über das Zielbild bis zum Cut-over – und setzt es anschließend mit dem Team um. Unser IT-Support arbeitet nach deinen Standards und spiegelt dir, was im Alltag hakt.
Was du bei uns machst
Microsoft 365 & Entra ID

• Tenants aufsetzen und aufräumen: Rollen, Lizenzen, Gruppen, Gastzugriffe und klare Namenskonventionen

• Exchange Online betreuen: Postfächer, Verteiler, Mail-Flow, Spam- und Phishing-Schutz, SPF, DKIM und DMARC

• SharePoint und Teams so strukturieren, dass Seiten, Bibliotheken und Berechtigungen auch in zwei Jahren noch verständlich sind

• Identitäten absichern: MFA, Conditional Access, Notfallkonten und Rechtekonzepte in Entra ID

Intune & Endgeräte

• Windows-Geräte über Intune verwalten: Konfigurations- und Compliance-Richtlinien, Updates und App-Rollouts

• Geräte-Rollouts und Windows-11-Umstellungen planen und durchziehen, gern mit Autopilot

• Microsoft Defender for Business einrichten und Meldungen bewerten

• Apple-Geräte einbinden, wo Kund:innen gemischt arbeiten, über Intune und Apple Business Manager

Migrationen & Projekte

• Bestandsaufnahmen bei Kund:innen durchführen und daraus ein Zielbild entwickeln: Wo soll die IT in ein bis zwei Jahren stehen?

• Umzüge planen und umsetzen: vom Fileserver nach SharePoint, von Google Workspace zu Microsoft 365, von Tenant zu Tenant oder raus aus dem lokalen Active Directory

• Den Plan selbst mit umsetzen: Testlauf, Cut-over am Wochenende, Rückfallebene und Nachbetreuung der Nutzer:innen

• Konzepte so aufschreiben, dass Geschäftsführung und Vorstand entscheiden können: mit Varianten, Kosten und Risiken

• Aufwände realistisch schätzen und Angebote gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vorbereiten

Copilot, KI & Automatisierung

• Microsoft 365 Copilot und andere KI-Tools bei Kund:innen einführen – mit aufgeräumten Berechtigungen, Vertraulichkeitsbezeichnungen und geklärtem Datenschutz

arbeitnow:customer-success-onboarding-sp.description:
Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.
Deine Mission
Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.
Deine Aufgaben

• Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

• Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

• Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

• Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

• Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.
Das bringst du mit

• Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

• Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

• Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

• Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

• Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

• Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.
Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

• Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

• Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

• Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

• Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

• Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

• Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

• Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.
Wen wir suchen
Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

• Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

• Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

• Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

• Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt - von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Paid Ads sind unser Hebel für Skalierung. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen, und mit starken Creatives auf Meta und Google wollen wir noch mehr Menschen für Calisthenics und GORNATION begeistern.
Wir suchen einen Performance Creative Manager , der unsere Ad Production von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung steuert. Du entwickelst Konzepte, planst Shootings, briefst unsere Cutter und sorgst dafür, dass regelmäßig neue Ads live gehen.
Dein Ziel: mehr Ad Output in besserer Qualität, mehr Winning Concepts und Creatives, mit denen wir unseren Ad Spend skalieren können.
Arbeitsmodell: ab 30 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster - weil Konzeption, Shootings und schnelles Feedback im Team live noch besser funktionieren.
Start: 01.01.2027
Aufgaben

• Ad Production steuern: Du planst den Produktionsfunnel für Evergreen Ads und Aktionen und sorgst für einen konstanten Output an neuen Creatives.

• Konzepte entwickeln: Du recherchierst Trends, Formate und Ad Libraries und entwickelst daraus Konzepte, Hooks und Angles für Meta und Google.

• Shootings & UGC organisieren: Du planst und begleitest interne Ad Shootings und stimmst dich mit unseren Athleten zu Organic Reposts und UGC ab.

• Feedback-Loops mit Cuttern: Du briefst unsere Cutter, gibst Feedback zu Ad-Versionen und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst.

• Performance auswerten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Media Buyer analysierst du die Ergebnisse, leitest Learnings ab und bringst sie direkt in die nächsten Konzepte ein.

• Aktionen begleiten: Bei allen Kampagnen mit Paid-Anteil bist du von Anfang an dabei und planst die passenden Creatives rechtzeitig.

Qualifikation

• Erfahrung in der Ad-Konzeption: Du hast bereits Ads konzipiert oder mit UGC gearbeitet, idealerweise im D2C-Umfeld, und weißt, warum ein Creative performt.

• Organisation & Projektmanagement: Du behältst Konzepte, Shootings und Deadlines parallel im Blick und setzt klare Prioritäten.

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du treibst Themen eigenständig voran und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen.

• Bezug zur Szene: Du bist in der Fitness- oder Calisthenics-Welt zuhause und verstehst unsere Community.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Du stimmst dich mit Media Buyer, Cuttern, Athleten, Content Team und externen Partnern ab und bleibst auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen klar.

• Hands-on & belastbar: Shooting-Deadlines und viele Stakeholder bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig.

arbeitnow:senior-fullstack-entwickler-ph.description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring für unseren Kunden die Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.
Auf einen Blick

• Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

• Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

• Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

• Standort: Berlin

• Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

• Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle
Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.
Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.
Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.
Deine Aufgaben

• Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

• Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

• Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

• Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

• Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

• Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

• Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …
… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.
Dein Profil

• Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

• PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

• Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

• Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

• JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

• Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

• Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

• Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

• Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

• Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

• Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.
Dein Team
Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.
Was wir bieten

• Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

• Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

• 30 Urlaubstage

• Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

• Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

• Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

• Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

• UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

• Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

• Teamgespräch vor Ort

Über das Unternehmen
Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.
MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.
Unser Wachstum hängt an zwei Seiten gleichzeitig. Wer etwas verschicken will, braucht jemanden, der es mitnimmt. Wer mitnehmen will, braucht Aufträge auf seiner Strecke. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt.
Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind.
Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen.
Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.12. in mit 30h/Woche als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀
Aufgaben

• Paid-Kanäle verantworten

Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt.

• Den ganzen Funnel im Blick

Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden.

• Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie

Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen.

• Creative-Pipeline

Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert.

• Testing-Programm

Du testest systematisch statt nach Bauchgefühl. Von der Hypothese über das Setup bis zur sauberen Auswertung. Learnings dokumentierst du so, dass das ganze Team sie nutzen kann.

• KI und eigene Tools

Du arbeitest KI-first. Mit Claude Code baust du dir eigene Tools für Auswertung, Reporting, Automatisierung und Creative-Varianten. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

• Performance sichtbar machen

Du lieferst ein klares wöchentliches Reporting für Team und Gründer:innen. Nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern was wir jetzt tun sollten.

• Trends und Plattform-Änderungen

Neue Formate, Algorithmus-Updates, Veränderungen bei Tracking und Attribution. Du hast sie auf dem Schirm, bevor sie uns treffen, und leitest ab, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet.

• Datenschnittstelle im Marketing

Du wirst Ansprechperson für Datenfragen aus CRM, SEO und Social Media und verbindest die Zahlen zu einem Bild.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und dabei eigenständig Budget verantwortet. Idealerweise bei einer App, auf einem Marktplatz oder in einem schnell wachsenden Startup.
Meta Ads und Google Ads kennst du in der Tiefe. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur aufgesetzt, sondern Account-Strukturen gebaut, Budgets über mehrere Kanäle gesteuert und auf Events jenseits des Installs optimiert. Erfahrung mit Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Mobile-Attribution und Tracking-Setups ist ein klares Plus.
Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Tool-Wissen:

• Du denkst in Funnels, nicht in Downloads. Ein günstiger Install, aus dem nie ein Transport wird, ist für dich kein Erfolg.

• Du arbeitest datenbasiert. Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sauber und sagst auch, wenn ein Test nichts gebracht hat.

• Du nutzt KI täglich und hast Lust, dir mit Claude Code eigene Workflows zu bauen.

• Du kennst die Trends im Paid-Bereich und bringst neue Ideen mit, bevor jemand danach fragt.

• Du triffst Budgetentscheidungen selbst und kannst sie mit Zahlen begründen.

• Du schreibst Ad Copy, die unsere Zielgruppe wirklich trifft.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.
Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.
Benefits

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle : Arbeite, wann und wo es für dich am besten passt

• Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote : Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm

• Offsites mit dem Team : Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr

• Free MUVN Rides : Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren

• Corporate Benefits : Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Antwort auf diese Frage:
Performance Marketing für einen Marktplatz wie MUVN funktioniert anders als für einen Onlineshop oder eine klassische App. Wir brauchen Menschen, die etwas verschicken, und Fahrer:innen, die es mitnehmen, am besten auf derselben Strecke. Was würdest du bei uns anders angehen? Und auf welche Kennzahl würdest du als Erstes schauen?
Es gibt keine richtige Antwort. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst.
Oder schick uns ein kurzes Video dazu. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.
So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit Katharina, dann eine Session mit Jule an einem echten Case aus unseren Kampagnen, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.
Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.
Let's get it muvn. 🚀

arbeitnow:director-brand-partnerships-lo.title: Director, Brand Partnerships
arbeitnow:director-brand-partnerships-lo.description:
LTK’s mission is to empower the world’s premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we’re looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. 

We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth.

 

Director, Brand Partnerships (UK)

Location: London, UK
Reports to: VP, Brand Partnerships (EU)
Role Type: Full Time

About the Role

We're looking for a Director, Brand Partnerships to join our growing EU Brand Partnerships team.

This is a senior commercial role responsible for driving enterprise growth across the UK through the acquisition, growth and strategic development of LTK's most valuable brand partnerships. You'll own the development of high-value relationships with leading fashion, beauty, lifestyle and luxury brands, positioning LTK as a trusted, long-term creator commerce partner.

As one of the UK's most senior commercial leaders, you'll lead consultative sales conversations with executive stakeholders, identifying opportunities to solve complex marketing challenges through LTK's full-funnel creator marketing solutions. You'll be responsible for building new enterprise relationships while strategically growing a portfolio of LTK Europe’s highest-potential and highest-value brand partners. Through a consultative approach, you'll develop a healthy pipeline of opportunities, convert new business and expand long-term investment across your accounts.

Working closely with Brand Activation, Creator Success, Campaign Operations and Marketing, you'll own the long-term growth of strategic brand partners, taking over once brands have successfully onboarded and transitioned through their initial activation phase to maximise retention, investment and lifetime value.

This role is ideal for an experienced enterprise seller who thrives on opening new opportunities, influencing senior decision-makers and building meaningful commercial partnerships across every level of a brand's marketing organisation—from executive leadership through to day-to-day marketing teams.

What You'll Own

Enterprise Sales & Market Development

  • Develop and execute the UK enterprise & mid market business strategy across fashion, beauty, lifestyle and luxury sectors.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of high-value opportunities through strategic prospecting, networking and industry engagement.
  • Develop relationships across senior marketing organisations, including CMOs, Marketing Directors, Digital, Social, Affiliate and Ecommerce leaders.
  • Lead complex consultative sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and contract execution.
  • Position LTK as a strategic creator commerce partner by delivering insight-led, value-based sales conversations.
  • Consistently exceed ambitious Managed Services and Advertising revenue targets.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic brand partners, identifying opportunities to increase investment across LTK's commercial solutions.
  • Develop long-term account strategies that deepen relationships and expand LTK's footprint across multiple business units.
  • Identify opportunities across creator collaborations, paid media, content, licensing, events and emerging commercial products.
  • Build trusted executive relationships that position LTK as a long-term strategic marketing partner.
  • Deliver executive business reviews, strategic recommendations and commercial proposals that support long-term partnership growth.
  • Partner with clients to solve evolving marketing challenges through innovative creator-led solutions.

Commercial Leadership

  • Partner closely with Brand Activation to ensure a seamless transition of newly activated brands into long-term commercial management.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Creator Success, Campaign Operations, Product and Operations to deliver an exceptional partner experience.
  • Share market intelligence and customer feedback to influence product development, commercial strategy and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Lead the development of sales playbooks, enterprise outreach strategies and consultative selling best practices.
  • Identify emerging categories, market trends and whitespace opportunities to expand LTK's enterprise footprint across the UK.
  • Represent LTK across the UK marketing industry by building executive-level relationships, speaking at key industry events and strengthening LTK's position as the leading creator commerce platform.
  • Act as a senior commercial leader within the UK Brand Partnerships team, shaping commercial strategy, coach consultative selling and foster a culture of high performance

Sales Excellence

  • Consistently exceed individual sales quotas while contributing to wider UK Business Partnerships objectives.
  • Use performance data and commercial insights to continuously optimise sales strategy and pipeline health.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting and reporting through HubSpot and internal systems.
  • Build compelling, insight-led presentations and business cases tailored to executive audiences.
  • Stay ahead of consumer trends, retail innovation and the evolving creator economy to identify new commercial opportunities.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years' experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships or business development within digital marketing, media, SaaS or influencer marketing.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding commercial targets through enterprise new business acquisition and strategic account growth.
  • A consultative relationship builder who earns trust quickly and is comfortable influencing senior stakeholders through insight rather than transactional selling.
  • Experience leading complex consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and executive decision-makers.
  • Exceptional commercial acumen with the ability to translate market trends into compelling business opportunities.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, social commerce and the evolving creator economy.
  • Comfortable influencing cross-functional teams and collaborating across multiple business functions.
  • Existing senior relationships across fashion, beauty, luxury and lifestyle brands.
  • Highly strategic while remaining hands-on and execution focused.
  • Proactive, entrepreneurial and driven to build new commercial opportunities.
  • Fluent English language skills; additional European languages are a plus.
  • A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency
  • Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence
  • Adaptability to a dynamic, fast-moving environment
  • A growth mindset and openness to feedback

arbeitnow:senior-risk-engineer-london-26.title: Senior Risk Engineer
arbeitnow:senior-risk-engineer-london-26.description:
We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.

Capstone is a global, alternative investment management firm operating across a broad range of derivatives-based strategies with a deep understanding of volatility. With approximately $14.6 billion of AUM and 315 employees (as of September 1, 2026, Capstone was formed in 2007 and is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Tokyo, California, Stamford, Boston, and Milan.

At Capstone, we constantly aim to expand our view of how WE SEE THE WORLD DIFFERENTLY® in order to create opportunity. Our commitment to provoking the evolution of asset management provides us with a perpetual hunger for knowledge that we believe drives the improvement of our particular approach to investment. We seek to harness the complexities of global derivatives markets with disciplined strategic insight, an experienced, accomplished team and advanced technology to create sustainable value. We’ve created a particular approach to investment that we believe drives continuous improvement and opportunities for our clients, team and industry.

The Team:

Capstone is looking to appoint a Senior Risk Engineer at Senior Vice President level within Risk Technology. This is a hands-on role combining software engineering, risk and financial markets, with direct exposure to the investment process. You will design and build investment-facing risk and decision-support capabilities, remaining close to the code, data and users from initial problem through to production.

This is an opportunity to build the technology behind Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy - turning complex risk and portfolio data into timely, actionable intelligence. You will develop tools that help Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider across stress scenarios, risk factors, margin, liquidity and portfolio analytics. The work will directly support sizing, trade expression, hedging, portfolio construction and capital allocation - helping drive better decisions, more efficient capital and more repeatable alpha.

You will work closely with Risk Managers, Portfolio Managers, Quant Research and the wider Technology, Data and AI teams. The role requires deep technical contribution, end-to-end ownership and the ability to shape outcomes through strong judgement, delivery and collaboration. It offers broad exposure across strategies and asset classes, together with the opportunity to help shape the next generation of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform.

We are building a high-performing team that values ownership, collaboration and solving difficult problems. We encourage curiosity and new ideas, alongside the discipline and reliability needed to deliver and support critical production systems.

Responsibilities and Impact:

  • Architect, build and own production-grade components of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform, remaining close to the code, data and users and designing for performance, scalability, reliability and usability.
  • Build and evolve scalable cross-asset risk capabilities spanning Greeks and sensitivities, stress scenarios, VaR, P&L vectors and attribution, limits, factor analytics, margin, and exposure aggregation.
  • Partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Quant Research to solve complex derivatives, risk and portfolio challenges, taking ideas from problem definition through to production.
  • Build APIs, data pipelines and interactive decision tools that help users understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider at trade, POD, strategy and fund level.
  • Translate pricing and risk methodologies into scalable, explainable services, with clear treatment of model assumptions, calibration, validation and controls.
  • Advance Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy by building tools that turn research, risk analytics and AI into practical investment insight - helping Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers analyse scenarios, understand book and factor exposures, diagnose P&L and access validated analytics through natural language.
  • Engineer and operate resilient risk services, integrating positions, market and reference data, and internal or third-party analytics, with strong testing, data lineage and end-to-end ownership of production issues.
  • Shape and deliver high-value components of the Risk Technology roadmap in partnership with Technology, Data and AI teams, using common platforms, standards and engineering practices and contributing to design reviews, code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Our future colleague has these skills:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, quantitative development or risk technology within a hedge fund, asset manager, investment bank or comparable capital-markets environment, with meaningful exposure to front-office or market-risk systems.
  • A strong record of personally designing, building and supporting production-grade risk, pricing or trading systems, and owning complex projects from definition through delivery and support.
  • Advanced Python / Java and SQL skills, together with strong proficiency in at least one comparable language; practical experience with APIs, distributed or event-driven architectures, databases, data pipelines and large-scale processing.
  • Strong understanding of derivatives and cross-asset risk analytics, including option pricing, Greeks, scenario analysis and VaR. Knowledge of factor risk and margin analytics is desirable.
  • Strong architecture and engineering judgement, with a focus on maintainability, testability, performance, controls and operational resilience.
  • Ability to critically assess model outputs, challenge assumptions and trace discrepancies across data, calibration, methodology and implementation, while explaining conclusions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience integrating internally developed and third-party pricing and risk libraries across asset classes, with strong attention to data lineage, reconciliation, consistency and controls.
  • Clear, concise communication and evidence of technical leadership through judgement, ownership, and delivery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers, Quant Research and engineering teams.

Bonus skills:

  • Hands-on experience applying machine learning, large language models agentic tools or AI-assisted development in a controlled production environment, including evaluation, access controls, monitoring and human oversight.
  • Experience designing and operating modern engineering and data platforms, including cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, streaming, data lineage and observability.
  • Deep product and risk knowledge in at least one asset class, combined with a broad working understanding across multiple asset classes, including equities, fixed income, credit, commodities and FX.

Benefits & Compensation Information:

Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this.  We offer a robust and competitive benefits program to ensure the well-being of our colleagues.

Some benefits included in this role are:

  • Training and development opportunities
  • Robust Wellness Resources: Physical, Mental and Financial
  • Time-Off, Retirement and Commuter Benefits
  • Gym Reimbursement and other Discounts

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.

To learn even more about being part of the team, visit us online: Careers - Capstone (capstoneco.com)

Don’t forget to follow us on LinkedIn

arbeitnow:remote-senior-business-analyst.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
  • Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
  • Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
  • Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
  • Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
  • Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
  • Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
  • Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
  • Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
  • Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
  • Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
  • Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills

  • Product management
  • Analytics
  • Marketing
  • Data Science
  • Design
  • Customer Success

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

arbeitnow:remote-head-of-engineering-sal.title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
arbeitnow:remote-head-of-engineering-sal.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are 

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

arbeitnow:senior-security-engineer-appli.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, Application for our Engineering and Technology team. You own application security for Firmus AI Cloud and the internal software that runs it. Automation is how you scale that ownership. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own the security of that software: the public APIs, the services behind them, how tenants stay separated inside the application, and the AI assistants and agents we ship on top. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the CI/CD security gates that every production repository passes through: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and SBOM generation. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, and draft threat models.  
  • Ship the secure paved roads other teams build on: reusable libraries, service templates, and developer tooling.

arbeitnow:senior-ai-infrastructure-engin.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, Kubernetes
arbeitnow:senior-ai-infrastructure-engin.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

Role Summary (Location Melbourne or Sydney)

The Senior Kubernetes Engineer, AI Infrastructure owns the technical design and delivery of the backend infrastructure that powers the Firmus Kubernetes platform. This is a hands-on principal-level individual contributor role, responsible for building production-grade cluster lifecycle, control-plane, networking, storage, security, observability, and automation capabilities across GPU-accelerated bare-metal environments.

They solve the hardest platform engineering problems, set Kubernetes engineering standards, and provide domain-level technical sign-off for platform designs. They work across AI Platforms, Solutions Architecture & Delivery, networking, security, and operations to create a secure, resilient, multi-tenant platform that can be deployed and operated consistently at AI-factory scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Kubernetes platform reference architecture across management and workload clusters, including control-plane topology, cluster lifecycle, multi-tenancy, workload isolation, and failure-domain design.
  • Build and maintain the backend services, APIs, controllers, operators, and automation required to provision, configure, upgrade, scale, and retire Kubernetes clusters reliably.
  • Engineer repeatable bare-metal Kubernetes deployment and lifecycle workflows using infrastructure-as-code and automated provisioning technologies such as Cluster API, kubeadm, Redfish, PXE, Ironic, or Metal3.
  • Design and operate cluster networking across CNI, ingress, service discovery, DNS, load balancing, network policy, and service mesh; integrate Multus, SR-IOV, BGP, InfiniBand, or RoCE where required for high-performance AI workloads.
  • Define persistent-storage and data-service patterns using CSI, Ceph, local NVMe, object storage, backup and restore, and disaster-recovery mechanisms appropriate for stateful platform and AI workloads.
  • Integrate and productionise NVIDIA GPU and Network Operators, device plugins, drivers, DCGM telemetry, scheduling, quotas, and topology-aware placement for multi-node accelerated workloads.
  • Establish GitOps and CI/CD patterns for platform software, configuration, policy, and release management, with safe testing, progressive rollout, rollback, and upgrade practices.
  • Build platform security into the architecture through identity and access control, RBAC, secrets management, policy-as-code, image and software-supply-chain controls, tenant isolation, and auditable change management.
  • Define service-level objectives and engineer observability for metrics, logs, traces, events, capacity, and performance; lead diagnosis of complex distributed systems failures and eliminate recurring operational toil.
  • Set engineering standards, design patterns, review practices, and operational readiness criteria; mentor senior engineers and resolve cross-team technical decisions while remaining directly involved in implementation.

 

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production Kubernetes platforms and at least 3 years operating at senior staff, principal, or equivalent level.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes internals, including the API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager, kubelet, admission, CRI, CNI, CSI, reconciliation patterns, cluster performance, upgrades, and control-plane failure modes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating highly available, large scale and multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms on bare metal, private cloud, or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Strong software engineering ability in Go and/or Rust, with practical Python and Bash skills; experience building Kubernetes operators, controllers, admission webhooks, CLIs, or platform services.</

arbeitnow:head-of-ai-factory-commissioni.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.
