With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

 

Role Summary

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Head of AI Factory Commissioning to build and lead the function responsible for commissioning the physical infrastructure of our AI Factories across the Asia Pacific region. You will set the strategy, standards and governance that ensure every AI Factory is proven safe, resilient and performing to design before any compute is deployed.

 

An AI Factory is a building scale computer that places unprecedented demands on power density, liquid cooling, controls integration, operational resilience, and commissioning rigor. This role is responsible for ensuring these next-generation facilities are proven ready to support large-scale GPU deployments before handover to AI Cluster Commissioning. Firmus has AI factories under development ranging in size from tens of MW to GW scale.

 

This is a function lead role, at the same level as the Head of AI Cluster Commissioning. You will lead a team of Commissioning Managers who run the day-to-day commissioning. Your focus will be building the function, setting direction, managing risk across the portfolio, and owning the “ready for IT” gate: no data hall is handed over for cluster bring-up until its infrastructure has passed the appropriate level of commissioning acceptance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Function Build

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team of Commissioning Managers and commissioning professionals.
  • Define the structure, capability and resourcing model for the function so it can scale with Firmus’ national and APAC project pipeline.
  • Allocate leadership and resources across the portfolio of AI Factory projects, balancing priorities and managing delivery risk.
  • Build a culture of safety, ownership, technical rigour and continuous improvement.

Commissioning Strategy & Governance

  • Set the strategic direction for AI Factory commissioning, including the methodology, commissioning levels (L1–L5), Integrated Systems Testing (IST) approach and acceptance criteria.
  • Direct the development of commissioning standards, frameworks and templates, delivered through the Commissioning Manager.
  • Set up governance, assurance and reporting that give leadership clear visibility of commissioning progress, readiness and quality across all projects.
  • Make sure commissioning strategies cover all critical infrastructure, including:
    • HV/MV/LV power distribution, UPS, generators and battery energy storage
    • Liquid cooling (CDUs, secondary fluid networks, chillers and heat rejection)
    • Air-side cooling (CRAH/CRAC units, fan walls, air handling and containment)
    • Controls and monitoring: BMS, EPMS and the CubeSense SCADA platform
    • Fire detection and suppression, security and other life-safety systems
  • Act as the final escalation point for complex technical issues, commissioning failures and acceptance decisions.

 

Handover & Stakeholder Interfaces

  • Own the facility “ready for IT” gate, jointly with the Head of AI Cluster Commissioning, so commissioned data halls hand over cleanly to cluster bring-up.
  • Set the standard for handover to operations, including as-built documentation, training, known issues and operational readiness.
  • Work with Engineering & Technology, Construction/Delivery, Operations and the AI Infrastructure Platform (AIIP) teams to embed commissionability from concept design onwards.
  • Represent commissioning with executive leadership, customers, partners and key suppliers.

Commercial, Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Set the strategy for engaging third-party commissioning agents and oversee their commercial and delivery performance.

The Role


As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)  you sit at the intersection of software reliability and operational excellence. You own the health, resilience, and recovery of our production systems—while spending equal energy innovating solutions that eliminate human toil, reduce incident blast radius, and raise the reliability bar across the entire platform.  You will partner closely with engineering, operations, and business teams to understand daily pain points and translate them into lasting automated solutions. Half your time is spent in the trenches—supporting production, responding to incidents, and deeply understanding how our
systems behave under real conditions. The other half is yours to build: automation, tooling, and observability platforms that make tomorrow's on-call shift meaningfully easier than today's.  


You will work on challenges like:


● Design and build comprehensive monitoring and observability platforms that surface the right signal at the right time—eliminating alert fatigue and accelerating root-cause analysis.
● Develop intelligent automation and self-healing capabilities that diagnose issues, trigger recovery workflows, and reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR) without manual intervention.
● Analyze incidents, identify systemic trends, and engineer solutions that prevent entire classes of failures from recurring.
● Build reusable runbooks, diagnostic tooling, and recovery playbooks that turn tribal knowledge into scalable platform capabilities.
● Create golden-path operational workflows—making the safest, most reliable path also the easiest one for engineering teams to follow.
● Partner with Platform Engineering to influence CI/CD pipelines, deployment safety, and infrastructure resilience from a production reliability perspective.
● Champion Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and SRE best practices while helping teams adopt modern engineering workflows.
● Continuously measure production health through SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, and drive engineering priorities based on reliability data.
● Explore emerging technologies—including AI-assisted diagnostics and developer tooling—that transform how we operate production systems.

The Team


We believe resilient systems are built by engineers who understand them end to end.  Our Production Engineering team is the first and last line of defense for our production platform.  We treat reliability as a product, with uptime and engineer experience as our north stars. We combine the discipline of SRE with a builder's mindset: when we see a recurring problem, we build a solution—not a workaround.


You will work across every engineering and operations team to understand failure modes, quantify reliability gaps, and build platform capabilities that scale with the organization. Whether it's reducing MTTR from hours to minutes, building self-service diagnostic tools, or designing proactive alerting that catches issues before customers notice, your work will have immediate, measurable impact.


If you're passionate about making production systems invisible to end users—and you get energy from both firefighting and building the systems that make fires less likely—you'll thrive here.

What We're Looking For


We're looking for engineers who combine operational instinct with a builder's discipline.


You should have:
● Strong hands-on Python skills—this is your primary language for automation and tooling.
● Experience in SRE, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related discipline with direct production ownership.
● Proven track record of building automation and diagnostic tooling that improved recovery times or reduced operational toil.
● Deep familiarity with cloud-native technologies—Kubernetes, containers, distributed systems—and how they fail in production.
● Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, and a strong intuition for what "good" monitoring looks like.
● Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and GitOps-based deployment workflows (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar).
● Familiarity with the broader technology stack: Java, Go, Kafka, Redis, Snowflake, and Postgres.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills—you thrive on ambiguous, high-stakes production problems.
● A product mindset applied to operational tooling: you think about usability, adoption, and documentation when building internal solutions.
● Excellent communication skills and the ability to work fluidly across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
● Self-starter mentality—you identify opportunities, take initiative, and deliver with minimal supervision.
● Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset; fintech or financial industry background is a plus.

The Technology You'll Work With


You'll operate and build on a modern cloud-native platform that includes:

● Kubernetes & AWS
● Terraform & ArgoCD

Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Job

The Product Manager owns strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) domain of the Zone & Co platform — covering procurement, vendor management, AP automation, invoice capture, approvals, and payments. Reporting to the Director of Product, this role spans the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and ongoing health of live features.

You'll translate complex AP/procurement workflows (requisition-to-approval, three-way match, invoice capture, payment execution) into intuitive software built natively on Oracle NetSuite. This is a ground-floor opportunity in "Agentic Finance" — you'll spend more time in working prototypes than slide decks, using AI to move from insight to demo in hours, and you'll define how autonomous agents earn user trust in a domain where accuracy is non-negotiable.

What You'll Do

  • Define product vision and strategy for P2P, backed by market and customer research
  • Own the roadmap — set OKRs and prioritize new features, enhancements, defects, and tech debt
  • Lead development with Engineering and Design through the Agile lifecycle
  • Drive Agentic AI integration — automate invoice coding, matching, exception handling, and approval routing, while designing guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Prototype fast with AI, then turn what works into requirements, user stories, and quality evals for AI features
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy and enablement
  • Ensure product logic meets global financial and tax compliance standards
  • Monitor performance and iterate based on data and customer feedback
  • Protect UX so complex workflows stay intuitive within NetSuite
  • Manage backlog, stakeholder alignment, UAT, and internal training
  • Use AI tools to summarize customer feedback from Support and Sales
  • Evaluate third-party integrations and support technical debt reduction

What You'll Need

Required

  • AI-native: builds with AI daily and has shipped AI/agentic features to production
  • 5+ years in Product Management within Fintech, ERP, or B2B SaaS, with direct P2P/AP/procurement ownership
  • Hands-on finance experience (practitioner or close partner to AP/procurement/controllership teams)
  • Track record taking roadmaps from discovery to launch
  • Experience owning a live, at-scale product — balancing new work against defects, escalations, and tech debt
  • Strong Agile/Scrum skills and familiarity with tools like Jira or Productboard
  • Proven success in fully remote, async, globally distributed teams
  • Excellent communicator, able to translate compliance logic into simple software

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable native ERP platform
  • Familiarity with P2P/spend tools (Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com, Tipalti, AvidXchange, Ramp) and OCR/document capture
  • Understanding of multi-jurisdictional tax logic (VAT/GST/Sales Tax)
  • Finance/accounting/procurement certification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CPIM, etc.)
  • Experience scaling products in high-growth (Series C–D) environments

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

United States

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

Non-US Jurisdictions

About the Role 

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: 

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)
An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)
You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)
Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)
At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process.

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

arbeitnow:senior-research-scientist-ai-s.title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
arbeitnow:senior-research-scientist-ai-s.description:
About Us
Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.
Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.
In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.
At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role
You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer.
We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards.
You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include:

• Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise.

• Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk.

• Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail.

• Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work.

We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community.
You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and
experimental teams across the company.

About You
You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed.
You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas.
You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work.
You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim.
You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them.
You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. You care about enabling useful scientific and medical applications of AI and are motivated to make them safer.

Nice to Have

• Research experience in AI safety or biosecurity, including evaluations, red-teaming, or threat modelling.

• Experience with protein design, genomic models, structure prediction, or other biological AI systems.

• Experimental biology experience, or computational research validated in collaboration with an experimental team.

• Experience implementing and evaluating safeguards in deployed systems.

• Collaboration with biosecurity organisations, synthesis screening initiatives, or AI safety institutes.

Compensation and benefits
What we offer in return

• Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

• Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

• High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

• Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

arbeitnow:emea-statutory-reporting-senio.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co .
We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions
About the role
Applied Intuition is scaling quickly across entities and geographies, and statutory reporting, clean audits, and compliant local filings are essential. In this London-based role, you will be the accountable owner of statutory reporting, audit, and compliance for our EMEA entities, including the UK, Germany, Sweden, and Saudi Arabia, with more to come.
Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will lead the EMEA local close and statutory audits, own the filing calendar, oversee the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion work produced by our India-based outsourced accounting team, and partner with Tax, Legal, and Business Technology to automate statutory and compliance processes in NetSuite. This is a hands-on opportunity to build a best-in-class statutory and compliance function across EMEA for a high-growth company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

• Own the preparation, review, and sign-off of statutory financial statements for our EMEA entities under local GAAP (UK GAAP/FRS 102, German HGB, Swedish K2/K3, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia), including the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion and bridge work papers.

• Lead each statutory audit end to end with our external auditors, from planning and PBC lists through audit queries, adjustments, and management representation letters, closing audits on schedule.

Application Security Testing

Threat Modeling & Application Security Analysis

• Participate in threat modeling sessions.

• Document identified threats, assess risks and provide mitigation recommendations.

Vulnerability Management

Collaboration & Awareness

Required Skills & Experience

Preferred

• Experience of participating in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions.

Key Competencies

• Eager to learn and expand technical skills in application security.

• Effective communicator with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Collaborative and proactive problem solver.

• Ability to prioritise work.

Au cœur de Value Chain et rattaché à Decathlon Digital, les équipes united du sous domaine Fulfillment, Logistics, Transport and Customs (FLTC) ont un rôle très important à jouer avec un impact direct sur l’expérience client à travers la disponibilité de nos produits et les délais de livraison. 

Notre équipe Transport&Customs Engineering design, développe et assure la maintenance de nos outils digitaux interconnectés avec un écosystème Decathlon complexe qui permet la gestion de la chaîne de valeur de bout en bout. Ces outils sont réparti sur deux périmètres : 

Transport : plusieurs produits digitaux pour gérer le transport international (upstream) et les flux de transport locaux (downstream) de nos produits et composants. Ces produits digitaux interviennent depuis nos fournisseurs jusqu’au client final.Customs : Des outils digitaux pour les douanes permettant le référencement de nos produits et composants, le calcul des taux et la génération des documents douaniers ainsi que les opérations de déclaration et dédouanement à la sortie/entrée d’une zone douanière.

TA FUTURE MISSION

Rejoignez l'équipe Transport et Douane l! Historiquement basée sur des outils monolithiques (Legacy) générant une complexité de référencement et une forte imprévisibilité des coûts à payer en douane, nous sommes en pleine transformation. Notre vision est de créer une source intelligente et malléable à fin que notre référentiel soit une source de vérité unique. L'utilisation de l'IA pour l'auto-classification et l'optimisation dynamique des droits de douane, transformera la douane à Decathlon et fera de la conformité, un levier stratégique de compétitivité.

Pour répondre à ces challenges, tout en permettant la croissance du business de Decathlon, nous cherchons à renforcer l’équipe produit Ref&Calcul par un développeur backend  qui va travailler avec le reste de l’équipe et en se référant au inputs business pour développer from scratch la solution de référencement des produits et composants et de calcul des taux de douanes. Dans le cadre de cette mission, Il sera amené à faire du support niveau 2 et Niveau 3 sur des solutions existantes et de celles qu’il développera. 

 

Une attention particulière sera apportée quant à l’autonomie requise pour les développements, autant que sur le partage d'expérience et de compétence.

Une expérience en développement dans des contextes agiles est fortement appréciée.

Le profil évoluera dans une équipe support et aura la responsabilité de prendre les sujets supports de Niveau 2 et 3

Il sera force de proposition sur les développements d'amélioration continue, la supervision et le monitoring de l'ensemble des applications du périmètre.

Le profil doit être intéressé et volontaire sur du Backend et capable d'appliquer et de différencier les bonnes pratiques de développement

Communiquant et force de proposition, tu dois aussi savoir faire preuve de transparence, gérer tes priorités, et être impliqué autant dans la réussite du/des projet(s) que dans la réussite de tes collègues

 

Compétences Requises

  • Concept : BDD, TDD, DDD, Clean Architecture / code, …
  • Back : Java 17+, SpringBoot, RESTful API, Kafka, kafka connect, OpenAPI, Oauth2, JWT, …
  • Architecture Microservices
  • Infra & Database : Docker, Kubernetes (GKE, EKS), Vault, postgres, mongodb
  • Deploy : Github - Github Actions, Flux, Helm
  • Tools & Monitoring : SonarQube, Datadog, Bruno, Gravitee…
  • Testing : Cucumber, Gatling, testContainers…

Compétences Souhaitées

  • Front : React, Typescript, Javascript, NextJS, TailwindCSS
  • Testing : Cypress ou Playwright, Jest ou Vitest, Gatling, X-RAY

  • Ecoute, communication, transparence
  • Autonomie
  • Rigueur et organisation
  • Sens du service

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

• Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

• Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

• Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

• Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

• Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

• Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

C'est un plus si :

• Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

• Tu parles anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés.

• Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires.

• Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client.

• Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence.

• Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers…

arbeitnow:ingenieure-de-recherche-h-f-cd.description:
Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :
École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.
Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.
IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.
Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.
Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :
Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.
Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.
Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.
L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.
Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :
• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation
Capacités et aptitudes :

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous
En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :
· Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance
· Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.

arbeitnow:cdi-hr-data-social-controlling.description:
Mission principale
Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.
Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Principales responsabilités
A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale

• Construire le budget annuel de masse salariale et des effectifs, en lien avec la DRH, la Direction Financière et les équipes opérationnelles.

• Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année.

• Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs.

• Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements.

• Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs.

• Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH.

• Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération.

• Préparer les analyses nécessaires aux revues budgétaires et aux présentations destinées au CODIR.

B. HR Data Analytics et aide à la décision

• Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH.

• Analyser les tendances RH et identifier les principaux facteurs d'évolution des indicateurs sociaux.

• Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur le turnover, l'absentéisme, le recrutement, la mobilité interne, les rémunérations et les parcours professionnels.

• Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles.

• Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats.

• Concevoir des analyses prospectives et, lorsque les données le permettent, des modèles de prévision pour anticiper les évolutions des effectifs et des indicateurs sociaux.

• Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers.

C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation

• Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles.

• Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats.

• Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique.

• Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH.

• Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité, de la cohérence et de la disponibilité des données sociales.

• Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'optimisation des processus de collecte et d'exploitation des données.

D. Projets RH

• Participer activement à l’ensemble des exercices annuels liés aux sujets Comp & Ben :

• Révision annuelle des salaires, évaluation des bonus, plan de commissionnement pour les équipes de vente.

• Etudes de rémunérations, benchmarks internes et externes.

Profil recherché
Formation

• Bac +5 en contrôle de gestion, finance, statistiques, data analytics, ressources humaines ou école de commerce avec spécialisation pertinente.

• Une double compétence en finance et en data constitue un atout.

Expérience

• 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion sociale, HR Analytics, contrôle de gestion ou analyse de données, idéalement avec une exposition aux problématiques RH.

• Une expérience dans le retail, la mode, le luxe ou un environnement multi-entités est appréciée.

Compétences techniques

• Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des fonctions avancées d'analyse de données.

• Bonne maîtrise de Power BI.

• Capacité à manipuler, consolider et analyser des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes.

• Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de masse salariale, des rémunérations, des effectifs et des principaux indicateurs sociaux.

• Capacité à construire des modèles budgétaires, des prévisions et des analyses de sensibilité.

• La connaissance du système de paie ADP est un avantage.

• Doté d’un esprit analytique, vous êtes rigoureux et proactif, vous comprenez l’environnement Business, et êtes à l’aise dans la collaboration avec les différents départements.

About Voodoo
Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team
At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role
We’ve built BeReal with a tiny technology team of world-class engineers and we intend to keep this mindset as we scale it to hundreds of millions of users. To achieve this, we ship new features faster than any other scaled social network while upgrading our infrastructure. We work in small teams of generalists and give each engineer high autonomy to make product related decisions.

• Tackle exciting technical challenges, given the nature of our product, which experiences spikes of millions of users connecting within a 2-minute window.

• Contribute to the development of a robust architecture capable of supporting massive scale as we attract new users and expand to new countries.

• Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to create new features for the app.

• Analyze trade-offs and address technical challenges related to key components of our backend.

• Participate in code and design reviews.

Our Stack

• Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Pub/Sub, GitHub actions, and ArgoCD.

• Backend: Go, Node.js (NestJS, Nx, Typescript)

• Frontend: Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android).

• Database: Spanner, PostgreSQL, Redis.

Profile

• You have 5+ years of experience working on API on distributed architecture.

• You have a proven experience in Go and contribute to developing high volume API microservices.

• You are self-reliant and have prior experience in a startup or similar environment.

• You value teamwork and thrive on challenges.

• You are proficient in English as our team is diverse and international.

• You have a master degree in computer science or related field.

• Most importantly, you believe in the project, are motivated, and eager to embark on an exciting and challenging journey.

Benefits

• Competitive salary upon experience

• Swile Lunch voucher

• Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

• Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family is 100% borne by Voodoo

• Wellness activities in our Paris office

About Prelude
Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.
Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.
Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.
But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.
Why join us
Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.
We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

• Care
We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

• Bias for Action
We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

• Ownership
We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

This Account Executive role at Prelude is a hunting position, built for an outbound-first seller who thrives on prospecting and knows how to move fast. You’ll close SMB deals at volume across multiple industries and own the full cycle from A to Z, including your own prospecting, demos, and negotiation. Because you’ll handle technical stakeholders directly, you’ll also become a true expert in our product.
What will you be doing?

• Running your own outbound motion through cold calls, emails and LinkedIn to build pipeline from the ground up, working closely with our high-performing BDRs

• Owning the full sales cycle from first call to closed-won, typically within a short sales cycle

• Qualifying SMB prospects across multiple industries

• Running discovery that uncovers real pain and moves deals forward

• Delivering demos tailored to each buyer, including technical stakeholders

• Hitting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for pipeline generation, activities and closed revenue

• Keeping HubSpot up to date for accurate forecasting

What are we looking for?

• At least 2 to 3 years in a closing role running a full outbound sales cycle with a track record of closing high-volume SMB deals

• A strong outbound background, ideally as a BDR or SDR - you’re comfortable picking up the phone 50+ times a day and know how to hook a prospect in the first 30 seconds

• SaaS sales experience is a must - you know what an API is and can hold your own in a conversation with a technical buyer

• Consistent quota attainment and overachievement

• A hunter mindset and the ownership to build your own pipeline and drive your own metrics

• Sharp, instinctive discovery skills - you can uncover pain efficiently

• Curiosity and the drive to become a product expert, so every conversation is relevant and consultative

• Fluency in English

• Familiarity with HubSpot is a nice to have

• Genuine excitement for what Prelude is building

What do we offer?

• Competitive base salary with uncapped commission + BSPCEs

• Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office in Paris, 1 day remote

• High-end gear and ergonomic setup

• 100% travel subsidised to our Paris office

• Private health insurance

• Swile meal vouchers

• The opportunity to be part of building something big, from the start!

Interview process

• Interview with Hiring Manager

• Role-play session with Sales

• Final meeting with the CEO

We care about your potential and motivation. If you're excited about the role and this sounds like your next step, we’d love to hear from you

Zefir is hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product and Ops, and the Talent team is the engine behind it. We are looking for a freelance SDR to join the team, learn sourcing from our Founding Talent Lead, and run our AI recruiting workflows every day.
Think outbound prospecting, except your leads are candidates.

Build and improve our AI recruiting workflows | About 30% of your time
Help shape how Zefir uses AI to find, assess and engage talent. Work with our Talent Lead to turn ideas into working automations, test them on real recruiting needs, and improve them through daily use.

• Build and experiment. Create and adapt workflows for candidate sourcing, scoring, outreach and recruiting dashboards.

• Test, learn, iterate. Try different prompts and approaches, review the results, and refine what works.

• Bring your recruiting judgment. Check AI recommendations against real candidate profiles and use what you learn to improve the next batch.

• Make the system better every day. Debug issues, remove repetitive steps, and spot opportunities to automate more of the groundwork.

Source candidates for our open roles | About 70% of your time

• Source profiles for open roles from the scorecard and the hiring manager brief.

• Expand the pool: past Ashby candidates, LinkedIn Recruiter, target companies.

• Add qualified leads to Ashby with a one-line rationale and prepare outreach drafts in Zefir's voice.

 
What You Bring

• A junior profile with a sharp, structured mind: you learn fast.

• A strong general education. No hard skills required.

• A first experience as an SDR or BDR (ideally in a B2B startup) is a plus. We are not looking for a cold-calling specialist, but for someone who can run written outbound at volume: LinkedIn and email sequences, follow-ups, a clean CRM.

• No recruiting experience needed: our Talent Lead trains you on sourcing during your first weeks.

• You are comfortable with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier, n8n…).

• You are rigorous with data, and you look for the cause of an error before escalating.

• Strong writing in French, working English.

• Freelance status, or ready to set one up.

 
Process

• Healthcare plan : Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

• Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement) : With flexible remote work options.

• Swile meal card : €11 per worked day.

• Swile mobility card : €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

• Team events : Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles
🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.
🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.
🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

arbeitnow:brand-director-paris-308346.title: Brand Director
arbeitnow:brand-director-paris-308346.description:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.

We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.

You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

• Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

• Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

• Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

• Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

• Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

• Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

• Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

• A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

• Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

• Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

• Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

• Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

• Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

• You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

• You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

• You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

• You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

• You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

• We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

• We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

• We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

• Health care (100% coverage).

• Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

• Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

• 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

• 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

• ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in the summer and one week in the winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). This enables everyone to actually disconnect and enjoy their vacation. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Per French standard, we also offer another 4 weeks to allow team members to choose when they want to take time off.

How to apply:

Send us your CV and a portfolio, plus one thing you'd rewrite on our website or in our app, and why. Keep it short. We'll know.

arbeitnow:legal-counsel-employment-paris.description:
Company Description
We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Please apply with a CV in the English Language. This is a Paris-based role with global reach and therefore Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) is important.

Role Summary
Checkout.com is seeking a talented and dynamic Legal Counsel with a strong French employment law background to join our Employment Legal team. This role will involve advising on the full spectrum of employment law issues across our French business and supporting broader global employment law initiatives, especially across other EMEA jurisdictions.
You will work closely with our People Team and key business stakeholders in France and internationally. This is a great opportunity to support and develop our French employment legal strategy while collaborating as part of a global team supporting employees across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You will take a consultative and commercial approach to handling complex Labor Code compliance matters, works council (CSE) consultations, litigation, employee relations, and strategic projects across France. You’ll also advise on individual and collective dismissals, restructurings, settlement negotiations, performance management, misconduct investigations and HR audits. You’ll monitor legal and regulatory developments across EMEA and provide proactive guidance on emerging risks and legal requirements. You’ll also help the employment legal team develop scalable processes, templates, and compliance frameworks, including through the use of AI tools.
You will be able to handle multiple areas of responsibilities autonomously, demonstrating excellent critical judgment with hands-on approach. You will report into our Associate General Counsel (Head of Employment) based in London. You will also work closely with the regional People Team leads, based in France and other EMEA jurisdictions.
You will be joining a high-achieving legal team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be the best legal team in the world, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

Essential Qualifications:

• French qualified lawyer (Avocat admitted to the French Bar or Master 2 in French Employment Law / Droit du Travail)

• 5+ years experience specializing in French employment law, either in a reputable law firm or in-house

• Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex legal issues clearly to non-French leadership.

• Within a commutable distance from our Paris office and comfortable working in the office as necessary under our hybrid working policy (currently three days per week on scheduled office days).

Strong candidates will demonstrate the following:

• Experience as in-house employment counsel, ideally in a large global business headquartered outside of France.

• Extensive experience managing CSE consultations, collective negotiations, restructurings, and pre-litigation/settlement strategy in France.

• Work with a high-growth technology or another fast-paced company.

• Exceptional analytical and writing skills, with a business-centric focus on risk.

• Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands.

• Enthusiasm for new challenges and working with a range of different stakeholders.

• Be a systemic thinker with proven abilities for process improvement and simplification, including AI.

• Comfortable with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture.

Role Type and Location
This is a permanent and full-time role based in Paris. Under our current hybrid working policy, office attendance is mandatory on 3 days per week.
Additional Information
If you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please apply anyway. We're always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.
We believe in equal opportunities
We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.
Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.
When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.
We want to set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. We’ll be happy to support you.

Additional Information
Bring all of you to work
We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com
We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

arbeitnow:capital-account-manager-paris-.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!
At Lightspeed Commerce, we believe exceptional teams are built from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities often apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If you are excited about this role and feel you can make an impact (even if your experience does not align perfectly with every bullet point), we encourage you to apply.
About the Role
We are looking for an Account Manager, Capital based in Paris to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you will partner directly with a dedicated portfolio of hospitality merchants, acting as a trusted advisor to help them scale and streamline their operations using Lightspeed Capital.
What You’ll Do

• Drive Merchant Growth: Partner with hospitality merchants across your portfolio to understand their financial needs and present Lightspeed Capital solutions effectively.

• Build Strategic Relationships: Serve as a trusted consultative partner, identifying financing opportunities that align with your merchants' long-term business goals.

• Manage Deal Cycles: Lead discussions, negotiate agreements, and close financial contracts to support portfolio retention and growth.

• Collaborate for Territory Success: Work closely with regional leadership to identify expansion opportunities and meet regional goals.

What You Bring

• B2B Account Management or Sales Experience: Proven experience managing client relationships, driving pipeline, and closing agreements. Fintech, SaaS, or financial services experience is a strong asset, but transferable consultative sales experience is welcome.

• Consultative Communication: Ability to articulate financial concepts clearly and build rapport with merchant owners and executive stakeholders.

• Growth Mindset: Comfort working in a fast-paced environment, taking initiative, and incorporating feedback to develop your craft.

• Bilingual Fluency: Fluent professional proficiency in both French and English (written and verbal).

Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

• Familiarity with the hospitality or restaurant industry.

• Exposure to SaaS, payments, or banking/lending products.

• Hands-on experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce.

What’s in it for you?
Come live the Lightspeed experience...

• Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

• Unlock your potential with our growth program, paving the way for promotions and career advancement;

• Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

• Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

• Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

• Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

• Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

• Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

• Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office

• Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office

• Health insurance with attractive guarantee plan

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?
Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .
Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:
Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.
Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.
Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement .

Data & Systèmes d’information

o Extraire et exploiter les données issues des applications métier (ERP, PLM, PIM, CMS, e-com, B2B, POS).

BI & Analytics

o Comprendre les besoins des équipes opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions techniques.
