arbeitnow:software-engineer-intern-ads-p.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers:

• 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

• 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

• 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

• ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

• 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

• 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

• 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

• 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

• 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll join one of the Mirakl Labs Ads teams for a six-month internship starting in January or February 2027 , based in Paris or Bordeaux . You'll be part of a cross-functional Squad made up of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers, and a QA Engineer.

2. Your Impact

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of an AI agent that autonomously generates and executes test scenarios, covering new feature validation, regression testing, and exploratory testing.

• Help design, write, and run test cases to evaluate the agent's performance.

• Explore different technical approaches and contribute to benchmarking their results.

• Work under the guidance of experienced engineers and QA team members

• Contribute to the project using existing programming skills

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

• Currently pursuing a degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field (engineering school, university, or career change), and looking for a 6-month internship

• First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project

• Good understanding of a programming language

• Proficient in working with LLMs and developing skills and/or agents

• Appreciation for software quality best practices: testing, clean code, design patterns

• Strong team player with a genuine enthusiasm for knowledge sharing and problem-solving

4. Tech Stack

• Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot

• Front-end: ReactJS

• Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL

• Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring

5. Languages

• French: Fluent

• English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

• Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

• Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter , then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma , Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.

• Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl

• Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion

• STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. arbeitnow:mid-market-account-executive-f.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
arbeitnow:mid-market-account-executive-f.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

• Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.

• Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.

• Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

• Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

• The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.

• Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.

• Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.

• Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

• Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.

• A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.

• A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

• Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

arbeitnow:engineering-manager-france-194.description:
Engineering Manager
Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:
Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.
What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.
Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:
You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.
As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.
You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.
This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do:
People Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development.

• Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work.

• Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges.

Hiring & Team Growth

• Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions.

• Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly.

• Partner with engineering leadership to shape team structure, squad ownership, and hiring priorities as the organization scales.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

• Partner with Product Managers to translate product and business priorities into clear engineering objectives, realistic roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

• Own engineering delivery across your squads, ensuring work is appropriately scoped, estimated, and delivered with clear accountability.

• Identify and manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed and addressing blockers early.

Engineering Processes & Continuous Improvement

• Own and continuously improve how your squads operate, using our Discovery → Run lifecycle, inspired by Shape Up, and DORA metrics to measure delivery effectiveness.

• Establish practical, scalable ways of working that improve predictability, collaboration, and engineering quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and the VP of Engineering to evaluate and improve engineering processes across the wider organization.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Provide technical guidance on architectural decisions, engineering trade-offs, and complex delivery challenges, ensuring teams make well-informed decisions.

• Work closely with Product, Design, Support, Sales, and leadership to align engineering priorities with business needs.

• Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, creating transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders.

Our Tech Stack
Our backend is built in Go (Golang) , with Svelte on the frontend, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch for data, and DigitalOcean for cloud infrastructure. We use Docker , GitHub Actions , and Grafana to support deployment, automation, and observability, with a modular hexagonal monolith architecture.
You won't need to be hands-on with every technology, but you'll bring the technical understanding to challenge architectural decisions, navigate trade-offs, and support your engineers in solving complex problems.

What Success Looks Like:
By 3 months

• You've built a strong understanding of our product, technology, engineering processes, and business objectives, establishing trusted relationships with your engineers and key stakeholders.

• You've taken ownership of people management across your squads, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and an understanding of each engineer's strengths and development needs.

• You've assessed current delivery practices, team structure, and performance, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, predictability, and team effectiveness.

By 6 months

• Your squads are operating with clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable KPIs aligned with product and business priorities.

• You've established effective delivery practices, with more predictable planning, proactive risk management, and improved visibility for stakeholders.

• You've identified team capability gaps and are actively contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the development of engineers across your squads.

• You're contributing meaningful improvements to engineering processes and organizational structure alongside the wider engineering management team.

By 12 months

• Your squads consistently deliver against realistic, well-defined roadmaps, with clear accountability, effective collaboration, and measurable improvements in delivery performance.

• Engineers have clear development paths, receive regular feedback, and feel supported in their growth, contributing to strong engagement and retention.

• New engineers are onboarding efficiently and becoming productive quickly, supported by established processes and a clear engineering hiring bar.

• You've helped shape a scalable engineering organization with well-defined squad ownership, effective ways of working, and stronger alignment between Engineering, Product, and the wider business.

• Stakeholders have confidence in engineering delivery, with transparent communication, reliable planning, and fewer unexpected blockers.

What We're Looking For:

• Proven experience directly managing and developing software engineers, ideally eight or more across multiple teams, within a growing engineering organization.

• Demonstrated experience building or scaling engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and supporting engineers' career development.

• A strong software engineering background with solid architectural fundamentals, enabling you to challenge technical decisions, understand trade-offs, and provide credible guidance.

• Experience owning engineering delivery, translating product and business objectives into actionable plans, managing dependencies, and driving measurable outcomes.

• A data-driven approach to engineering management, with experience using delivery metrics and team performance insights to identify and implement improvements.

• The ability to establish effective engineering processes and ways of working that improve team performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

• Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the confidence to create structure, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions in a scaling environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively across distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

• Experience working with Go (Golang) or managing teams building Go-based applications.

• Familiarity with Shape Up or similar appetite-driven development methodologies.

• Experience using DORA metrics to measure and improve engineering delivery.

• Knowledge of Team Topologies and experience shaping squad structures as engineering teams s

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:
You'll be joining as our Cybersecurity Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.
At FullEnrich, security and privacy aren't just compliance requirements; they're fundamental to our product and the trust our customers place in us. As we scale, we're looking for someone to take ownership of our security, compliance, and corporate IT programs, ensuring we continue to protect our customers, strengthen our infrastructure, and meet the expectations of increasingly sophisticated enterprise clients.
As our first dedicated security and IT hire, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up. You'll own our security strategy and compliance roadmap, working closely with Engineering, leadership, and teams across the business to implement practical, scalable controls. Our engineers build and operate the platform, while you'll define, oversee, and continuously improve the security measures that protect it.
We're already SOC 2 compliant, with ISO 27001 and additional certifications on the horizon. Operating across multiple regions and working with 20+ data providers also brings interesting challenges around data privacy, vendor security, and international regulations.
This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, direct exposure to leadership, and the opportunity to build a security function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do:
Security & Infrastructure

• Own and continuously improve our application and infrastructure security posture, partnering with Engineering to implement and maintain effective security controls.

• Lead our vulnerability management program, including external penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and remediation tracking.

• Identify, assess, and prioritize security risks, ensuring vulnerabilities are addressed based on their potential business impact.

Compliance & Certifications

• Own our security compliance program end to end, maintaining SOC 2 and leading future certifications such as ISO 27001.

• Manage ongoing evidence collection, auditor relationships, control assessments, and remediation activities.

• Develop and maintain a scalable compliance roadmap aligned with business growth and customer requirements.

Security Governance & Risk Management

• Develop and maintain security policies, risk assessments, and our company-wide risk register.

• Lead regular access reviews, security awareness initiatives, and incident response preparedness.

• Coordinate security incidents and drive continuous improvements to our security processes and controls.

Corporate IT & Identity Management

• Own our corporate IT security framework, including device management (MDM), identity providers, SSO, and SaaS access controls.

• Oversee secure employee onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, and hardware inventory management, working with our operational IT team on execution.

• Improve and automate IT security processes to ensure they remain reliable and scalable as the company grows.

Data Privacy & Vendor Security

• Oversee privacy operations, including data subject requests, vendor data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

• Ensure our practices align with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and US state privacy laws, coordinating with our DPO and relevant stakeholders.

• Build and maintain a risk-based vendor security assessment process across our data providers and wider SaaS ecosystem.

Customer Trust & Enterprise Security

• Own the security due diligence process for enterprise customers, including questionnaires, audits, and security reviews.

• Maintain our customer-facing security documentation, trust page, and audit report distribution.

• Partner with Sales and leadership to turn security and compliance into a competitive advantage, helping customers move through procurement and security reviews with confidence.

What Success Looks Like:
By 3 months

• You've taken full ownership of our existing SOC 2 compliance program, with evidence collection, control monitoring, and auditor coordination running smoothly.

• You've assessed our current security posture, completed an initial risk assessment, and identified the highest-priority improvements across infrastructure, corporate IT, and identity management.

• You've established an effective process for handling enterprise security questionnaires and customer due diligence, with turnaround times measured in days rather than weeks.

• You've developed an initial 12-month security roadmap covering remediation priorities, penetration testing, incident response, and future certifications.

By 6 months

• You've implemented improvements to our highest-priority security and IT controls, including identity management, endpoint security, and access governance.

• You've established a repeatable vulnerability management process, with penetration testing completed or underway and remediation tracked through to resolution.

• You've strengthened our incident response readiness through documented procedures and a tabletop exercise.

• You've implemented consistent processes for vendor security reviews and privacy operations, ensuring risks are assessed and regulatory obligations are managed effectively.

By 12 months

• Our SOC 2 compliance program is operating as a continuous, audit-ready process, with renewals running smoothly and minimal disruption to the wider business.

• You've made measurable progress against our security roadmap, including advancing ISO 27001 or other certifications agreed with leadership.

• Our corporate IT and security processes are reliable, scalable, and embedded into everyday operations.

• Security is actively supporting business growth, with faster enterprise due diligence, stronger customer confidence, and fewer security-related obstacles in the sales process.

What We're Looking For:

• Proven experience owning a security and compliance program end to end, including SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, auditor management, evidence collection, and control remediation.

• Strong understanding of application and cloud infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering teams to identify risks and implement practical controls.

• Hands-on experience with corporate IT security, including MDM, identity providers, SSO/SCIM, SaaS access management, and employee lifecycle processes.

• Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations, particularly GDPR, and experience navigating international data protection requirements and cross-border transfers.

• Experience managing security governance processes, including risk assessments, vulnerability management, incident response, and security policies.

• A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence to work across technical and non-technical teams, engage with auditors, and represent security in enterprise customer discussions.

Nice to Haves

• Experience working in a data-heavy or API-first SaaS business, particularly data enrichment, data brokerage, or similar industries.

• Security management certifications such as CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) or equivalent.

• Experience working as, or closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer (DPO).

• Experience supporting enterprise sales processes through security due diligence and customer-facing security reviews.

• French language skills or proficiency in another European language.

The Hiring Process:

• Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

• Practical case on a real security & compliance scenario from our world (1 hr) – A chanc

arbeitnow:mobile-paid-acquisition-expert.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Paid Acquisition Expert to build Qonto’s mobile app acquisition strategy and establish expertise we don’t yet have in-house.
Reporting to Alicia Dassance , you will work closely with our Global Expertise team. You’ll combine hands-on campaign work across the App Store and Google Play Store with the strategic view needed to decide what we bring in-house, test what works, and scale it across markets.

➡️ What you’ll do

• Set Qonto’s cross-market mobile app acquisition strategy, and build the internal capability to run it

• Test and improve App Store and Google Play pages: wording, visuals, conversion

• Support the local paid managers in building the global strategy and driving optimisations across Apple Search Ads, Google UAC, Snapchat and push — with TikTok and Meta in scope

• Bring mobile acquisition in-house, taking over work currently handled by an external agency

• Partner with local market teams, creative, GrowthOps, engineering and measurement to get changes shipped

➡️ What we’re looking for

• Relevant experience: you bring hands-on mobile app acquisition experience (around 5 years in the domain) and can speak to your own scope, decisions and results.

• Builder mindset: you’ve set up something that didn’t exist before. You decide what to prioritise, build the operating approach, and learn by testing rather than waiting for certainty.

• Platform and channel expertise: you run acquisition across Apple Search Ads, Google UAC and paid social, and improve App Store and Google Play pages through structured testing of wording and visuals.

• Measurement fluency: you work confidently with MMPs such as Adjust, with ATT/SKAN, and with the consent and data-sharing constraints that shape what you can measure and decide.

• B2B context: B2B acquisition experience is a plus — strong B2C profiles remain in scope if you’re curious about how the model changes.

➡️ What we can offer you

• Ownership from day one: you define the strategy, the routines and the testing roadmap for a capability that doesn’t exist yet in-house.

• Investment behind it: mobile acquisition is a 2027 focus at Qonto and budgets are set to grow.

• Cross-market scope: you sit in the Global Expertise group and work across Western and Central Europe, rather than owning a single market.

➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Alicia , our Performance Marketing Global Expert.

• Her path? Alicia has built a part of her performance marketing career at Qonto — six and a half years, from Display Ads Manager to to Performance Marketing Global Expert. She has held local and more operational roles in the past, and knows the channels from the inside.

• What does she bring to the team? Alicia brings deep hands-on paid acquisition and performance expertise, and a rare understanding of how Qonto’s markets, channels and growth levers actually fit together.

[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. 

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

Remote from Switzerland

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.
  • Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity

We’re hiring our first Founding Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

This role will be remote from Switzerland. 

How you will make an impact

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.
  • Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.
  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.
  • Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.
  • Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.
  • Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.
  • Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.
  • Business-fluent German: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in German. 
  • Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.
  • Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.
  • Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.
  • Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.
  • Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.
  • Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

  • Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.
  • Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.
  • Approximately 65% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Reporting structure

You’ll report directly to our VP of Global Revenue, for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion and will participate in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process

  • Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins
  • Deal Review - 30 mins
  • Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins
  • Final Interview - ~2.5 hours
  • Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation

The estimated compensation range for this role is 280-340k CHF OTE, 50/50 split, depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

 

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

  • 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
  • ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 
  • ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

  • 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
  • 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
  • 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees
  • 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 
  • 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees

  • 🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office

  • ✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely
  • 🥤 Monthly happy hours
  • 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

arbeitnow:clinical-solutions-consultant-.title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
arbeitnow:clinical-solutions-consultant-.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.
Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.
Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.
Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.
You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.
This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.
You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

• Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

• Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

• Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

• Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

• Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

• Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

• Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

• Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

• Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

• Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

• Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

• Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

• Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

• Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

• Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

• Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

• Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

• Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

• Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

• Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

• Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

• Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

• Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

• Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

• Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

• Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

• In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

• Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

• Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

• Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

• Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

• Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

Für das dafür obligatorische, einjährige Zusatzmodul (Praktikumsjahr) suchen wir motivierte Nachwuchstalente: Wenn du praxisnah lernen möchtest, wie moderne ambulante Beratungen funktionieren, und wertvolle Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von persönlicher Patient*innenbetreuung und zukunftsweisender Digital Health sammeln willst, ist unser Graduate-Internship genau das Richtige für dich.
Für unser Oviva-Team in der Schweiz suchen wir dich per Oktober 2027 als Des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc .

Warum Oviva?
Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.
Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.
Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich
Als Graduate / des. Ernährungsberater*in machst du dich Schritt für Schritt mit dem Arbeitsalltag einer Fachperson im ambulanten Beratungssetting vertraut und baust deine Handlungskompetenz kontinuierlich auf:

• Ambulante Ernährungstherapie: Du führst Beratungen von Erwachsenen, Kindern und Jugendlichen durch – zunächst eng begleitet vor Ort in unseren Partnerpraxen und digital, später eigenständig mit Vor- und Nachbesprechungen (Praxisauslastung ca. 1–4 Beratungen pro Halbtag).

• Zuweisermanagement & Vernetzung: Du arbeitest interprofessionell mit Ärzt*innen sowie medizinischem Praxispersonal zusammen, stärkst Beziehungen und unterstützt bei der Gewinnung und Entwicklung regionaler Partnerpraxen.

• Wissensvermittlung: Du konzipierst und führst Fachwebinare (z. B. für MPA) durch und hältst praxisnahe Vorträge an Fachveranstaltungen sowie internen Weiterbildungen.

• Qualität & Projekte: Du erstellst und überarbeitest hochwertige Beratungshilfsmittel, nimmst regelmässig an internen Fallbesprechungen teil und unterstützt bei regionalen Marketingprojekten.

• Office-Präsenz: Jeden Mittwoch bist du vor Ort in unserem Büro in Zürich präsent, tauschst dich mit anderen Graduates aus und vertiefst dein Netzwerk.

Das bringst du mit

• Ausbildung: Du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss deines Bachelorstudiums (des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc) an einer Fachhochschule (z. B. BFH) in Ernährung und Diätetik.

• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbständig, flexibel und bist top organisiert.

• Begeisterung: Du hast Freude an der persönlichen sowie digitalen Patient*innenbegleitung und bist offen für unterschiedliche Fach- und Indikationsgebiete.

• Standort-Flexibilität: Du arbeitest flexibel im Homeoffice sowie digital, bist jedoch jeden Mittwoch verbindlich vor Ort in unserem Office in Zürich.

• Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir voraus; gute Englischkenntnisse sowie weitere Sprachen sind ein grosses Plus.

Deine Benefits bei Oviva

• Strukturierter Berufseinstieg: Ein massgeschneidertes Graduate-Programm mit gezielter Einarbeitung, Supervision und enger Begleitung auf dem Weg in die selbständige Beratung.

• Vergütung & Spesen (Basis 100 % Pensum):

• Grundgehalt: CHF 2'525.– pro Monat

• Feste Spesenpauschalen: CHF 225.– Monatsspesen, CHF 30.– Telekommunikation sowie CHF 137.50 Reisespesen-Zusatz für Graduates

Unser Praktikum findet in der Regel mit einem Pensum von 80 % statt.

• Modernste Arbeitsmittel: Eine eigenentwickelte, innovative App und Beratungssoftware, die administrative Abläufe erleichtert.

• Teamkultur & Vernetzung: Ein dynamisches, interdisziplinäres Team, in dem Wissen geteilt und Erfolge gemeinsam gefeiert werden.

• Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Eine Unternehmenskultur, bei der Patient*innenzufriedenheit und Behandlungsqualität an erster Stelle stehen.

(a) = alle: Vielfalt ist uns wichtig.
Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.
Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

arbeitnow:ingenieur-securite-des-procede.description:
📜 Contexte
Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.
Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.
Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.
📌 Votre rôle
En tant qu' Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés , vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.
Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.
Vos missions
🎯 Responsabilités
🔹 Analyse des risques procédés
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA .
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.
🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1 .
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.
🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.
🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) .
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.
🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques .
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

About the role
Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.
We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).
You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

• Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

• Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

• Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

• Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

• Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

• Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

• Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

• As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

• Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

• Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

• Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

• Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

• Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

• Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

• Has built or set up an AML function or framework

• Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

• Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

• Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

• Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

• Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

• Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

• Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

• Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

• Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

• Pension Plan

• Daily Sickness Benefits

arbeitnow:homologation-certification-eng.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
arbeitnow:homologation-certification-eng.description:
About EH Energy Engineering
EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.
To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.
This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate .
 
Key responsibilities
Certification strategy and project management

• Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

• Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

• Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

• Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

• Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

• Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

• Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

• Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

• Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

• Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

• Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

• Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

• Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope
The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

• IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
 

Required qualifications

• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

• 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

• Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

• Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

• Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

• Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

• Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

• Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

• Fluent English, written and spoken
 

Preferred qualifications and personal profile
Nice to have

• Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

• Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

• Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

• Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

• Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

• Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

• Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

• Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end
 

Start date: Immediately

arbeitnow:senior-stack-scientist-nyon-50.description:
Senior Stack Scientist
About EH Energy Engineering
EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.
As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

• Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

• Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

• Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

• Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

• Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

• Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

• Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

• PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

• 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

• Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

• Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

• Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

• Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

• Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

• Management experience

• English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. • Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

We strive to achieve this by offering:

• 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role

• UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes)

Nice to have:

• Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.
 
About the role:
DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.
We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.
This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.

What you’ll be doing

• Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

• Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

• Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

• Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

• Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

• Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

• Create, monitor, and analyze product marketing performance metrics to guide strategic actions.

• Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making

What we are looking for

• 3+ years of product marketing experience, in the B2B SaaS or technology space (legal tech strongly preferred but will consider experience within complex data/AI enterprise software space)

• Overall 5-8 years of experience as product marketer, marketing solutions, product management or product strategy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. Writing experience is important (share your portfolio or submit a writing sample with your application)

• Comfortable with user data and have experience in industry and customer research

• Translate data into actionable insights, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment, managing multiple priorities with attention to detail

• Analytical data-driven mindset, but orientation towards getting things done quickly and efficiently

• Ideally, experience collaborating with Marketing on account-based and content strategies

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

What you can look forward to

• You will be able to take on full ownership of your projects and tasks from day 1

• You will have a stake in shaping the future of a high-impact, high-growth deep-tech startup

• Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.
