We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟
We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.
Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.
This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

• You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

• You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

• You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

• AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.
WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀
Lead the Hub Model

• Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

• Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

• Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

• Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

• Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

• Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

• Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

• Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads
Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

• Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

• Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

• People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

• Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

• Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.
Build the Team

• Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

• You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

• Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

• Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

• Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

• Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

• Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

• Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

• Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

• Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

• Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

• Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

• Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

• Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

• Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

• AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

• Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥
Experience & Background

• 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

• Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

• Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

• Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

• Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

• Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

• Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

• AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

• Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

• Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

• Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

• Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗
Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

• 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

• 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

• 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

• 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

• 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

• 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

arbeitnow:senior-propulsion-engineer-ele.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
arbeitnow:senior-propulsion-engineer-ele.description:
Your Mission:
As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.
Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.
As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.
 
Your Day-to-Day:

• Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

• Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

• Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

• Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

• Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

• Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

• Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

• Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

• Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

• Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

• Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 
Your Profile:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

• At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

• Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

• Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

• Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

• Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

• A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

• Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

• Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

• Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

• Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

• Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

• Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

• Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

• Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

• Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.
 
Why us?

• Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

• We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

• Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

• Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

Your Mission:
As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.
You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.
The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.
 
Your Day-to-Day:

• Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

• Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

• Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

• Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

• Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

• Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

• Perform engineering assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

• Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

• Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

• Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 
Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design engineering role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

• Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

• Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft powerplant systems. Experience with electric aviation or electric propulsion systems is an asset.

• Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

• Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

• Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

• Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing functional, structural, environmental, certification, manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

• Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach and attention to detail.

• A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

• Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

• Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-clima.title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-clima.description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.
  • Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.
  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

You Will

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.
  • Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.
  • Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
  • Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
  • Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
  • A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
  • The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
  • A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
  • An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.

Nice to Have

  • A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
  • Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

  • Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.
  • You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.
  • We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.
  • In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.
  • Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.

What’s in It for You?

  • Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.
  • The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.
  • Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.
  • Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.
  • Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.
  • Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

arbeitnow:triage-audicien-drachten-fries.title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
arbeitnow:triage-audicien-drachten-fries.description:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

arbeitnow:platform-engineer-amsterdam-17.title: Platform Engineer
arbeitnow:platform-engineer-amsterdam-17.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
  • Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
  • Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
  • Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

  • Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
  • Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
  • Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
  • Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

  • We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
  • We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
  • We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.
This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

arbeitnow:software-engineer-database-ams.title: Software Engineer - Database
arbeitnow:software-engineer-database-ams.description:
About MotherDuck
Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck , we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do
The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.
Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.
This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

• Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

• Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

• Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

• Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

• Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

• Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

• Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

• Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

• You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

• You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

• A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

• Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

• You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

• You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

• You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

• You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

• You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

• The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

• Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

• Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

• A good pension plan

• Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

• Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. arbeitnow:product-owner-gemeentepas-goud.description:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet
Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.
In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.
Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.
Wat doe je nog meer?

• Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

• Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

• Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

• Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

• Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

• Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

• Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

• Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je
Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

• Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

• Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

• Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

• 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

• Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

• Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

• Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

• Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

• Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

• Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

• Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee
Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

• Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

• Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

• Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

• Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.
Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.
Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of
Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

arbeitnow:stage-duurzame-en-innovatieve-.title: Stage duurzame en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen voor betonconstructies
arbeitnow:stage-duurzame-en-innovatieve-.description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer.
Hoe maak je een betonconstructie duurzamer, zonder in te leveren op veiligheid en kwaliteit? Tijdens deze stage bij Dura Vermeer Divisie Infra onderzoek jij welke materialen daaraan kunnen bijdragen. Je combineert constructieve berekeningen met duurzaamheid en ontdekt hoe we materiaalkeuzes maken voor infraprojecten. Volg jij een technische hbo- of wo-opleiding en zoek je een meewerk- of afstudeerstage? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Dit wordt jouw stage
Voor betonconstructies komen steeds meer nieuwe materiaaloplossingen beschikbaar. Maar een materiaal met een lagere milieu-impact is niet automatisch voor iedere toepassing de beste keuze. Ook de sterkte, kosten en verwerking op de bouwplaats tellen mee. Hoe vergelijk je die oplossingen op een eerlijke manier? Dat ga jij onderzoeken.

Samen met je begeleider kies je een betonconstructie die als basis dient voor jouw onderzoek. Je onderzoekt hoe verschillende materiaaloplossingen aan dezelfde technische eisen kunnen voldoen. Vervolgens vergelijk je de oplossingen op technische prestaties, milieu-impact, kosten en praktische toepasbaarheid.

Afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen ga je aan de slag met:

• Het kiezen van een geschikte betonconstructie en het vaststellen van de eisen waaraan deze moet voldoen.

• Het verzamelen van informatie over bestaande en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen.

• Het uitwerken van materiaalvarianten en het maken van constructieve berekeningen.

• Het vergelijken van de varianten: wat zijn de voordelen, beperkingen en aandachtspunten?

• Het vertalen van jouw resultaten naar een advies voor onze collega’s.

Je legt je aanpak, berekeningen en conclusies vast in een rapport en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team. Daarmee help je onze collega’s om beter onderbouwde materiaalkeuzes te maken.

Je staat er tijdens je onderzoek niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met constructeurs, ontwerpers en duurzaamheidsadviseurs en krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Zo leer je hoe constructief ontwerp en duurzaamheid in de praktijk samenkomen. Samen stemmen we de invulling en diepgang van de opdracht af op jouw opleiding en op de eisen van je meewerk- of afstudeerstage.

Bij ons breng je ook je eigen kennis en ideeën in. Je krijgt ruimte om vragen te stellen, initiatief te nemen en te ontdekken waar jouw interesses liggen. Zo maak je niet alleen meer van je studie, maar ook meer carrière.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.
Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Dit breng jij mee

• Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Constructieve Techniek, Structural Engineering, Built Environment met een constructieve specialisatie of een soort gelijke opleiding;

• Je bent op zoek naar een stage voor minimaal vier dagen per week;

• Je bent proactief en durft vragen te stellen;

• Je bent analytisch, kritisch en onderzoekend;

• Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van betonconstructies en constructieve berekeningen;

• Je hebt interesse in innovatieve materialen en duurzaamheid.

Dit bieden wij jou

• Een mooie stagevergoeding van € 700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week;

• Bouw mee aan je toekomst: je stage is het perfecte startpunt om door te stromen naar een traineeship of startersbaan binnen Dura Vermeer;

• Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je eigen initiatieven te laten horen;

• Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

• Goede begeleiding van een ervaren collega of manager in jouw vakgebied. Je werkt tijdens je stage samen met fijne collega's die zorgen voor een leuke en professionele werksfeer;

• Stage lopen én plezier maken: van kennismaking op de introductiedag tot leuke activiteiten en projectbezoeken met collega’s en medestagiaires.

Wil jij ook meer uit je stage halen?
Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Solliciteer direct via onze website met de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature (niet per e-mail).
Geef in jouw motivatiebrief duidelijk aan welke richting jou aanspreekt en wanneer je gewenste start- en einddatum is . Op die manier kunnen wij jou optimaal helpen.

Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Neem dan contact op met onze campus recruiter Daphne Hund. Je kunt haar een WhatsApp-bericht sturen via 06 1333 63 81.

Waar wacht je nog op? Grijp deze kans en solliciteer vandaag nog!

We focussen op waardecreatie en leefkwaliteit voor een duurzame samenleving op weg naar een circulaire economie. Zie voor meer projecten: www.studiosk.nl .

arbeitnow:internship-explainable-ai-for-.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
arbeitnow:internship-explainable-ai-for-.description:
Background
Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment
The assignment will include the following tasks:

• A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

• A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

• Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

• Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results
The final outcomes of this assignment will be:
§ A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.
§ An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.
§ A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration
For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

• You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

• You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

• You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

• You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

• A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

• Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

• An internship allowance

• Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

• Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR
Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

Interested?

Im Mittelpunkt stehen anspruchsvolle Bauvorhaben mit Erdarbeiten, befestigten Flächen und der baulichen Gestaltung von Außenbereichen.

Ihre Verantwortung – mehr als klassische Bauleitung

• Projekte erfolgreich abschließen: Sie begleiten Abnahmen und stellen eine strukturierte Übergabe sicher.

Qualifikation

• Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

arbeitnow:senior-product-engineer-softwa.title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
arbeitnow:senior-product-engineer-softwa.description:
Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes.

We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged.

What you’ll build
Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like:
• PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it
• Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time
• Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note
• Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time
• The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day

Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked.

What we expect
• Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them
• Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so
• Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner
• Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it
• Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook
• Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better

How we work
AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you:
• You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI
• You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship
• You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system
• Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance
• You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies
• You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on

Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns.
Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people who answer the phones for our customers. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee.

Who you are
• Senior-level, with significant experience shipping and operating production systems – you’ve been paged for your own code
• A track record of owning projects end to end: from a vague problem statement through delivery to production and iteration
• Used to working cross-functionally with product, design, data, and non-technical stakeholders – and comfortable talking to end users directly
• You think beyond your own code: business context, user needs, and product goals shape what you build
• You take ownership without waiting for instructions, make decisions under ambiguity, and escalate when it matters
• You communicate openly and clearly, in writing and in person, with technical and non-technical people alike
• Our stack is Ruby on Rails, Go, and Dart/Flutter. Deep experience in at least one of these helps; strong fundamentals matter more than any specific language
• Bonus, not required: experience in healthcare, dental, or another regulated domain; or with integrating into legacy on-premise systems

Location, language, and setup
• Location: You live in Germany and can be in our Berlin office regularly. The role is hybrid: 2–3 days a week on site, the rest remote
• German: Business-fluent German (C1 or better) is required. You’ll talk to practices, read PMS vendor documentation, and work with German regulatory and billing concepts daily. Our team language is English
• Eligibility: You already hold the right to work in Germany.
• Working hours: Full-time

Why Roger?
• The opportunity is absurd. A market worth billions that still runs on fax machines and phone tag
• Real leverage. You’ll be one of 6 engineers. Your area is yours – your decisions shape the product, not a committee’s
• Hard, interesting problems in a space most tech companies ignore: legacy integrations, regulated data, real-world workflows with real-world stakes
• Engineers who care about craft. We argue about architecture, not politics
• Compensation: €75,000 – €95,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity participation and benefits: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, 30 days’ vacation and Hrmony (50€ in-kind compensation).

arbeitnow:business-innovation-manager-ai.title: Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) – AI, MarTech & Digital Solutions
arbeitnow:business-innovation-manager-ai.description:
100% remote.
Neue AI-Tools, autonome Agenten, Automatisierungen, neue Plattformen oder smartere Wege, digitales Marketing effizienter zu machen: Wenn Technologie auf Marketing trifft, wirst Du neugierig.
Und noch besser: Du willst nicht nur darüber reden, sondern ausprobieren, bauen und umsetzen.
Wir sind eine unabhängige Digital-Performance-Agentur aus Deutschland und verbinden über 25 Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung mit AI, First-Party Data, eigener Technologie und datengetriebenen Lösungen.
Als Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest Du direkt mit unserem Director of Business Innovation und unserem Innovation-Team zusammen. Ihr identifiziert neue Möglichkeiten, testet Ideen und entwickelt daraus Lösungen, die bei uns und unseren Kunden tatsächlich etwas bewegen.
Kurz gesagt: Du machst aus „Das müsste man mal ausprobieren“ ein „Läuft.“
Dein Spielfeld:

• Du findest heraus, was wirklich Potenzial hat.
Neue AI-Anwendungen, APIs, Plattformen, Automatisierungen oder Entwicklungen im digitalen Marketing: Du behältst den Überblick, probierst Neues aus und bewertest, was für hurra.com und unsere Kunden echten Mehrwert bringt – und was einfach nur der nächste Hype ist.

• Du baust Lösungen statt PowerPoints.
Aus guten Ideen machst Du funktionierende Lösungen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Tools, Automatisierungen und Workflows und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz. Dabei kann es um AI, Data, Search, Media, Content, Analytics oder ganz neue Marketing-Technologien gehen.

• Du sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen auch gut bleiben.
Was funktioniert, wird nicht einfach abgehakt. Du entwickelst bestehende Tools und Anwendungen weiter, machst sie stabiler und skalierbarer und kümmerst Dich darum, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig laufen.

• Du bringst Marketing, Business und Tech zusammen.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Search, Media, Data, Strategy und weiteren Bereichen zusammen. Du verstehst ihre Herausforderungen, übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen und bist Sparringspartner für neue Ideen und deren Machbarkeit.

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

• Du kennst digitales Marketing und denkst technisch.
Du musst nicht in jeder Disziplin Spezialist sein. Aber Du solltest verstehen, wie digitales Marketing funktioniert und Spaß daran haben, es mit Technologie besser zu machen.

• Du baust Dinge, statt nur darüber zu reden.
Du probierst aus, entwickelst Prototypen, verbindest Systeme und schreibst auch mal ein Script. APIs, Automatisierungen, AI-Schnittstellen, LLMs und AI-Agenten sind für Dich keine Buzzwords, sondern Werkzeuge, mit denen Du echte Lösungen baust.

• Du wartest nicht auf das nächste Briefing.
Du erkennst neue Möglichkeiten, entwickelst eigene Ideen und bringst Themen selbstständig voran. Wenn etwas noch keine fertige Lösung hat, wird es für Dich erst interessant.

• Du kannst technische Themen verständlich machen.
Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe – auch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die nicht jeden Tag mit APIs oder AI-Agenten arbeiten. Dafür solltest Du Deutsch verhandlungssicher beherrschen. Gute Englischkenntnisse helfen Dir zusätzlich.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet:

• 100 % remote und flexibel.
Arbeite dort, wo Du am besten arbeitest – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne unnötige Präsenzpflicht.

• Verantwortung statt Micromanagement.
Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Dinge auszuprobieren und Themen gemeinsam mit dem Director of Business Innovation voranzutreiben.

• Eine ziemlich große Spielwiese.
AI, Data, Automatisierung, MarTech, Search, Media, neue Plattformen und eigene Technologien: Dein Themenfeld ist bewusst breit.

• Direkter Weg von der Idee zur Umsetzung.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen. Gute Ideen sollen bei uns nicht in Präsentationen verschwinden, sondern ausprobiert werden.

• Benefits, die zählen.
EGYM Wellpass, Bike-Leasing, moderne technische Ausstattung und ein Team mit ziemlich viel Know-how in Search, Data, Media und Tech.

So einfach bewirbst Du Dich:
Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
Schick uns Deinen CV und ein kurzes Video – zum Beispiel über Loom. In zwei bis drei Minuten würden wir gerne von Dir erfahren:

• Welche Technologie oder welches digitale Marketing-Thema Dich gerade wirklich begeistert

• Was Du zuletzt gebaut, automatisiert, getestet oder verbessert hast

• Wie Du an technische Herausforderungen herangehst, für die es noch keine fertige Lösung gibt

• Was wir unbedingt über Dich wissen sollten

Das Video ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Bewerbung - ohne geht's nicht. Uns interessiert nicht nur, was in Deinem CV steht, sondern auch, wie Du denkst, Probleme angehst und über Technologie sprichst.
Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

arbeitnow:remote-dealer-account-manager-.description:
About AIM Intelligent Machines
AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations.
Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently.
We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships.
 
Position Summary
As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment.
You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems.
 
Key Responsibilities
Channel Partner Management

• Build and grow relationships with channel partners (resellers, OEMs, system integrators) to drive adoption of AIM’s automation platform.

• Enable and train partners to sell AIM solutions focused on multi-machine control and operator augmentation.

• Monitor partner performance and support business planning to meet joint sales targets.

• Identify new partners in strategic markets (construction, mining, landfill and quarry environments.

 
Key Account Management

• Identify and engage high-potential enterprise accounts seeking to modernize heavy equipment operations through automation, specifically in the mining, landfill and quarry markets.

• Understand customer workflows and pain points, and position AIM’s multi-machine control solutions as a strategic advantage.

• Lead the sales process from discovery through close, with support from technical teams.

• Maintain strong post-sale relationships to drive expansion and long-term success.

 
Internal Collaboration

• Work with marketing to create partner- and industry-specific messaging and campaigns.

• Partner with product teams to communicate market feedback and help shape feature development

• Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, and performance metrics.

 
Qualifications & Skills

• 3–7 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel sales—preferably in earthworks tech, industrial ground engagement automation, and heavy machinery.

• Experience selling or supporting technology that transforms field operations or operator workflows.

• Strong understanding of the construction or mining ecosystem—including OEMs, contractors, equipment dealers, and tech providers.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Self-starter with the ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly innovative environment.

• Comfortable with travel (30–50%) to partner/customer sites and industry events.

 
Why Join AIM?

• Solve a massive set of real-world problems that require scalable earth moving

• Accomplish that via deploying and expanding cutting edge tech

• Run your workstreams with the largest degree of autonomy

• Have an opportunity for rapid growth and a large voice on the direction of the company

• Receive company funded medical, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance, gourmet food & perks

• Experience a strong onsite collaboration (AIM offices, labs and proving grounds on the east side of the Greater Seattle area)

• Have an opportunity to travel to unique sites around the world (Americas, Australia, Africa & more)

 
Compensation: $115K – $160K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

arbeitnow:country-manager-germany-shift-.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.
The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.
microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.
We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.
This is an incredible opportunity, to own Shift’s German operation, from business acquisition and data collection through logistics, team-building and delivery.
Requirements

• Strong operational ownership: able to make local decisions, coordinate teams and take responsibility for delivery.

• Ability to win participation from businesses, particularly mid-sized businesses doing skilled, non-domestic tasks.

• Commercial judgment: build a local operation while operating as lean as possible.

• Practical logistics capability: maximise hardware, including distribution, returns, cleaning, uploads and loss prevention.

• Comfort building a team where justified by the economics, while working closely with Shift’s central team.

• Willingness to do hands-on, repetitive operational work, not only strategy or automation.

Who Will Thrive at microagi
Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

• Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

• Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

• Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

• Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

• You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

• You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

• You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

• You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

• You would forward output you cannot explain.

• "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire
We read every application and reply within five working days.

• Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

• Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

• Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

• Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

• Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.
Pay Transparency
Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.
What We Offer

• Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

• Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

• A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

• Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity
microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

About the Team
Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.
The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.
DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.
