Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.
The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.
This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

arbeitnow:remote-customer-success-onboar.title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist (m/w/d) - Germany
arbeitnow:remote-customer-success-onboar.description:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!
 
Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.
 
Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).
In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:
💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.
💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.
🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.
🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!
Deine Mission
Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

• Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

• Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

• Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

• Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

• Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

• Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

• Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

• Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

• Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

• Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

• Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen
🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.
🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.
📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.
🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.
💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.
🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.
 
Wen wir suchen
Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:
- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).
- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.
- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).
- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.
 
Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.
 
Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten
Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren
Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Deine Mission
Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com . Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.
Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben
1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

• Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

• Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

• Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

• Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

• Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

• Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

• Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

• Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

• Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

• Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

• Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

• Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

• Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.
Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com . Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.
Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

• Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

• Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

arbeitnow:ml-researcher-berlin-478768.description:
About Us
Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private and always available on your device.
We’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of on-device AI, from silicon-level optimizations to distributed inference systems.
We’re working on hard problems at the intersection of inference efficiency, model intelligence and autonomous research.

The Role
We’re looking for a Founding ML Researcher to work at the frontier of on-device AI. This role is for someone who identifies problems and potentials, designs and executes experiments and derives insights that translate into real-world performance.
You’ll have significant ownership over our research agenda and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes.

What You’ll Work On

• Inference research : Identifying and validating new approaches to on-device efficiency, including speculative decoding variants, novel quantization schemes and entirely new techniques yet to be discovered

• Model routing research : Building the intelligence that decides how requests are served between on-device vs. frontier API models

• Autoresearch pipelines : Designing systems that can autonomously explore, hypothesize and evaluate research ideas that accelerate our R&D loop

• Evaluations and benchmarks : Developing rigorous evals that measure performance in the real world, outside of clean academic settings

What We’re Looking For

• PhD in ML or equivalent industry research experience

• Deep understanding of LLM architectures and the principles of AI inference

• Expertise in a relevant topic, such as speculative decoding, quantization theory, model distillation, reinforcement learning

• A track record of producing results that people build on: research papers, open-source projects or blog posts that prove out novel ideas

• Good communication: the ability to explain complex ideas simply, give honest feedback and document findings in a reproducible way

• Nice-to-haves:

• Familiarity with GPU and accelerator architectures and kernel optimization (CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Triton, etc.)

• Experience deploying models under on-device constraints (memory bandwidth, latency budgets, and thermal and power ceilings)

What We Offer

• Equity and strong base salary

• Direct influence on technical direction: your ideas will shape the roadmap

• Work on genuinely hard problems that haven't been solved yet

• Small team, fast iteration, low bureaucracy

Location
The team is based in Melbourne and Berlin and works in-person from the office most days. We require strong written and spoken English, since the team collaborates across time zones.

About Nu
Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.
 
Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page
You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools.
As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America.
What you will do

• Design and build core low-level services and distributed runtimes for Nubank’s global data platform, with high fault tolerance, elastic scale and sub-second event availability.

• Lead the design of compute orchestration frameworks on large Kubernetes clusters, improving scheduling throughput and resource utilization for complex data pipelines.

• Design and optimize high-throughput streaming and storage architectures using Apache Kafka and distributed database internals for mission-critical financial workloads.

• Find and remove performance, network and storage bottlenecks across the infrastructure stack to reduce latency.

• Work with Analytics Engineering leads and platform users to define internal APIs, developer toolchains and data modeling practices that speed up developers company-wide.

• Set standards for resilience testing, automated failover, observability and architectural documentation.

What you bring

• Substantial experience designing, scaling and operating mission-critical distributed systems and backend architectures in high-throughput production environments.

• Strong practical knowledge of container orchestration and systems management at scale, ideally Kubernetes internals and custom controllers or operators.

• Advanced proficiency in a systems-oriented language such as Go, Java, Scala, Rust or C++.

• Experience with database system architecture (storage engines, indexing, replication) and/or event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

• A track record of technical leadership: writing design proposals, aligning teams on complex technical decisions, and mentoring engineers.

Nice to have

• Experience building internal developer platforms, custom compute engines or low-level database products.

• Experience with data platforms or compute runtimes that support production AI/ML training and inference.

• Familiarity with multi-region AWS networking, security, IAM and compute.

• Involvement in open-source distributed systems projects (e.g. Kubernetes, Kafka, data orchestration).

What we offer
We offer a competitive base salary in line with market rates, depending on experience and skills, along with:

• Learning and wellness allowance

• Vacations of 28 working days

• Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

• NuLanguage - Our language learning program

• Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

• NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

• Extended maternity and paternity leaves

• Life Insurance and AD&D

• Work-from-home Allowance

• Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model
Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/
Our working language is English.
Equal opportunity
We believe diversity makes our products and our teams better. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Severely disabled applicants with equivalent qualifications will be given preference.
Data protection
Your data is processed by Nubank in line with the GDPR. Details, including retention periods, are in our Candidate Privacy Notice on our careers page.
Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

We are now seeking an experienced, commercially minded resilience management expert who can help clients anticipate, withstand and recover from complex disruptions while also building trusted, long-term client relationships. As the Director you will combine deep expertise in resilience, crisis, business continuity and risk management with the ability to manage existing accounts, and identify new opportunities to sell, originate and grow work in the German market. This role requires an individual with strong social skills, executive presence, a “refuse to lose” attitude, and the confidence to advise boards and senior executives, present ideas in a compelling way and translate complex thinking into clear, persuasive and structured client communications.
Business Development

• Proactively manage accounts, identify prospects, build senior client relationships and generate new business opportunities for Control Risks, with a primary focus on corporate and government accounts throughout Germany.

• Work closely with your advisory & risk consulting team, account managers, Service Line leaders and the Managing Director in a consultative sales capacity, entering client conversations as a subject matter expert, shaping opportunities and helping to close new work.

• Own and deepen relationships with new and existing clients, demonstrating commercial persistence, high social intelligence and a “refuse to lose” approach to winning and retaining work.

• Own and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with clear accountability for converting opportunities into profitable work.

• Develop targeted account plans by identifying the right accounts for Control Risks, prioritising growth accounts of relevant size and potential, mapping decision-makers and buyer groups, and pursuing cross-selling opportunities across service lines.

• Author thought leadership on relevant topics, present at industry and network events, and help build both the Control Risks and personal brands.

Client Delivery

• Advise clients on complex resilience management, security, crisis, business continuity and enterprise risk challenges, developing practical, sustainable approaches that can be understood and acted on by senior decision-makers.

• Act as a senior project manager and trusted client adviser for Control Risks’ resilience and risk consulting projects, including assessing, designing, implementing and improving corporate security, resilience and risk management programmes, acting as the primary client contact and managing multidisciplinary delivery teams.

• Provide clients with expert support and insights on risk strategy, organizational structures, Enterprise Risk, Business Continuity, Crisis, Security, Cyber Risk, Digital Risk or Intelligence Management.

• Engage credibly with boards, executive committees and senior leadership teams, ensuring that business priorities are reflected in resilience and risk solutions and that recommendations are presented clearly, confidently and persuasively.

• Collaboratively scope complex and multidimensional resilience projects with clients, using strong relationship-building and social skills to bring in diverse Control Risks teams and position the firm effectively for follow-on work

• Own the full client delivery lifecycle from diagnostic assessment and solution design through implementation, stakeholder management, quality assurance and executive-level presentation of outcomes.

• Use delivery work to identify client priorities, unmet needs and follow-on opportunities.

• Manage engagement resourcing, budgets, margins and invoicing.

Requirements
Essential

• Significant work experience in a consulting firm.

• Direct, hands-on experience in selling and scoping consulting projects, including personally leading sales conversations, shaping client needs into project opportunities and converting those opportunities into won work

• Established network in the relevant industry and market, with a degree of external recognition or profile that enables credible senior-level client engagement and supports business development.

• Knowledge of best practices in resilience management, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity, organisational structures and executive decision-making under pressure.

• Demonstrated expertise in resilience management, including risk and resilience programme development, security and crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience optimisation.

• Strong understanding of cyber and digital risks and how they intersect with resilience management, crisis preparedness, business continuity and senior-level risk decision-making.

• Knowledge of data-driven approaches and understanding the impact of AI on resilience

• Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, including presenting complex recommendations in a compelling and commercially relevant way.

• Strong presentation skills, with the ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively.

• Business-level proficiency in German and English language.
Preferred

• Experience in multiple industries and client operating environments

• Ability to travel 50+% of the time and on short notice

• Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including strong social skills and the ability to build trust quickly with senior clients and internal stakeholders.

• Ownership, accountability and commercial resilience to drive success both within the team and across Control Risks.

• The ability to multi-task and balance competing requirements, including client-facing, business development related, and internal matters

• Committed, enthusiastic and commercially driven, with a “refuse to lose” attitude and a proactive approach to winning client confidence and new work.

• A high level of integrity, loyalty and discretion

• Willingness to learn and develop new skills

• Executive presence, board-level confidence and the ability to present ideas and recommendations in a compelling, visually clear and persuasive way.

Benefits

• We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance.

Für ein großartiges mittelständisches Produktionsunternehmen im Großraum Stuttgart suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Controlling. • Sie übersetzen Zahlen, Daten und Fakten aus dem Werk in Entscheidungsgrundlagen.

• Sie bereiten Berichte und Abweichungsanalysen auf, erläutern die Ergebnisse und entwickeln das Berichtswesen weiter.

• Sie wirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsabläufen, Systemen und IT-Reporting-Strukturen mit.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Praxis im Controlling; Erfahrung im Werkscontrolling eines produzierenden Unternehmens ist besonders willkommen.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SAP FI/CO, insbesondere rund um Kalkulation, Tarifermittlung und Prozesse; erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP S/4HANA sind ein Plus.

• Gute Kenntnisse der Rechnungslegung und ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Finanzbuchhaltung und Controlling ineinandergreifen.

• Ausgeprägtes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denken sowie eine hohe Fähigkeit, Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen zu finden.

• Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Fachbereiche wie die Werksleitung für Veränderungen zu gewinnen.

Ein paar Worte zum Schluss
Für unseren Kunden ist dies eine absolute Schlüsselrolle!
Wenn Sie Zahlen nicht nur analysieren, sondern mit Ihren Erkenntnissen die Entwicklung eines Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitgestalten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

arbeitnow:talent-sourcer-gn-recruiter-gn.title: Talent Sourcer (gn) / Recruiter (gn) - 100% REMOTE
arbeitnow:talent-sourcer-gn-recruiter-gn.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
Eine Führungskraft mit zehn Jahren Bauerfahrung schreibt keine Bewerbungen. Sie steht auf der Baustelle. Die meisten schicken ihr eine Nachricht und warten. Du fasst nach, greifst zum Telefon und holst sie ins Gespräch. Wenn das nach dir klingt, lies weiter.
JIRO ist eine Personalberatung für Bau und Infrastruktur mit Kunden in ganz Europa. Wir besetzen anspruchsvolle Führungspositionen, die lange offen bleiben. Für diese Suche bauen wir ein Sourcing-Team aus Leuten auf, denen Durchschnitt nicht reicht.
Arbeite, wann du willst. Wo du willst. So viel du willst.
Dein Job in vier Schritten

• Finden. Auf den gängigen Portalen und in Netzwerken suchst du die Profile, die zu unseren Stellen passen. Zu jeder Stelle bekommst du ein Briefing.

• Ansprechen. Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, nicht nach Vorlage oder KI.

• Dranbleiben. Bleibt die Antwort aus, hakst du nach. Zeigt jemand Interesse, greifst du zum Telefon. Du bleibst am Ball, bis aus einem Vielleicht ein Termin wird.

• Termin legen. Das Erstgespräch buchst du direkt im Kalender deines Kollegen. Ab da übernimmt er.
Vertrieb, Kundentermine und CRM-Pflege gehören nicht zu deinem Job. Deine ganze Energie geht ins Sourcing.
Wann, wo und wie viel: Du entscheidest
Wann du willst. Early Bird oder Nachteule, deine Entscheidung. Uns interessiert, was du lieferst, nicht ob dein Teams-Status grün ist.
Wo du willst. Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote. Lust auf ein paar Wochen Dubai, Lissabon oder Catania? Workation ist bei uns gern gesehen. Einzige Regel: Telefoniert wird, wenn Europa wach ist.
So viel du willst. Wie viel du rausholst, entscheidest du selbst.
Dein Verdienst hat keinen Deckel
Deine Vergütung setzt sich aus vier Teilen zusammen:

• eine feste Basis

• eine Provision für jedes Gespräch, das du legst

• eine Provision für jede Einstellung, die daraus entsteht

• Extra-Boni, die wir spontan ausloben, etwa für geknackte Ziele oder brennende Stellen
Was du außerdem bekommst

• Jeden Tag gemeinsam besser. Wir treffen uns täglich als Team. Was hat funktioniert, was nicht, was machen wir morgen anders? Wir wachsen zusammen, nicht jeder für sich.

• Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Wir sagen dir offen, was gut lief und wo noch Luft ist. Ehrlich, direkt, ohne Watte.

• Stillstand gibt’s nicht. Suche, Ansprache, Nachfassen: Wir testen, messen und schärfen nach. Was besser funktioniert, wird Standard für dich und das ganze Team.

• Aufstieg für alle, die Bock haben. Sourcing ist bei uns keine Sackgasse. Wer mehr will und das zeigt, wächst in die nächste Rolle.

• Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Corporate-Blabla, kein „Dafür bin ich nicht zuständig”.

• Die Werkzeuge zahlen wir. Profi-Zugänge zu den gängigen Portalen gehen auf uns.
Was du mitbringst

• Du kannst mit Menschen. Ob aus Recruiting, Vertrieb, Promotion oder Einzelhandel: Du weißt, wie man Fremde in wenigen Sätzen für sich gewinnt. Recruiting-Erfahrung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung.

• Du schreibst kurz und persönlich, ohne Floskeln.

• Hängt eine Suche fest, gibst du nicht auf, sondern probierst den nächsten Weg.

• Rankings spornen dich an, und du willst ganz oben stehen.

• Du ziehst durch, auch wenn niemand daneben sitzt.

• Was du zusagst, hältst du.

• Du sprichst und schreibst sicheres Deutsch.

• Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Recruiting-Portalen oder mit dem Bau.
Nichts für dich, wenn …

• … es dir egal ist, ob du einen Termin mehr oder weniger legst.

• … du lieber Kunden betreust und Abschlüsse machst. Dafür gibt es unsere Stelle als Recruitment Consultant (360°).

• … du jemanden brauchst, der dir morgens die To-do-Liste schreibt.
So geht’s weiter

• Kennenlern-Call: Wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen, und wir legen dir die Zahlen zu deinem Verdienst offen.

• Short Case: Du bekommst eine echte offene Stelle, findest passende Profile und schreibst eine Ansprache. Kein halber Arbeitstag. Wer mehr liefert als verlangt, fällt uns auf.

• Start: Zugänge, Briefing, los.
Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil reicht für den ersten Schritt.
Make your move.

We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner.
What You'll Do

• Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system.

• Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain.

• Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act.

• Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date.

• Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself.

• Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design.

How We Work
We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly.
What This Role Is Not
A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or security role.
What We're Looking For
Must-Haves

• You've shipped multi-step, tool-using LLM agents to production (LangGraph or similar)

• You know when sub-agents help, how to build good evals, and why retrieval fails

• Fluent in Python and productive in TypeScript/Node (NestJS is a plus)

• PostgreSQL and data modeling

• You use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day

• You write clear specs and can explain trade-offs to people who aren't engineers

• Fluent English (C1–C2)

Nice-to-Haves
None of these are required, but they'll help you get up to speed faster:

• You've connected agents to tools and data through MCP

• You've worked with knowledge graphs or other ways of modeling how people, work and information relate

• You've run models in production on AWS Bedrock or Vertex AI

• You've traced and debugged agents with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse

• You speak German

Who You Are

• You've set technical direction beyond your own work, and others build on your patterns

• You start from what users need and what could go wrong, then choose the tools

• You care whether the system still makes sense in a year

• You're happy to do backend work when a feature needs it

• You want influence through your work, not through a title

• You like working with designers and product people

• You enjoy technical debate and change your mind when the other argument is better

What We Offer

• Flexible remote setup

• Learning & development opportunities

• Generous vacation & workation budget

• Technical ownership of the platform at the core of wingmaite's product

How to Apply
Upload your CV through join and fill in the questionnaire so we can consider your application for the role! Optional: a link to agent or eval work you're proud of.

arbeitnow:werkstudent-product-operations.description:
Warum re-green?
re-green Mission ist es, alle deutschen Großbüros von ihrem CO₂ zu befreien. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist für 40 % des deutschen Energieverbrauchs und 36 % aller CO₂-Emissionen verantwortlich. Ohne eine bezahlbare Dekarbonisierung von Gewerbeimmobilien ist ein Erreichen des 2-Grad-Zieles nicht möglich – was wir machen zählt!

r e-green bietet Eigentümern eine energetische Sanierung an, ohne dass sie investieren müssen. Unsere Überzeugung: Jedes größere Gebäude wird künftig zu einem kleinen Energieunternehmen. re-green entwickelt und realisiert dafür ein standardisiertes Produktbündel aus Wärmepumpe, Photovoltaik und Batterie – kombiniert mit eigener Planungssoftware und einem vorgefertigten Container-Ansatz.
Deine Aufgaben
Dafür suchen wir einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der re-vive, unsere Planungssoftware für Wärmepumpe und Photovoltaik, mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung betreut und weiterentwickelt.
Vertrieb, Engineering und Finanzen planen, bewerten und finanzieren damit jedes Projekt.

Weiterentwicklung & Wartung von re-vive

Umsetzung von Verbesserungswünschen und neuen Features von der Anforderung bis zum Release. Nice to have ist Erfahrung in der Behebung von Bugs, KI-gestützte Entwicklung mit Next.js, TypeScript und SQL. Wichtig ist das Du Spass ein autodidaktischen Lernen, dem Übernehmen von Verantwortung und der Arbeit an digitalen Produkten in hoher Qualität mitbringst.

Prüfung von Abrechnungslogiken

Plausibilisierung der Ergebnisse gegen Angebote, Finanzmodelle und reale Betriebsdaten, Aufbau automatisierter Tests, Identifikation und Behebung von Unstimmigkeiten – von Heizlast und Jahresarbeitszahl über CAPEX und OPEX bis zu Cashflow, IRR und DSCR.

Produkt & Zusammenarbeit

Aufnahme von Anforderungen aus Vertrieb, Engineering und Finanzen, Weiterentwicklung von Preisbuch und Standardannahmen gemeinsam mit dem Product Lead, Dokumentation von Rechenregeln und Release Notes.
Das bringst Du mit
Sie sind als Werkstudent eingeschrieben, bringen ein starkes Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien mit und arbeiten sich schnell in komplexe Datenstrukturen ein.

Laufendes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Mathematik, Physik, Energietechnik oder vergleichbar. Wir sind offen für Interessierte aus anderen Studiengängen.

Erfahrung mit Code und SQL – idealerweise mit eigenen Projekten

Erfahrung oder Interesse in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche:
o KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
o Web-Entwicklung (Next.js, TypeScript) und Datenbanken
o Investitions- und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung
o Financial Modelling oder Excel-Modellierung
o Wärmepumpen, Heizlast und Photovoltaik
o Strompreisbestandteile, Netzentgelte und Umlagen
o Workflow-Automatisierung (z.B. n8n)

Gründlichkeit: Du prüfst KI-Ergebnisse, statt ihnen blind zu vertrauen

Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge selbst aufzubauen
Dein Start bei uns
In den ersten Monaten haben Sie sich in unsere Energiemodellierung eingearbeitet und unterstützen die operativen Prozesse bei der Umsetzung unserer Photovoltaik- und Wärmepumpenprojekte. Wer die meisten Anforderungen erfüllt, bewirbt sich am besten direkt.
Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen
Die Vergütung für diese Werkstudententätigkeit liegt bei EUR 17–18 per hour. Für Deinen Arbeitsweg erhälst Du eine Entschädigung für Reisekosten

Du baust das, was nachts läuft, und sorgst dafür, dass die Bank am nächsten Morgen damit arbeiten kann.

• Du entwickelst SAP-Lösungen in ABAP und ABAP-OO, von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung.

• Du steuerst und optimierst die Batch-Verarbeitung, planst Jobabläufe und überführst Anwendungen in die Hintergrundverarbeitung.

arbeitnow:head-of-finance-berlin-47673.description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities

• Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability

• Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making

• Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales

• Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications

• Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO

• Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes

• Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners

• Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

• At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company

• Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting

• Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options

• Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors

• Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models

• Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage

• Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments

• Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership

• Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created

• Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

• You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.

• You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.

• You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

Das bringst Du mit

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects
About our technology
The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role
We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. You will play a key role in bridging front-end design intent with construction execution, commissioning, and operational readiness, ensuring that facility infrastructure meets the requirements of our semiconductor manufacturing operations.

• Lead the design, review, and validation of mechanical, electrical, and civil/structural systems for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.

• Develop utility matrices, P&IDs, and single-line diagrams for equipment installations and tool hookups.

• Develop detailed cost models and capital expenditure estimates for facility projects.

• Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior and senior engineers.

Your Qualifications

• At least 10 years of experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, or mission-critical facility design, including a minimum of 5 years in a principal or senior technical leadership role.

• Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant systems, including low- and medium-voltage (LV/MV) systems, transformers, HVAC, exhaust systems, scrubbers, compressors, and cleanrooms.

• Strong leadership skills, with the ability to provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers.

• Fluent in both English and German , with excellent communication skills.

• Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and Navisworks.

• Proficiency in reading and preparing technical schematics, performing engineering calculations, interpreting blueprints, and understanding BMS software.

• Experience in engineering project budget preparation, budget control, and energy cost evaluation and control.

• Experience with FMEA and resilient design.

• Professional registration with a recognized engineering body will be considered a plus.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

arbeitnow:senior-functional-safety-engin.description:
About Us
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary
Join a motivating team of experts developing Electric Vehicle technology through innovative zonal architecture development.
This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site.

Responsibilities

• Establish and continuously improve the processes and technical pipelines that collect, organize, and present all traceable evidences required for Functional Safety release or sign-off reports (production and SW releases) across all FuSa domains (Dynamics, Body, Thermal, Energy, ADAS, Core).

• Define quantitative, evidence-based release criteria for FuSa sign-off — including thresholds for requirement verification coverage, safety mechanism test pass rates, diagnostic coverage metrics, ASIL-graded open-issue limits, and residual risk acceptance.

• Work closely with PMT to align FuSa maturity criteria to program milestones and gate reviews, providing per-domain risk profiles that surface gaps in evidence completeness and drive early visibility of domains at risk of missing gate criteria.

• Coordinate with FuSa domain leads, test automation, SW FuSa, HW FuSa, and PMT to align evidence deliverables against release schedules, driving pipeline efficiency so that sign-off can be given with confidence and minimal overhead on technical teams.

• Develop and maintain automated dashboarding that consolidates release readiness, requirement coverage, open safety issues, and post-release fleet safety performance — enabling data-driven release decisions and continuous calibration of release criteria over successive programs.

• Establish and track post-release safety performance indicators — including field failure rates against safety mechanism assumptions and safety-relevant DTC rates — to close the loop between pre-release evidence confidence and real-world outcomes.

• Coordinate with external suppliers and Brand partners to collect, validate, and integrate supplier-generated safety work products and SEooC arguments into the vehicle-level safety case.

• Work closely with the FuSa Process team and VWG Central FuSi process team to ensure release processes align with ISO 26262 compliance expectations across Rivian and VW programs.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:

• Degree in Electrical/Electronic, Mechanical, Software, Systems, or Computer Engineering (or similar).

• Over 5 years of experience in the automotive industry (or equivalent), ideally at an OEM or Tier 1, with at least 2 years in functional safety, systems engineering, or release/program engineering roles.

• Proven knowledge of ISO 26262, particularly around work product management, confirmation reviews, safety case argumentation, and evidence-based release assessment.

• Strong experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g. JAMA, DOORS) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence).

• Experience defining quantitative release criteria and safety performance metrics, and building reporting pipelines or dashboards to track them.

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau, Power BI); ability to present risk and safety performance metrics to technical and leadership audiences.

• Good understanding of vehicle system functionality across multiple domains.

• Excellent organizational and coordination skills; ability to drive cross-functional alignment under tight release schedules.

• Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to report clearly and concisely to senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with supplier safety artifact management — SEooC arguments and supplier-provided safety cases integrated into a vehicle-level safety argument.

• Exposure to fleet monitoring, field quality data, or post-release safety performance tracking.

• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and data pipeline tooling; scripting ability (e.g. Python) a plus.

Total Rewards
We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs .

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers ). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board .

Equal Opportunity
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. arbeitnow:staff-hardware-technical-progr.title: Staff Hardware Technical Program Manager
arbeitnow:staff-hardware-technical-progr.description:
About Us
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary
As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM) , you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.
Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.
 
Responsibilities

• Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche in parallel, keeping alignment across the three brands on requirements, schedules, and decisions.

• Own hardware integration schedules , milestones, and readiness gates across assigned vehicle programs, from prototype builds (EVT, DVT) through production validation.

• Drive engineering change management , including Program Change Requests (PCRs), impact assessments, and approval through partner boards.

• Coordinate with internal hardware development and validation teams, and bridge the time difference between the US home base and European partners.

• Track and close hardware issues and open action items, with clear owners and due dates.

• Lead cost-reduction initiatives on hardware platforms, including proposal reviews and status reporting.

• Represent hardware integration in program reviews, quality boards, and steering meetings, preparing decisions and clear status updates for leadership.

• Maintain the Brand Technical Responsible (BTV) interface, collecting partner feedback and turning it into prioritized actions.

• Help build and grow the European partnering team over time, including hiring and onboarding as the program scales.

 
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Strong background in hardware development and/or hardware validation, with enough technical depth to challenge engineering decisions and follow test results.

• Generalist profile: comfortable moving between hardware design, validation, program management, and partner alignment.

• Experience in automotive or another safety-critical industry, ideally across development phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).

• Fluent German and very good English, both written and spoken, for daily work with brand partners and with colleagues in the US.

• High stress resistance: able to keep priorities clear and communicate calmly during tight deadlines, escalations, and launch pressure.

• Agile working style: experience running work in sprints or iterative cycles, adapting plans quickly, and working in cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable working across time zones, with regular overlap with US colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with OEM partner programs, ideally with multiple brands in parallel.

• Experience with automotive change management processes and PCR or ECR workflows.

• Familiarity with zonal architectures, vehicle networking, or ECU platforms such as XMM, RFM, or VAS.

• Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) is a plus.

Total Rewards
We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs .

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers ). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board .

Equal Opportunity

About Yepoda
Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.
Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.
Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

About this opportunity
As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.
You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step. You ensure smooth procurement, manufacturing, and logistics processes via air and sea shipments (incl. import) to our warehouses and efficient delivery to our B2C and B2B customers. If you're a strong Operations leader, passionate about building efficient and scalable processes and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Your tasks

• Lead the end-to-end supply chain function, including demand planning, procurement/manufacturing, logistics and import, fulfilment, last mile, and inter-warehouse transfers.

• Develop and implement strategies that improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen reliability and agility as the business scales.

• Own demand forecasting and inventory planning to ensure product availability while keeping inventory levels lean.

• Oversee global logistics operations, optimising shipping modes from Asia and import flows into the EU, UK, and US.

• Build strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics providers; negotiate contracts and favourable terms, and ensure adherence to quality standards and delivery timelines.

• Evaluate and onboard new suppliers to support scalability and product innovation.

• Leverage our ERP system and forecasting & planning tools to drive continuous process improvement, while working with Product Development on sustainability, packaging, and supply chain innovation.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering accountability and collaboration, and align supply chain strategy with Product Development, Marketing, and Finance.

Your profile:

• 6+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, ideally within beauty, consumer goods, retail, or eCommerce, including 3+ years leading operations teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Proven expertise across inventory management, demand forecasting, global procurement, and international logistics.

• Track record of scaling supply chain operations in a high-growth, demand-volatile environment.

• Proficient in ERP systems and specialised SCM tools for forecasting and planning, while still comfortable running ad-hoc analyses in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide teams and secure buy-in from adjacent functions.

• Excellent negotiation and relationship management skills with international suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

What We Offer:

• Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

• Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

• Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

• Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

• We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

• Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

• Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of Yepoda’s exciting growth journey as our new Head of Supply Chain? We’d love to hear from you! 🫰✨

We have built and tested our MVP. Now we are looking for a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who builds the technology and product that grows and scales the company.

• Set up evaluation, safety and monitoring: expert-reviewed benchmark cases, grounding, escalation and regression testing

• Build a state-of-the-art UX/UI that technicians want to use every day

• Spend time with technicians in the field and turn their feedback into product within days

What you bring

• Machine Learning experience, ideally 3+ years applying it in production products (e.g. LLMs, retrieval/RAG, NLP, computer vision, model evaluation)

• Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just a product – full ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity

• Experience leading the technical build of a product from zero to one, e.g. as tech lead or founding engineer

Nice to have

• Previous founder or early-stage startup experience

• Experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise B2B requirements (security, GDPR, multi-tenant SaaS)

• Experience hiring and leading engineering teams

• A true co-founder role with ownership of the technology and a real say in the direction of the company

• An unfair head start: a cooperating partner with thousands of technicians and real repair data from day one – the fuel for a system that learns from every job

• A mission with real-world impact: helping close the skilled-trades gap in Europe

Location & start

arbeitnow:art-director-performance-creat.description:
Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat.
Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads.
Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson.
Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team.
Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst.
Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben.
Aufgaben

• Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging

• Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok

• Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

• Reportings: Performance im Ads Manager analysieren, Learnings ableiten und daraus Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für unsere Kunden aufbereiten

• Kundenkontakt: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, führst Calls, präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse und bist kreative Ansprechperson

• Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter

• Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen

• Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

• Du entwickelst unsere AI Workflows mit Claude, Figma und Higgsfield ständig weiter und trägst Learnings ins Team

Qualifikation

• Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder als Creative Lead, idealerweise im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld

• Wirklich hohe Kreativität: Du entwickelst eigene, unverwechselbare Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads

The Function & Team

The Compliance team is part of the 2nd line of defence who has responsibility and oversight of the Governance, Risk & Compliance functions within TriplePoint.  The Team is integral to the company's success, ensuring that all business operations adhere to the stringent regulations set by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

Joining the Triple Point Compliance Team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions directly impact the company's operations and overall success.

The team works closely with various departments to ensure that all business activities comply with regulatory requirements, thereby enabling the company to operate smoothly and efficiently. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the company's growth and to develop professionally within a respected and forward-thinking organisation.

By joining the Compliance team within the GRC function, you will become part of a collaborative and professional team that plays an essential role in supporting the firm’s success. Your contributions will directly influence how the business meets its regulatory obligations, while providing you with broad exposure to the firm’s products, investments and operations. This is an opportunity to strengthen Triple Point’s compliance environment and to play a meaningful role in sustaining the company’s long-term resilience and reputation.  The role reports to the Director, Regulatory Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

The Assistant Director, Regulatory Compliance will work alongside the Director, Regulatory Compliance as a deputy of a small, focused compliance department, providing technical support and leadership to the team, operating in a dynamic and fast-moving organisation.

The role has two core purposes: to provide strong technical regulatory expertise and practical, commercial advice to the business; and to support the growth of the Compliance team by developing the technical knowledge, skills and confidence of its members. The successful candidate will deputise for the Director, Regulatory Compliance when required.

The candidate will have extensive relevant compliance experience within the investment management or wider financial services sector, and a track record of providing proactive, commercial and value-adding regulatory advice in collaboration with Risk and Legal colleagues.

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-backe.description:

Senior Software Engineer - Backend
Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 2 in-person days a week.
Compensation: £120k base salary plus equity
Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate
Start Date: As soon as possible
Why we exist
Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.
This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?
We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.
How we do it
Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.
We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.
Why this role matters
None of this works without the data. Every enterprise brings its own tangle of ERPs and legacy systems, and the usual answer is yet another integration. We think a new era of enterprise data intelligence needs a new way of thinking about data, not a new layer of the same plumbing.

You'll find new ways to reach and make sense of enterprise data, pairing the very best of AI with your own creativity to crack hard problems. You'll have real autonomy over how you approach it, in a small, high-trust team with genuine influence over architecture, product and how engineering grows.
What you'll do

• Design, build and ship high-quality backend systems that power Deducta.

• Work with customers to understand their problems, and bring fresh insights and ideas that shape the platform.

• Develop reliable, scalable data and AI pipelines that ingest and process enterprise data.

• Build internal tools and models that get more value from enterprise data and improve how we deliver our product.

• Expand the range and depth of data Deducta can access, building a more complete picture of how large businesses operate.

• Push the boundaries of applied AI, both in the product and in how we build it.

• Own problems end to end, from definition to deployment, making sound calls on architecture, trade-offs, performance and reliability along the way.

Success in this role means:

• Customers find deeper value faster: You find new ways to deliver speed and value to customers at scale.

• Broader, connected data: Deducta can reach and link new kinds of enterprise data beyond spend, giving customers a fuller picture of their business.

• Systems others build on: The pipelines and tools you've built are reliable, documented and used by the team without needing you.

Who you are
You're a senior backend engineer who enjoys hard, loosely defined problems and takes them all the way to production. You don't need a background in enterprise data or procurement. We care about how you think and the quality of what you've built.
You might be the right fit if you have:

• Strong backend fundamentals and experience building reliable, maintainable systems, ideally with complex or messy data.

• Sound architectural judgement, and the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your decisions.

• A track record of owning problems from investigation through to production.

• A solid grasp of software design principles. .NET and TypeScript help, but fundamentals matter more than a stack match.

• High standards for testing, code quality and managing technical debt.

• Clear communication with engineers, product, customers and external technical teams.

• Real curiosity about applied AI, and the creativity to use it on problems others haven't cracked.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.
How we work
We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

• Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

• Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

• Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

• Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

• System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

• Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

• Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

• Background interview

• Technical interview

• Final interview

• Offer, referencing and start
