arbeitnow:head-of-business-development-i.description:
We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

• Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

• Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

• Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

• Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

• Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

• Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

• Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.

What you bring

• You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

• People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

• Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

• Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

• Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

• You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

• The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.

Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

• By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

• Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

• Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

• Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

• After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.

Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.
Compensation: $200K – $300K

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

This isn't investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund: we're hiring the leader of a team of six who build and grow relationships with family offices, VCs and strategic investors every day, and report directly to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

• Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

• Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

• Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

• Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

• Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

• Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

• Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.

What you bring

• You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

• People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

• Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

• Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

• Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

• You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

• The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.

Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

• By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

• Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

• Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

• Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

• After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.

Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.

arbeitnow:marketing-manager-london-26803.description:
BeyondMath is a pioneering startup, backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to reshape the frontiers of engineering through Foundational AI models for Physics. We are replacing traditional, slow, and expensive simulation methods with AI that rivals accuracy at orders of magnitude higher speed.
We are moving beyond the "generic AI" hype to solve the world's hardest physical engineering challenges in automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, and energy. We are looking for a Marketing Manager to be our first dedicated marketing hire: a hands-on operator who will build and run the channels, materials and events that put our technology in front of the engineers who need it.

The Role
As Marketing Manager, you are the person who makes BeyondMath's marketing actually happen. This is an execution role, not a strategy role: you will report to our GTM Lead, who sets direction with the CEO and COO, and you own turning it into a steady, high-quality stream of output across our social channels, our go-to-market materials and our events calendar.
You will work closely with the leadership team, our GTM and technical account teams, and our engineers and researchers, turning deeply technical work with global OEMs, Formula 1 teams and aerospace innovators into content and moments the market notices. You will not inherit a marketing machine; you will build one, with real autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and the BeyondMath brand system already in place to work from.

Key Responsibilities

• Own Our Social Channels: Run BeyondMath's LinkedIn and other relevant channels day to day — content calendar, copy, visuals, scheduling, community engagement and reporting — with a consistent voice and an on-brand look.

• Content Production: Turn product releases, customer results, research and team news into posts, short articles, case studies, one-pagers and short-form video, working directly with engineers and researchers to get the technical detail right.

• GTM Materials & Preparation: Support the GTM team with decks, one-pagers, proposals, demo collateral and follow-up materials, and maintain a current library of on-brand templates they can pick up and use.

• Events Calendar & Attendance: Own the events calendar across industry conferences, partner events and executive dinners or roundtables. Plan BeyondMath's presence end to end: selection and budget, sponsorships, speaker slots, booth and materials, logistics, attendee outreach, onsite execution and post-event follow-up and reporting.

• Owned Events & Webinars: Produce BeyondMath-hosted moments — technical webinars, customer roundtables, launch events — from concept through follow-up.

• Website, Email & Digital: Keep website content current (news, case studies, careers), look after basic SEO hygiene, and run newsletter and email communications to prospects and partners.

• Brand Guardianship: Apply and maintain the BeyondMath brand guidelines across all internal and external materials, and brief and manage freelancers or agencies (design, video, PR) where needed.

• Measurement: Track channel, content and event performance, report simply on what is working, and keep marketing data in the CRM clean and usable for the GTM team.

About You

• You have a "founder's mentality": you are a builder who is comfortable being the first person in a function, and who will set up the system and then run it yourself.

• You take pride in output. You would rather ship ten strong posts and two excellent events than write one strategy deck.

• You are at home with deeply technical subject matter and genuinely curious about engineering, simulation and AI. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to enjoy working with them.

• You are organised, detail-obsessed and reliable across many concurrent deadlines, and you bring a calm, can-do attitude to a fast-moving team.

Essential Requirements

• Experience: 3–7 years' B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup or scale-up and ideally in technology, software, engineering or deep tech.

• Social Channel Ownership: A hands-on track record running company social channels, LinkedIn in particular — content calendars, copywriting, visuals, community management and analytics.

• Events Delivery: Proven experience planning and delivering B2B events and conference attendance end to end, including sponsorships, logistics and onsite execution.

• Writing: Strong writing and editing. You produce clean, accurate copy quickly and can work with engineers to make complex things clear without dumbing them down.

• Tooling: Working proficiency in presentation and design tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides, Canva or Figma) and everyday marketing tooling (CRM and email, social scheduling, web analytics).

• AI-Native: Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) across your marketing workflow.

• Travel: Willing and able to travel for events across the UK and Europe, with occasional travel further afield.

Highly Desirable

• Technical Audiences: Experience marketing to engineering, manufacturing or industrial audiences (automotive, aerospace, energy, motorsport), or within CAE, simulation or engineering software.

• First Marketer: Experience as the sole or first marketing hire in a company.

• Video: Short-form video production and editing for social.

• CRM & Web: Working knowledge of a B2B CRM and a website CMS.

• PR: Experience with press, media relations and announcements.

Why Join Us?

• Full Ownership: You will own how BeyondMath shows up in the market — our channels, our materials and our events — and build the marketing function from the ground up.

• High Impact: Your work puts our technology in front of the engineers designing the next generation of sustainable transport and energy systems.

• Elite Team: Work alongside veterans from world-leading AI labs and top-tier engineering teams in a culture of "impact with integrity."

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-44-fe.description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role
Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.
Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.
Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.
AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Building intuitive user interfaces and data visualisations that unlock valuable insights for our customers.

• Building services that can cope with large volumes of data.

• Implementing and maintaining the AWS infrastructure that supports the services owned by the team.

• Build, maintain and evolve large-scale distributed systems, ensuring they remain resilient.

• Building observability into everything you ship (logging, metrics, alerting).

• Owning BAU in your primary domain and building enough operational familiarity with the other domains to support incidents, understand cross-domain interactions, and describe architectural boundaries.

• Collaborating with Product and Design to define and scope the products we build.

• Communicating with other teams and stakeholders when needed.

• Working in a collaborative environment. Pairing for most of your time, giving and receiving reviews, and helping to uphold the team’s shared quality standard.

Working with AI
This is not specifically an AI Engineer role, but every senior engineer in this team is expected to be AI-literate, in two directions: using AI to build better, and building AI into the product responsibly.

• Keep your practice current. Use current models, coding agents and agent tooling in your daily work, and re-test earlier assumptions as capabilities change; what was unreliable six months ago may be routine today.

• Open mind, evidence-led. Give a new tool, pattern or model a fair chance and evaluate it against our own codebases and workflows before ruling it out. Push back when something is presented as a silver bullet and adopting it would bring more risk, or more change, than the team can absorb. Make both calls on evidence, not on instinct or hype.

• Quality bar parity. Agent-generated code and content are held to the same standard as human work. Review it, test it and secure it the same way.

• Build to learn. A working prototype in front of a Product owner or a customer beats a slide. Be as willing to report a disappointing result as an exciting one, and kill weak ideas early.

• Design the human checkpoints and watch the cost. For agentic features, define what the system may decide alone, what needs approval and what escalates, and keep token and run costs visible alongside the value delivered.

• Share what you learn. Contribute to how the team adopts AI across the whole lifecycle (planning, review, testing and release, not only coding) and share your findings with the team and the wider P&T group, so practice spreads beyond one person.

The Signal AI Way
We want you to apply for this position. We want people to enjoy a good experience at Signal AI and we appreciate your professional needs might be different to what we can offer.

• Thriving in Dynamic Environments: If you thrive on stability and predictability, you might find our dynamic environment challenging. Our team frequently adapts to changing priorities, which can be incredibly exciting and rewarding for those who enjoy a fast-paced, ever-evolving workplace.

• Versatile Skill Set: We value versatility and the ability to work on both back-end and front-end development, and across two product domains. If you are passionate about expanding your skills across different areas, you'll find this role enriching and fulfilling.

• Collaborative Communication: Our culture emphasises building strong communication paths with various teams and stakeholders, including the Editorial team that depends on our tooling every day. If you enjoy collaborative problem-solving and sharing insights, you'll fit right in.

• Team-Oriented Programming: We encourage pair programming and team collaboration over solo work. If you find joy in teamwork and learning from peers, you'll thrive here.

• Flexible Coding Approaches: While we respect the discipline of TDD, we also appreciate flexible and innovative approaches to coding, and we prioritise observability over exhaustive test coverage. If you're open to experimenting with different methodologies, this role offers a great opportunity to broaden your horizons.

• Leveraging AI: We're not just building AI products; we use AI to build better. We expect our engineers to actively explore and adopt AI tools that make them more productive, and to keep their critical thinking switched on while doing it.

• Owning Our Systems: When something goes wrong in production, we don't point fingers. We fix it, learn from it, and improve our observability to catch it earlier next time.

If these aspects align with your professional values and aspirations, we believe you'll find a rewarding career with us at Signal AI.

About Signal
At Signal we want to help organisations identify risks and opportunities and see movements in the market before anyone else. We want to help leaders make bold decisions, safe that the data is on their side. We want to connect all those external data points together, uncover the unknown unknowns, and be at the very heart of the knowledge economy.
We’ve already built a world-class artificial intelligence platform for real-time information aggregation and analysis at a massive scale. We proved our value with monitoring and measurement products in the PR & Comms space, and are now joining the dots beyond.
We are friendly and informal people who are passionate about our brand as we all have a stake in our success. We have an inclusive environment, welcoming the skills and experience from many diverse backgrounds, and together we have created who we are and what we sell. We are proud of our achievements and continue to strive for the unknown.
Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.
We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

arbeitnow:founding-gtm-london-226081.description:
Company
Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.
 
We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.
 
By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.
 
Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.
 
Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.
 
Role
We're looking for a Founding GTM Associate to build the top of our enterprise pipeline, working side by side with our founders and sales team.
 
Our go-to-market runs from open source to enterprise. Developers find and build on our open models, and the companies they work for need production-grade, supported versions for products where latency, privacy and offline operation matter. Your job is to make that path faster and more predictable.
 
This is a hands-on, commercial role with one clear goal: book as many qualified meetings as possible for our sales team. You'll report to the CEO and work directly with the founders, research team and sales team.
 
We are not looking for a marketer measured on impressions. We're looking for someone commercially sharp, comfortable reaching out to people, and technical enough to hold their own with engineers.
 
Your work will include:

• Identifying which companies are using our open models, researching them, and getting the right ones into a conversation with sales

• Running targeted outreach to engineering and product leaders at our target accounts, by email, LinkedIn and through our community

• Booking meetings directly with prospects and handing them over to our account executives with clear context

• Building target account lists for events, dinners and conferences, and following up within 48 hours after

• Creating the assets that open doors: account research, tailored demos, one-pagers and case studies

• Supporting open source launches and creator partnerships so they generate pipeline, not just attention

• Tracking which channels produce meetings, and recommending where we put more time and budget

• Helping build the GTM processes and playbooks we'll scale as the team grows

 
In your first few months, the priority is turning companies already using our models into meetings. Events, launches and creator partnerships grow from there. Open source is our biggest advantage, but we care about meetings, not channels. If paid, LinkedIn or outbound gets better results, we want you to prove it and run with it.
 
This is a role to learn fast in. You'll see how an enterprise AI company is built from the inside, and as our GTM team scales, there's a clear path for you to lead part of it.
 
You have:

• 1–3 years' experience in sales development, B2B sales, consulting, a startup generalist role or another demanding commercial environment

• Strong commercial instincts: you can spot which companies are worth our time, and explain why

• Comfort reaching out to people you don't know, and following up until you get a response

• Sharp written communication: emails people answer, and briefs our sales team can act on

• Enough technical curiosity to run our models, follow an engineering conversation and learn fast

• Comfort being measured on one clear number, with the judgement to protect meeting quality while chasing volume

About Hozah
Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte's list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.
Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role
You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.
You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

• Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

• Diagnosing and fixing faults across devices, networks and our backend platform, working through problems methodically.

• Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

• Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

• Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

• Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

What we're looking for
This is a junior role. We care more about fundamentals, honesty and appetite to learn than years of experience.

• Around 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IT support, infrastructure or technical operations, or strong fundamentals you can demonstrate from projects, a home lab or study.

• Networking basics you can explain in plain English: what a switch and a router do, what an IP address is, what a VPN is for.

• A structured instinct when something goes offline: check power, check the network, check the device, in that order.

• Some awareness of APIs and SQL. You do not need to be fluent; knowing what they are and wanting to use them is enough.

• Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

• Organised, reliable and calm when something breaks on a live site.

What this role isn't

• Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

• A narrow role. You will touch hardware, networking, software and data in the same week.

• A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

• 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

• Free breakfast, lunch, drinks and snacks in the office, excellent transport links, and two friendly office dogs.

• You will need the right to work in the UK. A full UK driving licence is handy for site visits.

Product engineers keep ownership of the code in their services. You own the ground it runs on, and you make it easy for them to ship safely. Our engineers use AI coding tools every day, which means more code reaches production each week, so release safety and observability matter more than ever.

• Own the production platform: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Postgres, Temporal and the environments (staging and production) and how a change is promoted between them.

• Own on-call: the rota, the runbooks and the incident process, including postmortems that lead to changes rather than reports.

• Own observability across Cloud Monitoring, Logging and Trace, so the team finds problems before motorists and clients do.

• Own our infrastructure as code. Everything changes through Terraform and CI, with no console click-ops, including our SOPS-encrypted secrets.

• Own the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines and safe release: rollbacks, progressive rollout and promotion between environments.

About Kaluza
Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role
You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is primarily based on TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform. Our work and responsibilities are diverse and wide-ranging, so you will need to have a product-minded problem solving attitude first and foremost . As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

• Set the technical direction for your team : be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

• Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

• Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

• Own the health of your services : SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

• Coach the engineers around you : technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

• Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza : work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.

What you’ll bring
These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our best tech leads and value deeply, but we don’t expect everyone to tick every single box. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

• Experience with our tech stack: TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform.

• Experience leading technical change : you’ve taken a new service or a major architecture change from idea through to running in production, and you can say what you’d do differently.

• A daily agentic development practice : you build with tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and you have views on where agents help a team and where they get in the way.

• Operational ownership : comfortable deploying with shared tooling, well-versed in SRE fundamentals like SLOs, disaster recovery and platform health monitoring, and used to owning your software in production, including out-of-hours on-call.

• A coach’s instincts : you’ve mentored and grown engineers at different levels, and you make the people around you better.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action : you can deliver against a technical strategy iteratively over months, and you’d rather ship a sound first step than wait for certainty.

• Strong product sense : you ask why before building, and you can point to times when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.

• Clear communication, especially in writing : designs, specs, PR descriptions and post-mortems that a teammate, a stakeholder or an agent can act on, and the stakeholder skills to work well with Product Managers, Principal Engineers and other Tech Leads.

• Production management: you organize work, prioritize cases, monitor backlog and capacity, and use KPIs to improve delivery without compromising quality.

• Leadership potential: you guide colleagues, give practical feedback and help a relatively junior/new team grow. Formal management experience is not essential; understanding the lead role and being ready to step up are.

• Stakeholder management and customer focus: you collaborate across teams, communicate clearly and stay composed under pressure. You reduce customer friction without compromising controls or regulatory requirements, challenging requests and escalating when needed.

• Continuous improvement and technical curiosity: you seek better ways to work, use EDD tools confidently and explore AI with a critical eye on its outputs and limitations.

• Languages: you are fluent in English and French; another European language is a plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

• An opportunity to support a growing team: share your expertise and help colleagues build confidence and autonomy as the team expands.

• A practical improvement mandate: turn production insights into clearer processes, stronger reviews and better collaboration with Operations, AFC and Security.

• Exposure to evolving compliance operations: help scale operations as Qonto progresses toward becoming a bank, including responsible AI use in EDD.

• Room to grow: deepen your EDD expertise and develop leadership and coaching skills, with potential future expert opportunities in AFC, Risk & Compliance, AML or Operations, depending on your development and business needs.

Your manager will be Florence , our Anti-Financial Crime Director (Western Europe) .

• Her path? Florence is a certified AML specialist with strong experience in financial crime, AML/CFT and sanctions. Before Qonto, she led BoursoBank’s Financial Crime framework and held several senior compliance roles at Société Générale & Crédit du Nord.

Notre conviction : les entrepreneurs méritent une comptabilité certifiée, intégrée directement à leurs outils, pilotée par des pros qui ont du temps pour conseiller plutôt que pour saisir. L'IA automatise ce qui peut l'être, et le métier se déplace vers ce qui a toujours eu le plus de valeur : le conseil et la relation client. 
En tant que Chef de mission Comptable , tu rejoindras un département en hypercroissance au cœur de cette transformation, avec une équipe de 7 à 10 collaborateurs à piloter , et ton propre portefeuille de clients indépendants. Tu joueras ainsi un rôle actif dans l'évolution de notre solution.

➡️ Ce que tu feras

• Management : Tu supervises une équipe de 7 à 10 collaborateurs de séniorité variée (alternants, juniors et seniors) ; tu es garant de leur productivité et de leur montée en compétence.

• Conseil de confiance : Tu es l'interlocuteur principal de tes clients sur leurs enjeux fiscaux, financiers, juridiques et comptables — pas un exécutant, un référent. Parmi eux, une variété de dossiers comme des professions libérales, consultants, développeurs, RH indépendants, entreprises d’e-commerce, agents immobiliers ou encore holdings.

• Pilote ton portefeuille : Tu prends en charge la tenue, la révision et les obligations fiscales de tes clients (TVA, liasses fiscales, dépôt des comptes), avec des outils pensés pour aller vite sur ce qui peut être automatisé. Sur ton poste, la production directe représente 30% de ton temps.

• Façonne notre produit : Tu es le lien entre tes clients et notre équipe produit. Leurs retours, leurs frustrations, leurs besoins — tu les remontes directement et tu participes à l'évolution de la solution Acasi.

➡️ Ce qu'on recherche

• Formation comptable : DSCG, Master CCA, ou EC mémorialiste.

• Une première expérience de management en cabinet : 2 ans minimum. Tu as déjà managé une équipe sur le plan technique et sais faire monter en compétences tes collaborateurs pour les accompagner dans leur carrière.

• Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier — et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.

• Envie de construire quelque chose : Acasi n'est pas un cabinet figé. Tu veux participer à ce qui se construit — pas juste occuper un poste.

• Langues : français courant indispensable pour la relation client. Anglais B1 minimum à l'oral — nos équipes et nos outils sont en partie en anglais.

➡️ Ce qu'on t'offre

• Être au cœur du réacteur : L'IA va transformer la comptabilité plus vite que n'importe quel autre secteur. Chez Acasi, tu n'observes pas cette transformation depuis les gradins — tu en es l'un des acteurs.

• Un rôle produit rare : Tu as une voix directe sur l'évolution d'un logiciel comptable utilisé par des milliers de clients. Peu de cabinets offrent ça.

• Autonomie réelle dès l'arrivée : Ton portefeuille est à toi. La taille et la complexité s'adaptent à ton niveau — mais la responsabilité, elle, est immédiate.

• Une rémunération compétitive : Ton package est aligné sur ton niveau d'expérience et revu régulièrement — parce qu'on sait que les bons profils ont le choix.

• Tu es mémorialiste ? Toutes les formations obligatoires du stage prises en charge par Qonto, du coaching mémoire & prépa DEC à disposition et du temps réellement bloqué pour les révisions.

Why is this role important for Pennylane?
Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base.

• This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built.

• You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting.

• You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs.

You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance.

How will you contribute to the project?
You build from scratch the accounting model and controls with Product and Tech, then run daily accounting until volumes justify a dedicated operator.
You own the figures and accounting decisions, and prepare the accounting-based prudential reports. You collaborate with our Regulatory Lead, who oversees reporting deadlines, completeness and reviews, the reports before submission.
You would be a great fit if:

• You can work with incomplete information and make decisions, assumptions and open questions clear.

• You document accounting decisions and are able to defend them internally and externally, including to statutory auditors and the ACPR.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?
Build

• Design and test payment and financing accounting schemes in the Core Banking System, the accounting interpreter, working closely with Product and Tech teams

• Document the accounting impact of each product before launch.

• Reconcile the ledger, general ledger, bank accounts and reports. Keep each reported figure traceable to its transactions.

• Set up RUBA and COREP reporting, including dry runs, with the Regulatory Lead.

Operational accounting

• Reconcile payment accounts (eg. SCT, SDD, cards, cheques) against the settlement account daily. Check safeguarding coverage, keep evidence and flag shortfalls.

• Check own funds requirements, applicable ratios and available buffers daily.

• Forecast the amount and timing of capital needs with the Head of Finance and FP&A

• Resolve and document exceptions.

• Account for doubtful receivables, provisions, write-offs and reversals.

• Prepare closing entries, reconcile intercompany balances with Pennylane SAS and support statutory closings.

Strategic contributions

• Prepare the accounting, exposure and provisioning materials for the committee that sets credit risk appetite, overall exposure and counterparty limits.

• Quantify the accounting, provisioning and capital impact of new products, pricing or volume scenarios before launch.

• Alert the Head of Finance early on capital needs, prudential constraints and standards changes (PCEC, ACPR) that affect the model.

• Work closely with Pennylane’s Accounting Manager and the FP&A team to align on definitions, key metrics, and group procedures

Profile we are looking for
Must-have:

• At least 6–7 years of experience, ideally in financial services audit followed by accounting in a payment institution, financing company or bank.

• Strong PCEC, doubtful receivables and provisioning knowledge.

• Able to both build the accounting model and run daily reconciliations, exceptions and closings.

• Comfortable working with incomplete information and owning accounting decisions.

• Able to query large datasets independently.

• Works well with Engineering, Product, Data, Operations and the Regulatory Lead, with clear responsibilities.

• Professional French and English: documentation and regulatory exchanges are in French; teams work in English.

Nice-to-have:

• DEC or equivalent.

• SQL.

• Core banking or accounting interpreter experience.

• Experience building accounting and controls for a new entity or licensing programme.

• ACPR reporting experience (RUBA, COREP).

arbeitnow:senior-machine-learning-engine.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!
 
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.
 
About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

• 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

• 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

• 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

• 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

• 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission
Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.
The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot : invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.
Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.
By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI , you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI
You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

• You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

• You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

• You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

• You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

• You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

• You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

• You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

• You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

• You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane
Within one month:

• You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

• You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

• You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

• You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

• You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

• You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

• You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

• You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

• You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

• You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company
This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?
You may be a great fit if you:

• Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

• Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

• Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

• Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

• Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

• Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

• Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

• Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

• Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

• Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

• Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

• A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

• A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

• A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

• An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)

arbeitnow:specialiste-support-pilotage-e.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision
Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane
Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :
💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!
🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible
🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours
🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.
Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
- Tu intègres Pennylane et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

enshift ist ein Technologieunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf erneuerbaren Energien. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns eine nachhaltige und wirtschaftliche Energieversorgung.

Tasks

• Eigenverantwortliche Leitung von Projekten im Bereich Energy Systems, je nach Projekt in den Bereichen Wärme, Solar und Batterie

• Erstellung von Machbarkeitsstudien und technischen Konzepten sowie Bewertung von Varianten in technischer und wirtschaftlicher Hinsicht

• Einholen, kritische Prüfung und Vergabe von Angeboten bei Installationspartnern

• Betreuung der beteiligten Anspruchsgruppen, von der Hausverwaltung über die Bewohnerschaft bis zum Kunden, mit klarer und proaktiver Kommunikation

• Sicherstellung sauberer Daten in unseren Systemen, vollständiger Dokumentation und einer reibungslosen Übergabe

Requirements

• Technische Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Energie-, Gebäude-, Maschinen- oder Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Umfeld erneuerbarer Energien oder der Gebäudetechnik

• Technisches Verständnis kombiniert mit kommerziellem Denken in Budget, Kosten und Terminen

• Sicherheit in der Koordination von Partnern und Anspruchsgruppen sowie in der zuverlässigen Umsetzung von Projekten

• Kenntnisse im Bereich Wärmepumpen und Heizungssysteme sind von Vorteil, entscheidend ist ein echtes Interesse, dich in diesem Feld zu vertiefen

• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld

Benefits

• Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket und spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Weiterbildungen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien und Projektmanagement

• Ein dynamisches, innovatives Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum

• Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und echten Impact zu schaffen

arbeitnow:werkstudentin-sales-business-d.description:
Über Jurata
Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen.
Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich.
Deine Rolle
KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding.
Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst.
Deine Aufgaben

• Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine.

• Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft.

• Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis.

• Du begleitest Neukundinnen und Neukunden beim Onboarding, damit der Legal Agent schnell Teil ihres Alltags wird.

• Du bist an Events, Fachanlässen und Hochschulen das Gesicht von Jurata.

• Du pflegst deine Sales-Pipeline und unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und zuverlässig.

• Du bringst Kundenfeedback und Einwände strukturiert ins Team ein und gestaltest so Produkt und Playbook direkt mit.

Was du mitbringst
Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis.

• Du studierst Rechtswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master) und kannst dich mit einem Pensum von 40–80 % engagieren.

• Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt.

• Es reizt dich, juristische Fachpersonen von technologischer Innovation zu überzeugen.

• Du interessierst dich für Legal Tech, KI und Sales und greifst ohne Scheu zum Telefon.

• Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe: Du bleibst dran und lernst daraus.

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.

• Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch verständigen. Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

• Legal AI an vorderster Front: Du arbeitest in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Start-ups der Schweiz, mit einem Produkt, das bereits täglich in der Praxis im Einsatz ist.

• Netzwerk in der Rechtsbranche: Du lernst Kanzleipartner, General Counsels und Rechtsabteilungen kennen, lange vor deinem Berufseinstieg.

• Bewährtes Setup: Playbooks, qualifizierte Anfragen und regelmässiges Coaching machen dich schnell selbstständig.

• Fixum plus Provision ohne Obergrenze: Du erhältst ein Fixum und dazu eine Erfolgsprovision, die nach oben nicht begrenzt ist. Die angegebene Vergütungsspanne umfasst Fixum und Erfolgsprovision.

• Flexibles Pensum: Innerhalb von 40–80 % richtet sich dein Pensum nach Vorlesungen und Prüfungen, nicht umgekehrt.

• Praxiserfahrung, die zählt: Du erlebst aus erster Hand, wie KI die juristische Arbeit verändert, und baust Sales-Skills auf, die dir in jeder Karriere Vorteile bringen werden.

• 25 Ferientage: Du hast 25 Ferientage pro Jahr, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

• Remote-Woche: Du arbeitest bei uns im Büro in Zürich. Nach der Probezeit hast du Anrecht auf eine Woche Remote Work pro Jahr.

• Fitness-Abo: Du erhältst ein kostenloses Abo für das Fitnessstudio direkt neben unserem Büro.

• Firmenlaptop: Du erhältst von uns einen Firmenlaptop.

• Teamkultur: Wir pflegen eine echte Start-up-Kultur, haben einen legendären Teamgeist und unterstützen uns jederzeit gegenseitig. Es gibt kostenlose Snacks und Getränke, regelmässige Teamevents, (freiwillige) gemeinsame Workouts und eine lockere Kleiderordnung.

So bewirbst du dich
Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinen universitären Leistungsausweisen, weiteren (Arbeits-)Zeugnissen und ein paar Sätzen zu deiner Motivation, die du direkt im Bewerbungsformular eingeben kannst. Ein zusätzliches Bewerbungsschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wir melden uns bei Interesse innert weniger Tage für ein unkompliziertes Kennenlernen.
Passt es zeitlich gerade nicht, aber du kennst jemanden, der in Frage kommt? Empfiehl uns die Person per E-Mail an ----- Bei einer erfolgreichen Anstellung schenken wir dir als Dankeschön ein Studenten-Jahresabo für den Jurata Legal Agent.

arbeitnow:project-manager-geneva-423515.description:
About Taurus
Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
Tasks
The Role
We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Main Responsibilities

• Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

• Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

• Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

• Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements
Your Profile

• Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

• Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

• Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

• Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

• Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits
What We Offer

• An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

• A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

• A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

• A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Note
We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

arbeitnow:mechatronic-design-test-engine.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor.

We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test.

Responsibilities

•
Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured.

•
Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable.

•
Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline.

•
Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield.

•
Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain.

Requirements

•
You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines.

•
You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun.

•
AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team.

•
You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use.

You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA.

If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

arbeitnow:systems-engineer-excavator-aut.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
arbeitnow:systems-engineer-excavator-aut.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging .

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role .

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios , support atypical and beta deployments , and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

•
Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

•
Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

•
Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

•
Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

•
Apply hotfixes when appropriate

•
Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

•
Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

•
Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

•
Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact

What we're looking for

•
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

•
2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

•
Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

•
C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

•
Proficiency in Linux systems

•
Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

•
Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

•
Driver’s license B category

Beneficial

•
Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

•
Field testing experience

•
Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

•
Experience in motion planning or control

•
Experience in robotic competitions

Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.
