arbeitnow:staff-software-engineer-roboti.title: Staff Software Engineer - Robotics Platform
arbeitnow:staff-software-engineer-roboti.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.

About the Job

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. With your outstanding skills, you will be a role model for other developers in our organisation and guide them on their professional journey.

What you'll do

•
Collaborate closely with engineers from other teams to derive requirements and help shape the vision of our robotics platform

•
Derive roadmaps towards our vision, incorporating business needs and handling conflicting timelines and requirements

•
Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. health monitoring and machine configuration management. Guide junior team members to support your endeavors

•
Monitor external dependencies and alternatives to assess potential issues or improvements

•
Influence, nurture and grow our engineering culture

•
Contribute upstream to open source software projects to close gaps in required functionality

•
Engage in the robotics scene to stay up to date with ongoing developments and share knowledge in and outside of our company

What we're looking for

•
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

•
7+ years of hands-on experience in Software Engineering, Robotics Development or similar roles

•
Strong Software Engineering skills and solid experience with related tooling (e.g. clangd, cargo, pyrefly)

•
Strong programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have

•
Track record of leading high impact projects across teams

•
Experience with middleware (iceoryx2, DDS, AUTOSAR Adaptive) and IDLs (FlatBuffers, Protobuf)

Bonus Qualifications

Don't meet every requirement? We still want to hear from you. These are nice-to-haves, not dealbreakers:

•
Experience working on safety-critical systems and the respective software development processes

•
Experience in developing a production grade robotics system

•
Track record of open source contributions

•
Experience using Rust in a production environment

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

What we offer you:

  • Work-life-balance: Teamwork and personal collaboration in the office are central to us, but we also offer a regular remote work day for added flexibility. In addition, you can compensate for overtime.
  • Vacation mode on: You receive 26 days of paid leave plus an additional 4 compensation days.
  • Wellbeing first: Health benefits and dedicated Mental Health Awareness Days put your health and well-being front and center.
  • Practice makes perfect: Grow through our diverse training programs and leverage internal career initiatives for your personal development across the WPP network.
  • More than just a job: Look forward to unforgettable team events, exclusive employee discounts, and many more highlights.
  • Be yourself: Everyone is warmly welcome here – diversity and equal opportunities are at the core of who we are.

 

 

This is what you move:

As Manager Media Solutions | Campaign (m/f/d), you are responsible for the operational planning, coordination, and activation of digital campaigns for our key global client Roche. Your primary focus is on programmatic activations across CTV, Video, and DOOH. Based in the Media Solutions Unit Switzerland, you will work closely with Client Leads, Programmatic Specialists, local and international WPP teams, as well as publishers and technology partners.

  • Campaign Activation: Independently coordinate and activate programmatic campaigns with a clear focus on CTV, Video, and DOOH.
  • International Campaign Roll-outs: Support the execution of multinational campaigns across various markets, working closely with local WPP teams to identify the best publishers, ad inventories, and activation opportunities.
  • Setup, Monitoring & Optimization: Campaign setup in relevant DSPs and activation platforms is in your hands, along with continuous delivery monitoring and data-driven performance optimization.
  • Partner & Client Team Coordination: Act as a central interface with publishers, media vendors, and technology partners while advising client teams on feasibility checks and activation strategies.
  • Reporting & Insights: Derive actionable insights from campaign reports and share best practices across involved teams.
  • Processes & Innovation: Actively document and enhance activation processes, drive competency growth in Programmatic, CTV, and DOOH, and contribute to evaluating new technologies as well as international projects.

 

 

The following qualities distinguish you:

  • Programmatic & Media Experience: Solid professional experience in digital media, programmatic advertising, campaign management, or ad operations – ideally within an agency, media owner, or adtech environment.
  • Platform & AdTech Know-how: Hands-on experience with at least one leading DSP (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Adform) along with a strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems and adtech infrastructure.
  • CTV & DOOH Specialization: Prior exposure to Connected TV (CTV), Digital Video, and/or Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH), combined with an enthusiasm for cross-channel digital campaign formats.
  • Organization & Project Management: Strong organizational skills, a structured and solution-oriented work approach, and ease in managing complex campaign workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management & Team Spirit: Excellent communication skills, analytical thinking, and a collaborative mindset for cross-market teamwork in an international environment.
  • Language Skills: Business-fluent English (written and spoken) for daily international collaboration; good German skills are a welcome plus.

Furthermore you are: #problem-solver #team-player #hands-on-mentality

arbeitnow:remote-influencer-marketing-ma.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia
High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.
We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.
We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role Overview
As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.
Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.
Core Responsibilities

• Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.

• Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.

• Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.

• Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.

• Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.

• Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.

• Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.

• Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.

• Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.

• Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.

• Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.
Requirements
Background & Experience

• At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.

• A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.

• Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.

• Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.

• Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.

• Fluency in English; German is a plus.

• Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.
Benefits
What Makes You A Great Fit
At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:
Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.
Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.
Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.
Why Join Us?

• Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.

• Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.

• Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.

• Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.

• Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle?
If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers are constantly pushing the boundaries of engineering for life’s complexities. We are ambitious, fast-growing and love to explore. Tasks
For the next expansion step, 3Brain is looking for a full-time Hardware electronics engineer to reinforce our R&D team. You will help develop embedded systems for high-speed data acquisition devices, including tasks such as system engineering, schematics design and layout, testing and verification. You will also contribute to the current device’s life-cycle management, including activities such as automation, production testing and optimization.
In particular, your tasks involve:

arbeitnow:team-lead-invoices-zurich-4200.title: Team Lead - Invoices
arbeitnow:team-lead-invoices-zurich-4200.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.
To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role
Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.
This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

• Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

• Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

• Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.
This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.
You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do
Lead and grow the team

• Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

• Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

• Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire

• Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

• Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities

• Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

• Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

• Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers

• Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

• Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

• Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring

• You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

• You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

• You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

• You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

• You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

• You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

• You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

• You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get

• A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

• Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

• A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

• A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

• Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

arbeitnow:ai-product-concept-designer-in.title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
arbeitnow:ai-product-concept-designer-in.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.

Accountabilities

• Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.

• AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.

• Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.

• Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.

• Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.

• Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.

• Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.

• E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.

• Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.

• Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

• Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.

• Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.

• Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.

• Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.

• Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.

• Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.

• English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.

• Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly preferred:

• Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.

• Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.

• Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.

• Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.

• Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

Nice to have:

• Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.

• Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.

• Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.

• Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.

• Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.

• 100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.

• Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.

• Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.

• Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.

• AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.

• Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

Application requirements:

Please include the following when applying:

• Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.

• A list of the AI image-generation tools you regularly use.

• Your expected hourly rate.

• Your availability and preferred working arrangement (part-time or full-time).

How Jobgether works:

arbeitnow:senior-backend-developer-zuric.title: Senior Backend Developer
arbeitnow:senior-backend-developer-zuric.description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.
quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.
We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists
Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.
The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.
This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

• Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

• The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

• The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

• Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

• The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

• The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work
We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.
We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.
And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year
In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.
By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

• You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

• You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

• You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

• You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

• You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

• You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

• You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

• English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

• You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

• You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

• You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

• You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team
We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.
We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

• Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

• Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

• Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

• Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

• Pensum: 100%

• Start: As soon as possible

• Language: English; German a plus

• Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply
Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

We are looking for highly-motivated individuals with a commercial background, clear business acumen and strong communication skills, who can successfully drive major tenders and develop the Dutch market in line with ubitricity goals and ambition.

Based in our Amsterdam office on Keizersgracht 452, you'll be part of an international, collaborative team that values trust, ownership and open communication. Regular travel within the Netherlands will allow you to build strong relationships with partners and municipalities and make a tangible impact on the country's transition to sustainable mobility.

Responsibilities

• Leading commercial negotiations with public authorities, grid operators and other strategic stakeholders.

• Building and expanding a strong network across the Dutch energy and e-mobility ecosystem.

• Monitoring market developments, regulatory trends and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities.

• Contributing to industry working groups and helping shape the future of smart and grid-aware charging solutions.

Your profile

We're looking for a commercially driven professional who combines strategic thinking with the ability to build relationships and turn opportunities into results.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in business development, tender management, public affairs, sales or a comparable commercial role.

• Ability to influence decision-makers and build long-term partnerships.

• Help accelerate the transition to cleaner and more sustainable transportation.

• Work in an international and purpose-driven company with ambitious growth plans.

• Take ownership of meaningful projects with visible impact.

At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We’re hiring a Senior Imaging Engineer to join our optics and imaging team. You’ll own key parts of the image quality across our multi-camera systems, ensuring our cameras automatically capture high-performance footage that powers computer vision, tracking and insights for teams around the world.

As a Senior Imaging Engineer, you’ll:

  • Evaluate and improve camera systems. You’ll measure, analyze and improve how optics, sensors and image signal processing (ISP) perform across our computer vision applications.
  • Test and qualify hardware. You’ll evaluate lenses and camera modules against optical and environmental specifications, run qualification tests and partner closely with external suppliers on technical follow-up, and refine optical test methods for both lab environments and production lines
  • Support ISP tuning. You’ll tune exposure, white balance, tone mapping and dynamic range, while contributing to camera control and 3A algorithms to enhance downstream computer vision.
  • Collaborate and lead. You’ll contribute to imaging requirements and trade-offs alongside product managers and our optics lead, own projects end-to-end and share knowledge to mentor fellow engineers.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Proven imaging experience. You have deep experience in imaging, camera systems or optical engineering, ideally working on shipped hardware products, bringing a strong understanding of optics, image sensors and ISP pipelines.
  • Hands-on lab expertise. You bring practical experience measuring image quality - including MTF/SFR, noise, color and distortion - using lab equipment like collimators, test charts and climate chambers.
  • Proficient programmer. You’re comfortable using Python for analysis and tooling, as well as C/C++ on embedded Linux.
  • A clear communicator. You explain technical trade-offs to non-specialists with ease and make sound decisions even when working with incomplete data

Nice-to-Haves

  • Control algorithm development. Experience developing camera control algorithms such as auto exposure and auto white balance.
  • Calibration knowledge. Experience with camera calibration (intrinsics, extrinsics and distortion models) and multi-camera or stitched systems.
  • Supplier collaboration. Experience partnering with suppliers and manufacturing partners on specifications, sample evaluations and issue resolution.
  • Embedded platform experience. Familiarity with embedded camera platforms and ISP tuning tools.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Je adviseert nationale en internationale ondernemingen, leidt uitdagende consultancyprojecten en ontwikkelt samen met klanten innovatieve oplossingen. Geen traditionele adviesrol, maar een positie waarin inhoudelijke expertise, ondernemerschap en daadwerkelijke implementatie samenkomen.

Wat ga je doen?
Je bent een vertrouwd adviseur voor klanten, variërend van ambitieuze mkb-organisaties tot internationale multinationals. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen complexe douanevraagstukken, strategische besluitvorming en operationele verbeteringen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

• Strategisch douaneadvies: adviseren over internationale handelsstructuren, douaneregelingen, tariefindeling, oorsprong, douanewaarde en optimalisatie van douanekosten.

• Customs & Trade Compliance: begeleiden van organisaties bij AEO, vergunningen, interne beheersing, risicomanagement en naleving van internationale handelswetgeving.

• Business Transformation: analyseren en verbeteren van douaneprocessen, governance en internationale supplychains, waarbij je regelgeving vertaalt naar praktische oplossingen.

• Digitalisering & Innovatie: adviseren over de inzet van technologie, data, automatisering en AI binnen douane- en handelsprocessen.

• Projectmanagement: zelfstandig leiden van complexe adviestrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en resultaat.

• Business Development: herkennen van commerciële kansen, ontwikkelen van klantproposities en ondersteunen bij het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties.

• Thought Leadership: delen van expertise via trainingen, workshops, presentaties en kennissessies voor klanten en collega's.

Je bent een ervaren douaneprofessional die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met strategisch en commercieel inzicht. Je hebt een stevige professionele basis en bent toe aan een rol met meer verantwoordelijkheid, zelfstandigheid en invloed.

Wat breng je mee?

• Een ondernemende instelling en gevoel voor commerciële kansen.

• Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

• Ervaring met business development, digitalisering van douaneprocessen of internationale transformatieprojecten is een duidelijke meerwaarde.

Belangrijker dan een specifiek carrièrepad vinden wij jouw expertise, professionele volwassenheid en vermogen om klanten verder te helpen.

Wij bieden een seniorpositie met veel zelfstandigheid, inhoudelijke uitdaging en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

• Salaris van € 5.500 tot € 8.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

arbeitnow:senior-recruiter-amsterdam-495.description:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!
Wat je over ons moet weten?
Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.
Wat ga je doen?
Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

• Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

• Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

• Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

• Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

• Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

• Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.

Wat vragen we van jou?
Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.
Daarnaast:

• heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

• werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

• werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

• kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

• heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

• beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.

Wat krijg je van ons?
Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur.

arbeitnow:senior-legal-counsel-amsterdam.description:
Why Coda

Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay , Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud , enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop , Recharge.com , Startselect.com , and mobiletopup.co.uk , that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our close-knit commercial Legal team at Coda in Amsterdam, supporting a fast-growing business across fintech, payments, ecommerce and digital platforms.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a truly international, digital-first company. You'll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, with exposure to both our European businesses and the wider global Coda group.

The role is ideal for a commercially minded, proactive lawyer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, applying legal expertise creatively and pragmatically to support business growth.

You will report to the Lead Counsel, Europe, who is based in India, and work closely with our global legal team and stakeholders across the company.

What You'll Do

•
Provide end-to-end legal support to Coda’s European businesses, advising on commercial contracts, product-related matters, corporate issues and general legal queries

•
Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of customer, partner, vendor and technology agreements, providing pragmatic advice on deal structuring, risk allocation and regulatory requirements

•
Act as a trusted legal partner to Product, Commercial, Engineering and Operations teams, supporting product launches, new features and go-to-market initiatives

•
Take ownership of key legal matters and projects, working independently and proactively while balancing commercial priorities and legal risks

•
Support strategic initiatives, including M&A projects, disputes, European regulatory matters and cross-border projects involving Coda’s global businesses

•
Collaborate with global legal, compliance, corporate secretarial, investigations and regulatory teams to ensure effective and consistent legal support across Europe

•
Contribute to the development of legal processes, templates and playbooks to support the business's continued growth and international expansion

•
Work closely with senior business stakeholders and the Lead Counsel, Europe, acting as a key legal point of contact for European matters and ensuring alignment on priorities and risks

What You'll Have

•
A Dutch-qualified lawyer with a Master’s degree in Law, preferably from a Dutch university, and at least 7 years of relevant experience in commercial or corporate law, ideally gained in-house or at a leading law firm

•
Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial contracts, with sound commercial judgement and a pragmatic, business-focused approach to managing legal risk

•
Experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, SaaS or digital platforms, with a good understanding of payments regulations and frameworks, including PSD2/PSD3, AML and EMD

•
Familiarity with handling commercial disputes, investigations and related legal matters

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly and concisely

•
Proactive, independent and hands-on, with the confidence to take ownership of legal matters, manage competing priorities and seek support when needed

•
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, jurisdictions and time zones in an international environment

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.

Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

arbeitnow:founding-ml-engineer-spectrum-.title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
arbeitnow:founding-ml-engineer-spectrum-.description:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
  • Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
  • Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
  • Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
  • Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.

We expect you to have:

  • A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
  • At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
  • A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
    • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
    • Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
    • Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

Our ideal candidate would have:

  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.
  • Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.
  • The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
  • A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
  • Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.
  • A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.

Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT
Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

• Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

• Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

• In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

• Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

• Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

• Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

• Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ
Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

• Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

• Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

• Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

• Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

• Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

• Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR
Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

• Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

• Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

• Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

• Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

• Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

• Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

• 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

• Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

• Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

• Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt.

• Analytisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld is
