arbeitnow:senior-team-lead-sales-b2c-ber.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
Jetzt bauen wir unser nächstes Kernprodukt auf: Klimaanlagen . Greenfield . Enpals nächste Marktführerschaft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unseren Inside-Sales-Vertrieb from scratch aufbaut und führt.

Deine Aufgaben

• Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du bist die erste Sales-Führungskraft der neuen Unit. Du startest mit 3 bis 5 Sales Managern und skalierst das Team auf 8 bis 12 und prägst es dabei mit deinen Prozessen, deinem Leitfaden und deiner Handschrift. Das Recruiting verantwortest du gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition, vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Einstellungsentscheidung.

• Sales Playbook: Du entwickelst unseren Sales-Leitfaden für Klimaanlagen, von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Einwandbehandlung bis zum Closing, und optimierst ihn kontinuierlich auf Basis von Daten und Gesprächsanalysen.

• Prozesse, Tools & Markt: Du führst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produkt und Operations CRM, Tools, Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Planung und Installation weiter. Dabei beobachtest du Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Impulse für Angebot, Pricing und Verkaufsstrategie.

• Ramp-up & Coaching: Du onboardest neue Sales Manager strukturiert und bringst sie schnell auf Ziel-Performance. Dafür nutzt du einen klaren Einarbeitungsplan, Shadowing, Zertifizierung und definierte Ramp-up-KPIs. Anschließend entwickelst du jedes Teammitglied durch regelmäßige 1:1s, Call-Reviews und Side-by-Side-Coaching individuell weiter und gibst dabei klares, konstruktives Feedback.

• Performance-Steuerung: Du etablierst ein transparentes KPI-System (z. B. Erreichbarkeit, Termine, Conversion, Umsatz pro Kopf) und steuerst damit Kapazitäten und Performance des gesamten Teams: von Lead-Verteilung und Schichtplanung inkl. saisonaler Peaks bis zu Conversion Rates entlang des gesamten Funnels. Du erstellst Forecasts, leitest Maßnahmen ab, setzt sie konsequent um und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung.

• Leading by Example: Du bist nah am Kunden, führst insbesondere in der Pilotphase selbst Verkaufsgespräche und prägst eine leistungsorientierte, wertschätzende Teamkultur.

Dein Profil

• Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im B2C mit, idealerweise im Inside Sales (Telefon/Video) mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, z. B. in Energie, PV, Wärmepumpe oder Haustechnik. Außerdem hast du eine Affinität zu Energie, Gebäuden und Haustechnik.

• Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Sales-Teams. Für das Senior-Level sind es 4+ Jahre bzw. die Führung von 8+ Personen.

• Nachweisbarer Track Record: Du hast selbst überdurchschnittlich verkauft und Teams messbar zur Zielerreichung geführt.

• Du hast Erfahrung im Onboarding und Coaching von Sales Manager:innen sowie im Aufbau von Gesprächsleitfäden und Sales-Playbooks.

• Datengetriebener Steuerungsansatz: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPI-Dashboards und erkennst Hebel im Funnel schnell.

• Aufbau-Mentalität: Du gehst gern in Greenfield-Situationen, packst selbst mit an und übernimmst volle Ownership.

• Du kommunizierst stark und überzeugend, begeisterst Menschen und führst sie zu Spitzenleistungen.

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

• Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

• Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

• Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

• Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

• Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

• Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

• Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

• Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

• Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

arbeitnow:process-automation-engineer-in.title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
arbeitnow:process-automation-engineer-in.description:
We are Metrify Smart Metering , Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal.
Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. Our mission is to enable utilities, grid operators, and energy providers to install and operate smart meters. Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing.
While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities

Automate the operations behind every meter exchange
Metrify's Multi-Family Home team runs meter exchanges in apartment buildings, and your code will help run them. In a team of seven, you'll turn the operations we do by hand into automations that save time, reduce errors, and ship faster.
What you'll do

• Develop the automation layer on our ERP system.

• Write Python scripts that pull and process data from internal and external APIs, Airtable, and our ERP interface.

• Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case.

• Build an ops layer so non-technical colleagues can run and understand your tools without asking you.

• Work directly with the Multi-Family Home team, business operations, and tech and product, and be the bridge between them.

What you'll bring

• A technical background in computer science or engineering (EEE, mechanical, or similar). Strong business profiles with real tech skills are welcome too.

• Programming experience, ideally Python, and comfort working in a code repository (e.g., Git, GitHub, or similar).

• Curiosity about how businesses actually run, and an eye for edge cases.

• Clear communication, including explaining technical topics to people who don't code.

• Fluent English. German is a plus.

• Availability for a 6-month full-time internship, with the chance to stay on.

• Nice to have: SQL experience.

Why this role stands out

• Real impact from day one: Your automations will be used in live meter installation and business operations.

• Design freedom: You choose the tech stack, tooling, and approach. We're early, so you'll shape how things are built.

• Visibility: You'll work closely with the team lead and see how a business runs end to end.

Are you interested, even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential — regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer

• Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

• The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

• Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

• Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

• Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

• The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

• Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

• Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. We do not make decisions based on skin color, religion or religious beliefs, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age—neither during the hiring process nor throughout the employment relationship. Enpal is committed to providing a safe workplace and takes a firm stance against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

arbeitnow:product-specialist-berlin-3856.title: Product Specialist
arbeitnow:product-specialist-berlin-3856.description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION
Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.
Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

• Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

• Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

• Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

• Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.

• Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects.

HOW WE WORK

• Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.

• Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest.

• AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 2–4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation Manager

• You learn a complex product in depth, fast, and explain it clearly to people with very different backgrounds

• You're confident in front of customers: you lead a meeting, handle tough questions and can say no with good reasons

• You've managed projects with external stakeholders, including scope, timelines and expectations

• You turn scattered customer feedback into clear, prioritized input, and you pull usage data yourself to back it up

• You use AI tools every day in your own work

• German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our product and engineering team in English

Bonus points for experience in construction, construction tech or procurement, or with product enablement (help centre, webinars, product tours).

WHY US?

• Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers.

• Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

• Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Air.

• A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

• Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

• Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

ABOUT US
Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.
We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.
Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.
But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.
Compensation: €55K – €65K

• • Salary €55K – €65K

Benefits

• Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive

• Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office

• Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen

• Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen

• Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen

• Preparing templates, DMG guidelines, project instructions and reports

• Training project teams (e.g. presentations, how-to guides)

• Quality control of incoming and outgoing documents, and tracking of deadlines and workflows

• Administering the document management system (user management, access rights, system maintenance)

• Coordinating as-built documentation and handover to the corporate archive

• Interface management with external partners (e.g. suppliers)

• Ensuring compliance and documentation in line with applicable standards (e.g. ISO 9001)

Your Profile

• Completed vocational training or degree in document management, information technology or a comparable field

• At least 5 years of professional experience in large infrastructure or industrial projects

• Proven experience in implementing and using common DMG systems and virtual project rooms

• Strong organisational skills and structured thinking

• Strong communication skills and a team-oriented approach

• High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information

What We Offer

• Permanent position with a growing, specialised company

• Involvement in international onshore and offshore energy projects

• Collaboration with top players in the offshore wind industry

• Long-term prospects, responsibility and room to shape your role

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-syste.title: Senior Software Engineer, Systems Integration
arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-syste.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability

At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

•
Design and build reliable, deterministic interfaces and drivers, from drafting the first interface control document (ICDs), to testing with state-of-the-art HITL simulators.

•
Own the validation logic between the planning software and the hardware.

•
Build diagnostics and secure software-update paths for deployed equipment.

•
Build SITL emulators for the hardware you integrate, so the simulation team and CI can test against them.

•
Lead the software side of qualification. Write the verification plan, build requirements traceability from requirement to test to result, and make sure every release ships with its test evidence and a controlled configuration.

•
Own the software assurance pipeline in CI/CD: reproducible builds, secure boot and OS hardening, code signing, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and static analysis.

•
Use AI coding agents as normal engineering tools: to draft tests, interface code and emulators, to check traceability links, and to prepare evidence. You decide where they are used and how their output is reviewed. Engineers own and sign the evidence.

Who you are

•
A software engineer with 5+ years' experience integrating software with hardware in aerospace, defence, rail, automotive, medical or another regulated field.

•
Strong modern C++. Rust is welcome. Python for test automation and tooling.

•
Hands-on with hardware interfaces and protocols: Ethernet (UDP/TCP), serial, and fieldbuses such as CAN, plus time synchronisation (PTP, GNSS time).

•
You have taken software through a formal verification or qualification campaign: requirements-based testing, traceability, and configuration and change control.

•
Comfortable with HITL testing; debugging across the hardware/software boundary.

•
Able to explain technical risk clearly to systems and safety engineers, and to customers and assessors.

•
You use AI agents in your own work, and you have clear views on where they help and where they don't.

What we offer

• A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

• Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

• High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

• A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

• A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

• Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO

• Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market

• Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives

• Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies

• Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs

• Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs

• Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood

• Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business

• Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility

• Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field

• 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe

• Professional fluency in German and English

• Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions

• Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring

• Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes

• Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

• Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors

• Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies

• Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting

• Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem

• Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our: Data Privacy Policy.
WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Focused Energy’s Software Department builds the internal applications, data workflows, system integrations and automation that help our scientists, finance, legal, people and executive teams work faster and more reliably. As a Software Engineer in our forward deployed model, you will join projects where Focused Energy has an important technical or operational need, understand the context, build and deliver a reliable solution, complete a clean handover, and then move on to the next priority.
You will quickly learn several project domains across fusion systems, finance, legal and executive work, and you will own moderately complex features from design to deployment. You will be a go-to engineer for turning cross-functional needs into maintainable software, raising the standard for internal tools, and helping us reuse shared platforms and patterns.
You will see your work directly shape how fusion research and company operations run. You will gain broad exposure to scientific, hardware, operational and business problems, and you will take ownership from day one.

• Add automated tests, logging, metrics, error handling and basic operational guidance to the software you deliver.

• Move between projects after delivering agreed outcomes, leaving software tested, documented, maintainable and ready for its long-term owner.

• Improve code quality, remove small areas of technical debt, contribute to code reviews, and reuse shared platforms and patterns where they fit.

• Learn several project domains quickly, deliver your first end-to-end features, and establish a reliable routine for testing, documentation and handover.

• Understanding of relational databases and SQL, including schemas, migrations, permissions and data modeling.

• Experience integrating software through REST APIs, events, scheduled jobs or similar communication patterns.

• Ability to use tests, logs, metrics and traces to find problems and confirm that software works as expected.

• Ability to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly for learning, prototyping, testing, documentation and delivery, reviewing output to the same quality and security standard as other work.

• Ability to learn new languages, frameworks, systems and technical domains, and a willingness to move between projects after completing agreed work.

• Ability to turn the needs of non-software specialists into clear technical requirements and to explain software decisions in simple language.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with TypeScript, React, SQL, PostgreSQL, serverless functions or Azure services.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including serverless or managed application platforms.

• Experience working in a monorepo or with shared packages, reusable components and common engineering tooling.

• Experience with database security, row-level permissions, identity providers, single sign-on or role-based access control.

arbeitnow:operations-manager-fur-warmeco.description:
Wer wir sind
Kola NetZero bringt Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern mit einem führenden Anbieter für Wärmecontracting zusammen: Der Eigentümer bekommt eine neue, klimafreundliche Heizzentrale ohne eigene Investition, der Anbieter betreibt sie 15 Jahre lang, und wir begleiten den Weg von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Unterschrift. Hinter Kola NetZero steht die Kola Invest GmbH, ein Hamburger Family Office mit Fokus auf Wohnimmobilien.
Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großem Ziel: mehrere tausend Wohneinheiten pro Monat in die Wärmewende zu bringen. Dafür bauen wir gerade das Backoffice auf, das aus eingereichten Objekten vertragsreife Projekte macht. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und prägst, wie wir arbeiten.
Deine Aufgaben
Du verantwortest den Weg eines Objekts vom Eingang bis zur Freigabe durch den Anbieter. Konkret:

• Pipeline steuern: 50 bis 100 Objekte gleichzeitig im Prozess halten. Du weißt jederzeit, welches Objekt in welcher Phase steckt, was blockiert und was als Nächstes dran ist, und berichtest das wöchentlich an die Geschäftsführung.

• Objekteingang prüfen: Energieausweise, Heizkostenabrechnungen, Gasrechnungen und Objektlisten der Eigentümer sichten, Daten in unsere Portfolioliste übertragen und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen.

• Technischen Fit bewerten: Zentral oder dezentral, Energieträger, Kesselalter, Anzahl Wohneinheiten, Warmwasserbereitung. Du entscheidest mit, welche Objekte an den Anbieter gehen und welche nicht.

• Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können.

• Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt.

• Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben.

• Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten.

• Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist.

Dein Profil
Erfahrung

• 3 bis 7 Jahre in einer Rolle, in der du viele Vorgänge parallel koordiniert hast, zum Beispiel:

• Projektleitung oder Projektassistenz bei einem Heizungsbauer, Energieversorger, Messdienst oder Contracting-Anbieter

• Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung

• Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup

• Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft.

Projektmanagement

• Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat.

• Du kannst mit Eigentümern, Hausverwaltungen und Technikern gleichermaßen reden und hakst freundlich nach, auch zum dritten Mal wegen derselben Abrechnung.

• Du definierst Übergabepunkte und Fristen, hältst sie nach und kannst jederzeit sagen, wo die Pipeline steht.

Fachlich

• Du kannst einen Energieausweis und eine Heizkostenabrechnung lesen und weißt, was eine Gasetagenheizung von einer Zentralheizung unterscheidet.

• Du verstehst, wie eine Hausverwaltung arbeitet, was eine WEG ist und wer beim Eigentümer entscheidet.

• Du rechnest gern, prüfst Zahlen auf Plausibilität und kannst eine Vergleichsrechnung erklären.

Arbeitsweise und Tools

• Sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets, idealerweise hast du schon ein CRM oder Ticketsystem betrieben.

• Du schreibst Prozesse selbst auf und verbesserst sie, statt sie nur abzuarbeiten.

• Offen für KI-Tools im Alltag, weil ein großer Teil der Dokumentenauswertung darüber läuft.

• Deutsch verhandlungssicher.

Pluspunkte: Kenntnisse im GEG oder CO2KostAufG, Erfahrung mit Wärmecontracting oder Energieberatung, Aufbau eines Backoffice von null.
Was wir nicht suchen: Reine Sachbearbeitung ohne Koordinationserfahrung, oder Konzern-PMO mit Projekten, die 200 Tage Vorlauf haben. Bei uns sind die Projekte klein, viele und schnell.
Was wir bieten

• Eine Rolle mit direktem Einfluss: Jedes Objekt, das du vertragsreif machst, ersetzt eine alte Gas- oder Ölheizung.

• Aufbauarbeit statt Verwaltung: Du definierst die Prozesse, die später ein Team von 4 bis 5 Leuten nutzt, und wächst mit in die Leitung von Operations.

• Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Geschäftsführern und mit dem Team unseres Contracting-Partners.

• Festgehalt plus Beteiligung am Erfolg, abhängig von den vermittelten Wohneinheiten.

• Hybrides Arbeiten, Büro in Hamburg

• Moderne Tools: Google Workspace, KI-gestützte Auswertung von Unterlagen, keine Papierakten.

You will own the engine cycle and the top level technical architecture of a pump fed liquid rocket engine.   • Build, maintain and validate engine cycle models across nominal, throttled and off nominal operating conditions, including start up and shutdown transients.
  • Lead cycle trade studies and sensitivity analyses to optimise performance and identify design drivers, constraints and technical risks.
  • Perform top level engine sizing and define the principal operating points and component interface conditions.

  • Own the top level engine requirements, assumptions, interface definitions and technical budgets.
  • Act as the technical decision driver for cross functional design issues, and keep decisions documented, traceable and backed by analysis and test evidence.
  • Own the technical development roadmap and timeline: guide design iterations, prioritise maturation activities, and define the analyses, breadboards and tests that retire the highest risks.
  • Coordinate technical reviews and give clear recommendations to Propulsion leadership and to the programme and vehicle teams.

 

Qualification Checklist 

  • MSc in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering or a comparable technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Excellent understanding of engine cycles, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics and turbomachinery power balance.
  • Steady state cycle modelling, top level engine sizing and performance prediction.
  • Experience planning and coordinating multidisciplinary engine development or test campaigns, and driving a technical roadmap to agreed timelines.

arbeitnow:director-customer-compensation.title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
arbeitnow:director-customer-compensation.description:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.
  • Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.
  • Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.
  • Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

  • Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.
  • A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.
  • Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.
  • Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

What we offer

  • Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg
  • Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products
  • Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget
  • Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget 
  • Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program
  • Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.
  • Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes
  • Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill
  • Childcare and company pension scheme benefit
  • Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT

arbeitnow:phd-researcher-knowledge-disco.description:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

  • Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
  • Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
  • Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
  • Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
  • Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
  • Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
  • A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.
  • Documented experience in practical research work.
  • Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

  • Expected start date: September, 2026

Application package must include: 

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts ;
  • A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;
  • 2 recommendation letters;

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

About the Position

The research group of Dr. Sari Sadiya at Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor University (CU) and Constructor Technology (CT), invites applicants for Ph.D. student positions in Computer Science with a focus on wearable intelligence, multimodal data fusion, and edge AI.

The project investigates how wearable data streams can be transformed into structured knowledge and integrated into a knowledge-grounded digital avatar that supports bi-directional collaboration in education and research.

Ph.D. students will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment, combining AI/ML, edge computing, cognitive science, and human–computer interaction. In close collaboration with academia and industry, they will contribute to building privacy-preserving, real-time personalization frameworks while pursuing their doctoral dissertation.

About the Program

The PhD program is research-centered, emphasizing original contributions in:

  • Wearable data analytics and fusion methods
  • Biomedical data analytics
  • On-device processing and performance modeling
  • Personalization and adaptive reasoning systems
  • AI for Education

Doctoral students will also have access to specialized courses in:

  • Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Edge Computing
  • Advanced Computational Methods and Data Science
  • Cognitive Science and Human-Centered Computing

As part of the program, students will collaborate with Constructor Technology to gain first-hand industrial experience, contributing to real-world testbeds and prototypes.

Research Focus

This PhD position is part of the Wearable Intelligence Project, with two main research directions:

  • Data fusion of heterogeneous temporal streams
    • Designing algorithms to unify multimodal signals (physiological, cognitive, contextual, scheduling, and learning data).
    • Developing pipelines that produce structured insights powering the Agentic Personalization Engine (APE).
  • On-device data processing & performance modeling
    • Developing models balancing computation, energy, and data flows across wearable, edge, and cloud environments.
    • Exploring feasibility of running compact micro-LLMs directly on wearables.

The overarching goal is to create scalable, ethical, and transparent personalization systems that support education and research.

Funding

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Cognitive Science, or related disciplines.

arbeitnow:senior-product-manager-munich-.description:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

• Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.

• Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.

• Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.

• Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.

• Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.

• Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.

• Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.

• Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.

• Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.

• Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.

• Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

• Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.

• Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.

• Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.

• Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.

• Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.

• Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.

• An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.

• Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

• Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.

• Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.

• Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.

• Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.

• Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.

• Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

What we offer

Culture and growth

• A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

• Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.

• Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.

• Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

• Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

• Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.

• Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket.

• Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.

• Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.

• Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

arbeitnow:regional-operations-director-b.description:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers.

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

• Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations

• Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability

• Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements

• Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots

• Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

•
Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

• Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control

• Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives

• Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality

• Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

• Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region

• Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region

• Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

• Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)

• 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.

• You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.

• You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.

• You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.

• You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.

• You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.

• You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.

• You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.

• You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.

• You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.

• You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.

• Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

• Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.

• A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.

• Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.

• Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.

• A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

• A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact

• Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila

• Continuous training and coaching

• Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

arbeitnow:global-investigator-emea-16894.description:
Build a Safer World.
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.
The impact you will have:

• Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

• Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

• Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

• Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

• Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

• 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

• Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

• Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

• Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

• The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

• Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

• Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

• Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

• Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

• React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

• Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

• Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

• Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

• First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

• Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

• References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

• Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

• Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

• Accelerate repeatable workflows

• Structure and solve problems

• Improve output quality

• Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
At TRM, you should expect:

• Priorities and targets to change quickly

• Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

• A high level of personal ownership and accountability

• Close collaboration across teams and functions

• Frequent, high-touch communication

• Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

• A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.
We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.
If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles
We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

• Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

• Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

• Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission
At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.
TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information
By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

arbeitnow:event-manager-munich-318022.description:
WHO WE ARE
Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.
As Event Manager, you will be Proxima Fusion in Munich, you will plan and deliver events ranging from investor dinners and international conferences to community engagement, exhibitions and team retreats. Your will translate strategic briefs into effective event formats and independently manage delivery, from planning and budgets, to on-site production and follow-up.
This is a hands-on role combining creative judgment,meticulous project management and team spirit. You will bring event expertise to the table, advise internal stakeholders on what will work and take responsibility for turning plans into successful experiences.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

• You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

• You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

• Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

• Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

• Events achieve the objectives agreed with each team and provide a considered, professional experience with Proxima for our guests and stakeholders.

• Delivery stays on schedule and within agreed budgets, with risks, dependencies and changes managed early.

• A coordinated event portfolio gives teams visibility of upcoming activity and resource needs, while evaluation and lessons learned improve future delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Translate event objectives, audiences and content briefs into strong formats, detailed delivery plans and well-designed guest experiences.

• Independently manage events, including timelines, budgets, venues, suppliers, logistics, invitations, production, run-of-show, on-site execution and follow-up.

• Deliver events involving investors, policymakers, industrial partners, media and other external stakeholders. These may include executive dinners, partner meetings, or events at our offices.

• Manage Proxima’s presence at conferences, press moments, exhibitions, industry fairs and other high-profile external platforms together with the Communications team.

• Produce community and public engagement events in Garching and Gundremmingen, working with the teams responsible for local communications and engagement.

• Deliver meetings and events for Proxima’s industrial partnership network, including the Alpha Alliance.

• Organise internal events that build the social foundation on which the company is built: company parties, team retreats and occasional other events.

• Support recruiting events: career fairs, university formats, hiring days and technical meet-ups with People.

• Select, brief and manage agencies, venues and suppliers, including procurement, contract coordination and quality control.

• Maintain an overview of Proxima’s event portfolio and forward calendar, identifying dependencies, resource conflicts and delivery risks early.

• Track expenditure, evaluate events against agreed objectives and capture lessons that improve future delivery.

WHO YOU ARE

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in event management or production, ideally across corporate, conference, institutional or cultural formats

• A strong record of independently delivering complex events from initial brief through on-site production and follow-up.

• Excellent project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple events, budgets, deadlines and external partners simultaneously.

• The judgment to translate a strategic brief into an effective event format, combined with the confidence to advise and challenge different internal stakeholders where necessary.

• Experience working with senior stakeholders and high-profile guests, such as executives, investors, government representatives or industrial partners.

• Strong supplier and agency management skills, including briefing, negotiation and quality control.

• A hands-on approach and exceptional attention to detail. You anticipate problems, remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions when plans change.

• Fluent English and German.

• Willingness to travel within Europe and work occasional evenings or weekends around event dates.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

• Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

• Technical Screening (30 min)

• Technical Panel (3x60 min)

*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.
At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

• Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum.
