About us
Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.
 
We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.
 
The role
We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.
 
Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.
 
Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.
 
Problems you'll work on

• Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback.

• Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter.

• Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

• One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.

What you'll do

• Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

• Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

• Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

• Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

• Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

• Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

• Take prototypes from your research-focused teammates and turn them into shipped features

• Contribute to platform design decisions, take part in design reviews and help us hire

• Work with Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Kubernetes and GCP/AWS
 

Who we're looking for

• An owner. You take ambiguous product needs, make the architecture calls and carry the work all the way into production.

• A systems thinker. You design for scale and reuse, and you know when a simple, solid baseline beats a clever solution.

• A great collaborator. You enjoy working across research, product and engineering, and you make it easier for everyone to ship.

• A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 
Experience requirements

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time building and operating ML systems or model-backed products in production at scale

• Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals

• Hands-on experience deploying modern deep learning models in production, with a strong understanding of model serving, inference optimisation, GPU utilisation and performance trade-offs.

• Experience designing and operating scalable, distributed production systems, ideally involving GPU workloads, high-throughput data processing or low-latency inference.

• The ability to reason through an ML system end to end, from data and model choices to offline and online evaluation, deployment, monitoring and retraining

• A track record of personally owning complex systems from design through to production

• Bonus: computer vision or multimodal deployment experience (not required), model-serving frameworks, or experience with video, 3D or other complex data types

 
Why Encord

• Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

• Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

• 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

• Annual learning & development budget

• Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

• Daily company lunches

About Isembard
Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. The role
Inspection is the last point where a mistake is cheap to fix, and at our London factory it decides how quickly finished parts reach customers.
As a CMM Programmer you will programme, set and run coordinate measuring machines to verify high-precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics customers. You will work alongside machinists, CAM programmers and quality engineers so that what leaves the factory conforms.
What you'll do

• Write, simulate and optimise CMM programmes for complex geometry and tight tolerances.

• Choose probing, fixturing and datum strategies, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

• Carry out first article inspection (AS9102 / EN 9102), in-process checks and final inspection.

• Find non-conformances before they reach a customer, and feed corrective actions back into production with machining and CAM.

• Look after calibration and maintenance of CMMs, gauges and hand tools.

What we're looking for

• Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

• Strong PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso, Renishaw Modus or comparable software skills.

• Practical knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and ISO GPS, and confidence with complex drawings and 3D CAD.

• Proven ability to inspect tolerances of ±0.01 mm and below.

• Experience with aerospace inspection documentation, including FAI.

Nice to have

• SPC, capability analysis or measurement system analysis.

• AS9100 / EN 9100 experience.

• In-process probing on 5-axis machines.

• High-mix, low-to-medium volume production.

Why Isembard

• Work at the centre of the factory's quality, on advanced machines and metrology equipment.

• Help set inspection standards other sites reuse.

Strategy & Operations chez Pennylane :

Ensuite, nous concevons et implémentons des solutions efficientes et scalables qui permettent à Pennylane d’atteindre et dépasser ses plans de croissance (de 110 000 à 1 200 000 clients entre 2024 et aujourd'hui). Pour déplacer ces montagnes, nos équipes Strategy & Operations travaillent au quotidien avec les équipes Tech (développeurs, Product Manager) et Data (Scientists, Analysts…).

Améliorer de façon très significative la productivité des équipes par une meilleure utilisation des outils et une forte simplification.

Tu seras la/le responsable, l’interlocuteur.trice privilégié.e et la personne qui drive le changement au sein du département Customer Success (CS), aux côtés des managers opérationnels en charge des services professionnels, du support client et des chargés de comptes.

- De donner de la visibilité au niveau ops et data : aller comprendre au niveau corporate les challenges auxquels les équipes font face afin d’en anticiper et de comprendre les impacts sur le CS.

Nous recherchons un profil ambitieux, avec de précédentes expériences réussies sur des enjeux de transformation, d’amélioration de productivité et de gestion de projets.

- Expérience complète de la gestion de projet : tu sais cadrer un problème rapidement, livrer vite et itérer, sans attendre que tout soit parfait

- Mindset business

arbeitnow:it-support-administrator-w-m-p.title: IT Support Administrator W/M
arbeitnow:it-support-administrator-w-m-p.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France
(and tomorrow in Europe)?
Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?
Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and
Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and
finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the
best decisions for their business.

About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)
In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small
businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon
Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and
much more...
‍‍‍ Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of
the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong
remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of
Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding
ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000
accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact
Every great employee experience starts with great IT.
At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our
teams can focus on building the future of finance.

As an IT Support Administrator , you'll be one of the main points of contact for our
employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to
building an IT environment that scales with our growth.

What you'll do

Deliver an outstanding IT experience
Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the
most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience.

Employee onboarding & offboarding
You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one.
From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they
need to work successfully.
You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to
our IT environment and security best practices.
You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external
partners.

Keep our IT environment secure
Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of
everyone's daily habits.
You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review
permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company.

Manage our internal tools
You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and
ensuring employees have the right access at the right time.
You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools.

Share knowledge
You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company.
That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering
onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security.

Who are you?
We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT
fundamentals.
Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously
improving the employee experience.
You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine.
What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to take
ownership.

Why you'll love this role
● You'll work with every team across the company.
● You'll have real ownership from day one.
● You'll continuously improve our internal IT experience.
● You'll play a key role in scaling the internal IT environment of one of Europe's
fastest-growing fintechs.

We'd love to meet you if...
● You enjoy helping people and delivering a great employee experience.
● You have previous experience in IT Support, Workplace IT or IT Administration.
● You're proactive and enjoy taking ownership.
● You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.
● You're curious and enjoy learning new tools.
● You're comfortable administering modern workplace tools. Experience with Google
Workspace, Microsoft 365, Jamf, Intune, Okta or similar platforms is a plus.
● You care about security and access management (experience with ISO 27001 or
SOC 2 is a plus).
● You're fluent in English and French.

What do we do to make your work life easier
🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane
💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package
📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us
🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a
monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it
⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and
more than 300 activities related to wellness
You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French
💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment
🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work
remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum
time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days
(which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar,
fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.
If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on
top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue
healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon,
Bordeaux, Nantes...)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as
well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?
To thrive at Pennylane, you need :
● To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department
you’re applying to)
● To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
● To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
● Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they
meet the full list of criteria.
If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a
meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your
exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings
published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).
Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional
email addresses with the domains @ pennylane.com or @ pennylane-partners.com
We will never ask you for payment or financial information
(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the
recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not
respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that
we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.
We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender,
sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If
anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

arbeitnow:principal-thermo-mechanical-en.title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
arbeitnow:principal-thermo-mechanical-en.description:
About Us
We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.
Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.
Role Overview
As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.
As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.
Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.
You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.
This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team .
Responsibilities

• Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

• Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

• Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

• Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

• Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

• Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

• Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

• Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

• Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

• Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

• Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

• Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

• Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

• Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

• Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

• Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

• Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

• Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

• Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci
Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.
C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.
Présentation du poste
En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.
En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.
Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. arbeitnow:director-enterprise-france-par.description:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
 
How you'll make impact
We're expanding our senior commercial leadership footprint across France to accelerate growth across Airwallex's enterprise solutions. You'll lead the enterprise commercial organisation in France, combining strategic direction with operational sales execution across a complex, multi-product platform.

• Lead and scale an enterprise commercial organisation of 30+ people, including three Enterprise Sales Directors, to drive performance, accountability and operational excellence across France.

• Own France's enterprise KPI and total regional revenue performance, introducing the sales discipline, forecasting rigour and ways of working needed to support sustained growth.

• Define and execute the enterprise commercial strategy across core target verticals, expanding market share across Airwallex's full platform, including global business accounts, FX and treasury, spend management, global payments and embedded finance.

• Sponsor and help close strategic, high-value enterprise opportunities worth $2M+ in contract value, building trusted relationships with French C-suite stakeholders and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

• Partner with regional and global leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Solutions Engineering and Product to turn market insight into stronger GTM execution, product alignment and seamless enterprise client onboarding.

You'll work from our Paris, France office three days a week.

What we're looking for
Essentials

• 12+ years of experience in B2B enterprise sales within high-growth fintech, payments or enterprise software/SaaS environments.

• 5+ years of direct people management experience, including experience managing managers and Director-level sales leaders.

• A track record of leading a sizable enterprise sales organisation of 30+ people.

• A personal track record of closing or sponsoring complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals valued at $2M+ ACV.

• Experience leading sales turnarounds, implementing new ways of working and establishing high-performing sales cultures in scaling organisations.

• Deep experience in complex, multi-product platform selling, such as cross-border payments, global banking infrastructure, FX and treasury or developer platform SaaS.

• A pure commercial leadership background focused on revenue execution, pipeline growth and deal closing, rather than general operations or general management.

• Professional fluency in French and English, and based in or willing to relocate to France.

Preferred

• Commercial leadership experience at a leading fintech or enterprise SaaS company, such as Stripe, Adyen, Datadog, Snowflake, Cloudflare or MongoDB.

• An established network of C-suite decision-makers across major French enterprises, technology scale-ups and multinationals, including CFOs, Treasurers, CTOs and Procurement leaders.

• Strong knowledge of global banking systems, FX risk management, treasury operations, card issuing or embedded finance infrastructure.

• Experience operating with high autonomy in fast-paced, matrixed and rapidly evolving environments.

You'll thrive here if

• You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

• You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

• You're energized by change. Your grow happens in steps, not a straight line, and priorities shift as you learn.

• You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

• You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

Learn more about your team
Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.
It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it.
Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About the Team
OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Creative Partnerships team supports that mission by building trusted relationships with creators, experts, and organizations to help them explore valuable uses of AI.
We work across OpenAI to develop partnerships grounded in trust, usefulness, and measurable impact. Our work goes beyond individual launches and includes product education, partner feedback, and collaborative programs that create lasting value for partners and OpenAI.

About the Role
We are seeking a Strategic Partner Lead to build and manage trusted relationships on behalf of OpenAI in Europe.
You will identify and develop strategic partnerships that help people explore meaningful uses of AI and create value for OpenAI and the partners we work with. As the relationship owner, you will guide opportunities from initial engagement through development, execution, and ongoing growth, coordinating across product, technical, marketing, and other internal teams.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with an established network, strong strategic judgment, product curiosity, and a track record of turning relationships into successful partnerships.
Domestic and occasional international travel should be expected.

In This Role, You Will

• Originate, develop, and grow trusted external relationships.

• Serve as the primary owner for a portfolio of strategic partners.

• Understand partners’ goals, audiences, businesses, and concerns.

• Identify meaningful applications of OpenAI’s products and develop partnership plans around them.

• Lead opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation, execution, evaluation, and ongoing growth.

• Develop clear narratives and value propositions for prospective partnerships.

• Coordinate closely with teams across Product, Marketing, Communications, Global Affairs, Research, Legal, and Safety.

• Represent partner perspectives and share relevant insights with internal teams.

• Evaluate opportunities based on alignment, authenticity, feasibility, potential impact, and risk.

• Manage multiple complex relationships and priorities while maintaining a high standard of execution.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

• Have 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or a related field.

• Bring an established external network and a record of building trusted relationships.

• Have experience originating, negotiating, and growing complex partnerships.

• Can identify valuable opportunities and clearly articulate why they matter.

• Quickly understand a partner’s business, audience, incentives, and concerns.

• Are curious about technology and can identify relevant product applications.

• Bring strong judgment around trust, rights, safety, reputation, and the sensitivities surrounding AI.

• Communicate effectively with senior external partners and internal product and technical leaders.

• Lead effectively across functions, including when priorities are not fully aligned.

• Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

About OpenAI

About the Team
Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.
The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.
France will be the primary focus within the Southern Europe remit. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role
As Southern Europe B2B Marketing Manager, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Southern Europe, with France as the primary focus.
You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.
You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in Southern Europe. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.
This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused Southern Europe B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the local Consumer Marketing leads: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.
Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.
The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.
Regular travel across Southern Europe, with France as the primary focus, and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

• Own and execute the integrated Southern Europe B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the local Consumer Marketing leads to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

• Carry pipeline goals for Southern Europe B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

• Partner closely with Southern Europe Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

• Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

• Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

• Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

• Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

• Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect Southern Europe market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

• Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of Southern Europe in regional planning and prioritisation.

• Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

• Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

• Own the operating rhythm for Southern Europe B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

• Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with Southern Europe customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

• Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

• Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

• Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

• Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

• Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

• Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

• Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

• Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

• Understand French enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

• Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

• Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

• Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

arbeitnow:international-expansion-paris-.description:
About Us
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.
We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.
We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.
Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.
This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.
You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

• Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

• Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

• Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

• Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

• Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

• Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

• Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.
You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.
This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you
This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Ideally, you would be able to start by February 2027.
Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.
We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.
Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.
You’ll be based in the France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.
The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

• Initial interview

• Take-home exercise

• Final interview (in-person)

• Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

arbeitnow:enterprise-customer-success-fr.description:
About 2501
2501 builds autonomous AI agents that operate directly in the shell to complete real production tasks - not just synthetic evals. We treat LLMs as pluggable brains, mixing open‑source and flagship models to get the best result. By fusing their output with observability data we surface root causes fast and automate the dull parts of incident response for corporate engineering teams who can’t afford downtime.
We’re a tight‑knit team of DevOps, Platform, and Infra engineers who ship fast, learn constantly, and elevate each other every day.
Why 2501 ?
We use AI to solve real problems in the underlying layers of every IT stack. We build what is the future of IT, ensuring every brick of our clients’ infrastructure is up and running.
We discovered an amazing opportunity to make IT more reliable and modern and we’re building the best way to make it a reality. Our customers and investors are backing this with strong commitment and foresee in our mission the future of IT.
We’re backed by three leading European VC funds, giving us the resources to aim high and take risks. And we’re just getting started!
What you’ll do

• Own post-sale relationships with our largest enterprise accounts - banking, telco, and large IT organizations.

• Drive adoption and expansion of 2501 agents inside complex infrastructure environments.

• Be the bridge between the business and the technical teams, translating goals into outcomes.

• Reduce churn by making customers wildly successful and spotting risk before it grows.

• Partner with product and engineering to feed real customer signal back into the roadmap.

Who you are

• Enterprise CS or TAM background in infrastructure, DevOps, or observability.

• Technical enough to talk shop with SRE and platform teams.

• Calm and credible under enterprise pressure, with a track record of growing accounts.

• Bilingual French & English speaker and based in or near Paris. (Please don’t apply if you don’t have the right to work in France, we are not offering visa sponsorship for this role and language requirements are mandatory)

• Startup or tech scaleup experience would be a plus, you need a high degree of autonomy and ownership

Not for you if

• You want a purely reactive support-desk role.

• You’d rather not get hands-on with technical infrastructure conversations.

Why you’ll enjoy working here

• Fully remote – work from anywhere in the EU; we have a soft preference for the Paris region or somewhere easily reachable, and keep core hours in CET for smooth collaboration.

• Competitive pay & meaningful equity – you own a piece of what you build.

• Small global team, big impact – your work ships to users the same day. We’re still small enough that every new hire changes the company; this isn’t a seat maintaining a corner of a big machine. People joining now will help shape the product, the engineering culture, and the way we build agents for enterprise infrastructure.

• Learn from the best – Built by people who’ve done it before. CTO Alex Zhuk ran the Shop Infrastructure Group at Shopify and spent years in platform and infra roles at Klarna and Omio; CEO Alexandre Pereira is on his third company. We only hire exceptional people, people who have built difficult things.

Hiring process

• 30min Intro with recruiter

• 30min Hiring Manager interview

• 60min Live Scenario interview

• 30min Coffee chat with CTO (Co-founder of 2501.ai )

How to apply
Send us something you’ve built or a few lines on why this role interests you.
We hire for skill, drive, and curiosity – not credentials.

arbeitnow:programmeur-mmt-controleur-qua.description:
Lieu : Wissous, Essonne (Usine)
Type de contrat : CDI, temps plein
Salaire : Compétitif
Equity : Aligné sur le marché
Présentation du poste :
Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble du contrôle dimensionnel chez Isembard France - de la programmation MMT (CMM) et du contrôle premier article jusqu'à l'analyse des causes racines des non-conformités et la préparation aux audits.
Vous construisez la fonction métrologie plutôt que d'en hériter. Cela signifie écrire les programmes de contrôle, définir les stratégies de palpage et de références, mettre en place l'étalonnage des moyens de mesure et décider comment les données qualité remontent vers l'usinage et vers MasonOS.
C'est un poste opérationnel, à forte autonomie, au sein d'une équipe fondatrice de quelques personnes. Il n'y a ni services cloisonnés ni passages de relais. Vous programmez, vous mesurez, vous validez.
Responsabilités principales :

• Développer, programmer et optimiser les gammes de contrôle MMT (PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso ou équivalent) pour des géométries complexes et des tolérances serrées

• Interpréter les plans, les cotations GD&T et ISO GPS, ainsi que les exigences de contrôle et de documentation spécifiques aux clients

• Réaliser les contrôles premier article (FAI / EN 9102), les contrôles en cours de production et la validation finale des pièces pour l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et le médical

• Définir la stratégie de palpage, le bridage et les systèmes de références ; concevoir des montages de contrôle si nécessaire

• Analyser les données de mesure pour identifier les tendances, les causes racines des non-conformités et les problèmes de capabilité, et ramener les actions correctives jusqu'à la machine

• Piloter l'étalonnage et le suivi de l'ensemble des moyens de mesure (MMT, calibres, micromètres, pieds à coulisse, colonnes de mesure)

• Tenir à jour les programmes MMT, les enregistrements de contrôle et la documentation qualité selon les normes EN 9100 / ISO 9001

• Travailler directement avec nos usineurs et programmeurs FAO pour résoudre les problèmes d'ajustement, de forme et de fonction avant et pendant la production

• Accompagner les audits clients et de certification, et contribuer à la certification EN 9100 de l'usine

• Collaborer avec l'équipe logicielle MasonOS pour que les données de contrôle soient capturées et exploitées, pas simplement archivées

Compétences requises :

• Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique en programmation MMT dans la fabrication de précision, l'aéronautique ou un atelier d'usinage

• Solide maîtrise pratique de PC-DMIS et/ou Zeiss Calypso

• Connaissance approfondie du GD&T (ASME Y14.5) et de l'ISO GPS, et aisance dans la lecture des modèles CAO 3D clients

• Expérience de la documentation de contrôle aéronautique (FAI, AS9102 / EN 9102, inspection à la source)

• À l'aise sur l'ensemble des moyens de mesure : MMT à portique, outils manuels, calibres, et équipements optiques ou de scanning

• Capacité à tenir et vérifier des tolérances serrées (±0,01 mm et en deçà si nécessaire)

• Fort instinct analytique - vous trouvez la cause, pas seulement l'écart

• À l'aise dans un environnement rapide, à forte autonomie et sans structure établie

Atouts supplémentaires :

• Expérience de la construction d'une fonction qualité à partir de zéro, ou de l'accompagnement d'un site vers la certification EN 9100 / AS9100

• Certification GD&T ou qualification en management de la qualité

• Expérience du palpage en cours d'usinage sur machines 5 axes et de la correction en boucle fermée

• SPC et analyse statistique de capabilité des procédés

• Expérience en atelier à forte diversité de pièces et petites à moyennes séries

• Maîtrise de l'anglais

Ce que nous offrons :

• Travailler sur des composants critiques pour l'aéronautique et la défense

• Prendre en main la fonction qualité d'une nouvelle usine dès le premier jour, plutôt qu'un recoin d'une usine existante

• Accès à des machines-outils de pointe, des équipements de métrologie et une automatisation en constante évolution

• Participation au capital (equity) d'un réseau d'usines en pleine croissance

• Opportunité de définir les standards de contrôle à l'échelle du réseau au fur et à mesure de notre développement

• Culture de haute performance axée sur l'amélioration continue

À propos d'Isembard :
Isembard a pour mission de forger l'accélération industrielle. Nous permettons de fabriquer des produits plus rapidement et à moindre coût pour les industries critiques, en combinant des machines-outils de pointe, la robotique et notre logiciel propriétaire, MasonOS. Les composants que nous fabriquons sont utilisés dans l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et d'autres secteurs stratégiques. Nous construisons un réseau distribué d'usines haute performance au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne et désormais en France. Notre site français est une nouvelle usine à Wissous, en Essonne, au sud de Paris.

Schweizer Engineering für die Software von morgen.
novu baut keine Lösungen von der Stange, sondern Individualsoftware, die zum Geschäft unserer Kunden passt. Wir definieren, entwickeln, betreiben und erweitern sie, alles im Haus und alles in der Schweiz, mit rund 50 Leuten in Zürich und Bern. novu gehört zur Union Group AG, einer Gruppe von Schweizer Agenturen für digitale Kommunikation.
Software entsteht mit AI immer schneller. Umso mehr zählt, wer versteht, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, und wer ihr Vertrauen über Jahre gewinnt. Genau dafür bist du da: Als Head of Consulting verantwortest du das Neugeschäft von novu, führst unser Consulting-Team und prägst, wie wir beraten. Du berichtest an den CEO und arbeitest im Führungsteam eng mit CTO und Head of Operations zusammen. Arbeiten kannst du wahlweise von Zürich oder Bern aus.
Was du bei uns machst

• Du verantwortest das Neugeschäft: Du baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf, gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu, führst Pitches und schliesst Aufträge ab. Du kennst deine Zahlen und steuerst danach.

• Du betreust einige Schlüsselkunden selbst und berätst Geschäftsleitungen auf Augenhöhe. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team baust du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus und ziehst die Schwesteragenturen der Union Group AG bei, wo sie deinen Kunden weiterhelfen.

• Du führst das Consulting-Team: Du rekrutierst, gibst klares Feedback, führst die Standortgespräche und entwickelst die Beratungskompetenz jeder Person gezielt weiter.

• Du prägst, wie novu berät: Du setzt Standards für Angebote, Kundenführung und eine schlanke Projektführung und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.

• Mit CTO und Head of Operations stimmst du Prioritäten und Kapazitäten ab, damit wir halten, was wir verkaufen.

• Gemeinsam mit dem CEO entwickelst du Angebot und Preismodelle weiter, gerade dort, wo AI verändert, wie Software entsteht und was Kunden dafür bezahlen. Den Einsatz von AI im Consulting treibst du selbst voran.

Was du mitbringst

arbeitnow:certification-engineer-nyon-34.description:
About EH Energy Engineering
EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.
To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.
This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate .

Key responsibilities
Certification strategy and project management

• Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

• Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

• Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

• Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

• Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

• Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

• Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

• Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

• Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

• Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

• Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

• Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

• Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope
The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

• IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

• Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

• 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

• Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

• Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

• Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

• Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

• Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

• Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

• Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile
Nice to have

• Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

• Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

• Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

• Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

• Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

• Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

• Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

• Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

Reporting to the Fractional HR leader based in the US, you will help build scalable, consistent people practices while providing responsive support to employees and managers.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys quick execution to make an impact, owning the details, building relationships, and balancing multiple priorities in a growing organization.

Talent Acquisition

• Source candidates through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion and sound judgment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

• Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

• Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.

arbeitnow:business-development-manager-s.title: Business Development Manager
arbeitnow:business-development-manager-s.description:
Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen.
Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl?
Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben.
Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht.
Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte.
Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung
Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.
Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen.
Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist.
Was du bei uns bewegst

• Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen.

• Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse.

• Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren.

• Mit KI besser arbeiten: Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, testest neue Anwendungen und verbesserst die Qualität und Effizienz unserer Recherchen, Analysen und Prozesse.

• Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen.

• Überzeugend argumentieren: Du erstellst klare Präsentationen, fundierte Business Cases, überzeugende Angebote und aussagekräftige Kundenreviews, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen sichtbar machen.

• Für Fortschritt sorgen: Du setzt klare Prioritäten und hältst Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte in HubSpot aktuell. Du hältst Zusagen ein und gehst Hindernisse frühzeitig an.

• Teams verbinden: Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen gemeinsam mit Product, Operations und Technology und leitest daraus verständliche Empfehlungen für Kunden und das Team ab.

• Den Status quo hinterfragen: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, hinterfragst Annahmen und machst aus kreativen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen.

Was du mitbringst

• Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung.

• Relevante praktische Erfahrung im Business Development, in der Beratung, in einem Technologieunternehmen oder im unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du kannst zeigen, welche Projekte du verantwortet und welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast.

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen und Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und klar und einfach zu erklären.

• Grosses Interesse an der Mobilität der nächsten Generation und an den Technologien, Geschäftsmodellen und Verhaltensänderungen, die die Branche prägen. Idealerweise kennst du die betriebliche Mobilitätslandschaft bereits und hast Ideen, wie sie sich verbessern lässt.

• Gutes Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst Zielkonflikte abwägen, Wesentliches priorisieren und vorankommen, ohne auf vollständige Informationen zu warten.

• Tatkraft und einen kreativen Zugang zur Problemlösung. Du entwickelst Vorschläge, überprüfst Annahmen und findest Wege, Dinge voranzubringen.

• Technologieaffinität und praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Copilot sowie das Urteilsvermögen, deren Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Französisch ist ein grosser Vorteil.

Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Haltung.
Du bringst Begeisterung, Ehrgeiz und eine lösungsorientierte Einstellung mit. Du lernst schnell, stellst durchdachte Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse. Du achtest auf Details und suchst laufend nach Wegen, gute Arbeit noch besser zu machen.
Du bist selbstbewusst genug, eine Idee zu hinterfragen, und offen genug, deine Meinung zu ändern. Die beste Lösung und der Erfolg des Teams sind dir wichtiger als persönliche Anerkennung. Du suchst Feedback, teilst dein Wissen und arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen, die das genauso halten.
Du probierst Neues aus, gehst bewusst Risiken ein und lernst aus Fehlern. Wenn du auf ein Problem stösst, ergreifst du die Initiative und beziehst andere ein, wenn es sinnvoll ist.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Hohe Ansprüche – und kluge, herzliche Menschen, die dich fordern und weiterbringen.
Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, geben direktes, konstruktives Feedback und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Exzellenz zeigt sich bei uns im Alltag: in durchdachten Lösungen, sorgfältiger Umsetzung und dem Willen, kontinuierlich besser zu werden.
Eine Rolle, die das ganze Unternehmen verbindet.
Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Vertrieb, Customer Success, Technologie und Operations und hilfst dabei, aus Ideen Lösungen zu machen, die Kunden schätzen.
Verantwortung und Raum für Initiative.
Gute Ideen finden bei uns schnell Gehör. Du übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, Dinge voranzubringen, kannst auf die Unterstützung des Teams zählen und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.
Die Möglichkeit, mit Urban Connect zu wachsen.
Mit deinen Ergebnissen und Fähigkeiten wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich. Du hast die Chance, die nächste Entwicklungsphase unseres Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
Dazu kommen:

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein schönes Büro in Zürich.

• Ein monatliches Mobilitätsbudget sowie Zugang zu unseren E-Bikes und geteilten E-Autos.

• Ein motiviertes Team, das gerne gemeinsam und überwiegend vor Ort arbeitet, Wissen teilt und Erfolge zusammen feiert.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?
Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar persönliche Zeilen: Warum Urban Connect? Was begeistert dich an der Zukunft der Mobilität? Und was hast du selbst in die Hand genommen und verbessert?
Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

arbeitnow:intern-power-electronics-engin.title: Intern Power Electronics Engineer
arbeitnow:intern-power-electronics-engin.description:
With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation.
At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving.
As an intern within our Traction Power Systems R&D team, you will support the development and validation of power electronic converters and control solutions used in railway and industrial applications. You will work alongside experienced engineers on innovative projects involving power conversion, control algorithms, testing, and system analysis.

The internship has the duration of 6 months and is expected to start in January 2027, but if that is not the best for you, let us know your availability.

Key responsibilities

• Support the design and analysis of power electronic converters.

• Assist in the development and validation of control algorithms.

• Participate in laboratory testing, measurements, and troubleshooting activities.

• Analyze simulation and test results and prepare technical reports.

• Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation projects within the team.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.

• Strong interest in power converters, control systems, and electrical energy conversion.

• Basic knowledge of power electronics and control theory.

• Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar is an advantage.

• Curious, autonomous, and eager to learn in a hands-on engineering environment.

• Good communication skills in English.
Benefits
A challenging internship in an international engineering environment.
Exposure to real-world power electronics and railway technology projects.
Mentorship from experienced R&D engineers.
Opportunity to develop practical skills in power conversion and control systems.

arbeitnow:erfahrener-sap-personalberater.title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
arbeitnow:erfahrener-sap-personalberater.description:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.
Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt
Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.
Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.
Deine Rolle
Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.
Deine Aufgaben
Kandidatengewinnung

• Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

• Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

• Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

• Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

• Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation

• Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

• Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess

• Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

• Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

• Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

• Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

• Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern

• Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

• Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst

• Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

• Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

• Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

• Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

• Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

• Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

• Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

• Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

• Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

• Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

• Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

• Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest
Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.
Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.
