arbeitnow:research-engineer-index-intell.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
arbeitnow:research-engineer-index-intell.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.
 
Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.
We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

• You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

• Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

• You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

• You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

• You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

• Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

• Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

• Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

• Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

arbeitnow:research-engineer-content-unde.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.
 
Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.
 
As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.
Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.
We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

• Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

• You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

• You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

• You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

• You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

• Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

• Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

• Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

• Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

• Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

• Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

• Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

arbeitnow:software-engineer-knowledge-en.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
arbeitnow:software-engineer-knowledge-en.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.
Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.
In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.
This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

• Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

• Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

• Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

• Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

• Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

• You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

• Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

• Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

• Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

• You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

• You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

• Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

• Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

• Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

• Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

• Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

• Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

• Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

• Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau

• Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung

• Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

• Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines

• Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine

• Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT

• Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443

• Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams

• Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen
Dein Profil

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung

• Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle

• Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript

• Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen

• Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)
Was hier nicht funktioniert

• Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker

• Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis

• Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen

• Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen

• Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln
Deine Benefits
Was diese Rolle besonders macht

• Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers

• Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft

• Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz
Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.
Bereit?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).
Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

About NIRLAB AG
The NIRLAB team at 908 Devices , based in Lausanne, Switzerland, develops advanced handheld spectroscopy solutions that combine near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy with machine learning. Our technology enables rapid, on-the-spot analysis of materials, providing users with immediate insight into material composition wherever it is needed.
NIRLAB was established in 2018 and its technology is used by customers across 40 countries worldwide. Today, as part of 908 Devices , the team contributes its expertise in NIR spectroscopy, machine learning, and handheld analysis to 908 Devices’ broader portfolio of innovative analytical technologies.
Software Engineer position at NIRLAB (80-100%)
We are seeking a proactive, experienced, and innovative Software Engineer to strengthen our software development team. This role focuses on designing, developing, and optimizing software components that power our advanced spectroscopy solution. The main software components are a mobile application, a web platform, and a dedicated ML model runtime. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in at least one of the following domains:

• Mobile app development on Android and iOS, ideally with .NET MAUI

• Frontend development, ideally with Svelte and SvelteKit

• Backend development, ideally with Django and Django rest framework

arbeitnow:customer-success-manager-80-10.description:
Hallo! Ja, DU… Wir suchen Dich!
Als internationales, stark wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der digitalen Immobilienvermarktung suchen wir für unseren Hauptsitz in Lengnau (BE) für den Customer Support eine lösungsorientierte, aufgeschlossene Person, die den Kundenkontakt schätzt .

Deine Aufgaben:

• Als zentrale Ansprechperson betreust und unterstützt du unsere Kunden bei der Einrichtung unserer Softwarelösung “HELLO OS”, dem innovativen Vermarktungstool für Immobilien.

• Du führst Nutzerschulungen im Rahmen des Onboarding-Prozesses durch, gibst Tipps und teilst Best Practices.

• Während des laufenden Betriebs stehst du für relevante Fragen zur Verfügung , damit unsere Kunden das “HELLO OS” ideal für ihre Bedürfnisse nutzen können.

• Du bist für Dein zugewiesenes Kundenportfolio verantwortlich , wodurch du die Kundenzufriedenheit sicherstellen und eine nachhaltige Beziehung aufbauen kannst, die für den weiteren Geschäftsverlauf elementar ist.

• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team und den Project Leadern zusammen, um individuelle Kundenprobleme erfolgreich zu lösen und Kundenfeedback in die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte einzubringen.

• Du hast einen direkten Einfluss auf die Entwicklung und Verbesserung unseres Customer Success Managements und unserer Produkte.

Die folgenden Eigenschaften zeichnen Dich aus:

• Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung , z.B. im Customer-Success-Management, Account-Management oder einer ähnlichen Rolle.

• Du hast Berufserfahrung im Software- und/oder Online-Umfeld , idealerweise in der Implementierung oder Anwendung von SaaS-Lösungen im Immobilienbereich

• Du hast ein technisches Verständnis , kannst dich für digitale Lösungen begeistern und hast Freude daran, zum Experten unserer Produkte zu werden und dein Wissen weiterzugeben.

• Du hast ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenzen und behältst auch in hektischen Phasen Ruhe und den Überblick.

• Deine Teamfähigkeit sorgt dafür, dass Wünsche und Anregungen der Kunden bei uns nicht untergehen sondern korrekt adressiert werden.

• Du kommunizierst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen empathisch und angemessen mit unseren Kunden.

• Du bist IT- und KI-affin und hast Erfahrung mit Service-Management-Tools wie Jira oder vergleichbaren Systemen sowie CRM-Lösungen .

• Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Schweizerdeutschkenntnisse zeichnen Dich aus. Auf Englisch kannst du dich problemlos mit Teamkollegen austauschen. Gute Französischkenntnisse sowie Kenntnisse in Italienisch sind ein grosser Pluspunkt.

Wenn Du zusätzlich in ​hektischen Situationen ruhig und zuvorkommend ​ ​bleibst, auch wenn die Belastung gerade maximal ist ​-​ dann willkommen im Team!
Solltest Du schon einmal Berührungspunkte mit Visualisierungen (3D-Renderings und ähnliche Produkte) gehabt haben, dann ist dies sicherlich von Vorteil.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• ein engagiertes Team, das etwas bewegen will

• ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

• die Möglichkeit, eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten und eigene Ideen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen

• interne Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• die neuesten Technologien der digitalen Vermarktung von Immobilien

• attraktives Office, aktuell in Lengnau (BE), ab Sommer 2027 in Biel/Bienne

• jährliche Team-Building-Tage in der Schweiz und/oder in Berlin

• attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen

• überdurchschnittliche Sozialversicherungskonditionen

Prima, dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung über den Button auf dieser Seite.

arbeitnow:senior-ai-engineer-zurich-1627.title: Senior AI Engineer
arbeitnow:senior-ai-engineer-zurich-1627.description:
About Rivia
Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.
Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.
Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.
Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.
 
About AI Engineering at Rivia
Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.
The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​
By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence.
 
The Role
As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​
You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​
The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.
 
What excites you

• Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team.

• Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

• Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

• Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities

• Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases.

• Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value.

• Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor.

• Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production.

• Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful.

• Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage.

 
What Excites us

• Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production

• Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

• Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains.

• Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance.

• Experience going from 0→1 at a VC-backed startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

 
Hiring Process
Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

• Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

• Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

• Coding Interview: 60 mins with the team to assess your coding skills.

• Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values
At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

• In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

• Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

• Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

• Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

• Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

• Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

arbeitnow:talent-acquisition-specialist-.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
arbeitnow:talent-acquisition-specialist-.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organization continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. To achieve this, it's essential to adapt by refining our recruitment strategies, upholding exceptional quality in our efforts, and embracing innovative recruitment methodologies. This is where our Talent Acquisition (TA) team plays a vital role.

In the role of Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a pivotal part in achieving the team's primary goal: attracting and hiring the right talent for Vinted while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience. Leveraging your expertise in recruitment, you will implement best hiring practices and collaborate with other team members on various projects. You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organization's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and ensure a seamless interview process to attract the right talent
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers
  • Build effective candidate talent pools through proactive sourcing, job boards, employee referrals, social media & employer branding campaigns etc
  • Guide hiring managers and interviewers on effective interview techniques and candidate evaluation methods
  • Track and report on key hiring metrics to ensure efficient recruitment processes, while providing a positive candidate and hiring manager experience
  • Gain exposure to talent acquisition initiatives by contributing to process improvement projects 
  • Stay informed about recruitment best practices and tools to continually improve the candidate experience

About you 

  • Previous experience as a Sourcer, Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Specialist specifically 
  • Proficiency in sourcing candidates using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools
  • Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building
  • Good understanding of assessment tools and interview evaluation techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and levels
  • A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn and grow within the talent acquisition field

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€47.300—€63.900 EUR

arbeitnow:account-executive-danish-speak.title: Account Executive - Danish Speaker
arbeitnow:account-executive-danish-speak.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.
We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.
But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

• Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market;

• Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

• Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

• Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

• Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

• Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

• Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

What we are looking for

• Fluent in Danish both written and spoken, as if it were your first language;

• Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

• Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

• Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

• Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

• Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

• Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

• Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

• Customer-centric mindset;

• You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 
What we offer

• Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

• Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

• Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

• Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

• Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

• Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

• Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

• Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

• Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

arbeitnow:senior-product-designer-rotter.title: Senior Product Designer
arbeitnow:senior-product-designer-rotter.description:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.

Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

• Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

• Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

• Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

• Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

• Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

• You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

• During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

• Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

• Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

• You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

• You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

• You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities.

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.

We offer

• A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

• Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

• The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

• Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

• Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

• A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

• A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

• A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

• 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here

• Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

• Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

• Pension plan;

• 5 Mental health days per year;

• Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

• Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

• All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

• MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

• Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

• Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

• You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to

arbeitnow:medior-senior-data-analyst-don.title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
arbeitnow:medior-senior-data-analyst-don.description:
SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen.

Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren.

Wat je gaat doen

• Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten.

• Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen.

• Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag.

• Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt.

• Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert.

• Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit.

• Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

• Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

• Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan.

• 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen.

• Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

• Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage.

• De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt.

• Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives.

Dit ben jij
Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

• Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

• Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen.

• Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré.

• Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool.

• Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré.

• Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen.

• Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Follo?
Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact.

• Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong.

• AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows.

• Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders.

• Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities.

Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht.

Wat ga je doen?

• Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's.

• Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen.

• Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand).

• Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen.

• Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie.

• Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken.

De ideale kandidaat

• Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy.

• Je bent nauwkeurig en analytisch ingesteld en werkt makkelijk met Excel en grotere datasets.

• Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, in woord en geschrift.

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

• Een stagevergoeding van € 650 per maand (bij fulltime).

• Een leerzame stage met veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid, verantwoordelijkheid en eigen initiatief.

• Werken vanuit ons Basecamp: een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een gym, restaurant en de DH Academy.

• Professionele begeleiding en de kans om echt iets bij te dragen.

• Een fijne werksfeer met de Rotterdamse mentaliteit.

arbeitnow:remote-go-to-market-lead-germa.title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
arbeitnow:remote-go-to-market-lead-germa.description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role
We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

• Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

• Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

• Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

• Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

• Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

• Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

• Bring insights: from German customers back into product development

What we’re looking for

• Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

• You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

• A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

• You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

• You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

• You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

• Native-level German and fluent English

• Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.
Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.
Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.
Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.
Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

arbeitnow:senior-key-corporate-sales-man.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. 24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO
Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot
Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship.

Dit ga je doen
Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door:

• Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies.

• Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen.

• Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken.

• Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk.

• Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties.

Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa.

Quote
"De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector

Hier kom je terecht
Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega's
Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen.
Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties.

Dit neem je mee

• Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker!

• Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen.

• Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband.

• Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou
Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

• Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

• Een laptop.

• Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

• Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden.

• Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma
Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen
Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Mariëlle Boer. Vragen? Neem contact op met Mariëlle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10487159) of per mail ( ).
Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Florian Rosenm ö ller beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Bel of WhatsApp Florian Rosenm ö ller via (0 6 30364562) . of stuur een e-mail naar Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent . Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit
Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter!

Samen met je collega's werk je aan de verantwoorde en effectieve besteding van publieke middelen. Onze adviseurs zijn intelligente mensen met een duidelijke mening vanuit stevige kennis en professionaliteit.
Werken bij Berenschot | Hoe is het om te werken bij ons adviesbureau

As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance.

arbeitnow:data-scientist-marketing-amste.title: Data Scientist Marketing
arbeitnow:data-scientist-marketing-amste.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right.
That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours.

Take Ownership 🚀
You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it:

• Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days.

• Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher.

• Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces.

• You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost.

• You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed.

• You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running.

• You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention.

• You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop.

• You are fluent in English.

Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up.

🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options
💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq

🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style﻿

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

What you'll do

Own and improve our IT operations

  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
  • Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
  • Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
  • Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
  • Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
  • Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.

Think like a product owner

  • Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
  • Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
  • Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
  • Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.

What you'll bring

  • Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
