arbeitnow:senior-backend-engineer-amster.description:
About Us
Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build powerful, delightful features that empower restaurant teams. You’ll work across the stack to bring new ideas to life, whether it’s building intuitive interfaces, scalable backend services, or the glue in between that makes everything feel seamless.
You’ll collaborate closely with design, product, and other engineers to rapidly ship impactful features. As an early team member, you’ll also help shape our engineering culture, tooling, and technical direction.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving real user problems, and wants to help modernize an underserved industry with thoughtful, elegant software.

Responsibilities:

• Build, test, and ship end-to-end features across the stack—from APIs and data models.

• Collaborate with designers and PMs to translate user needs into working, intuitive product experiences

• Own projects from concept to launch and beyond, balancing speed, quality, and scalability

• Improve system performance and reliability across frontend and backend systems

• Help evolve our codebase and technical architecture as we scale

• Contribute to shared tooling, component libraries, and best practices that level up the whole team

What you’ll need:

• 8+ years of professional experience as a fullstack or backend engineer in a product-focused environment

• Deep expertise in either Kotlin, Java, or Scala.

• Significant experience with distributed systems. You know how to build and maintain scalable, resilient services that work together.

• Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).

• Good experience of relational databases, such as Postgres.

• Comfortable working with APIs, relational databases, and docker

• A product mindset, you care about the why behind what you’re building and optimizing for user impact

• Ability to work collaboratively across functions and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Strong attention to detail and a sense of pride in crafting great user experiences

What is Restaurant Software?
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.
From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.
How we use AI at Tebi
We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance.

Jij bent de strategische sparringpartner die bedrijfsprocessen optimaliseert en vertaalt naar slimme technologische oplossingen. Je wordt een integraal onderdeel van het klantteam en speelt een cruciale rol in het verhogen van klanttevredenheid en zakelijke groei door middel van deskundig advies en strategische technologie-implementatie. Deze rol biedt een unieke mix van business en techniek: jij adviseert én zet jouw technische expertise in om impact te maken.
  

Jouw reisgezelschap  

Bij HSO Managed Services werk je in klantenteams die end-to-end verantwoordelijk zijn. Techniek, business en change komen samen, waardoor je korte lijnen, snelle besluitvorming en nauwe samenwerking met de klant ervaart. Je rol gaat verder dan beheer: je adviseert, innoveert en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor proactieve monitoring, incidentmanagement, roadmap en optimalisatie van kritische processen. Samen met je collega’s creëer je jouw eigen groeipad. 

 

Jouw bijdrage aan de reis    

  • Ontwikkel en presenteer verbeter-roadmaps en vertaal deze naar concrete opdrachten;
  • Adviseer klanten over toekomstige Microsoft-ontwikkelingen en innovaties;
  • Werk nauw samen met Sales en Accountmanagement om klantwaarde te maximaliseren;
  • Begeleid en coach consultants en developers, bewaak kwaliteit en deel best practices;
  • Stem actief af met de Customer Team Manager en klanten over voortgang en kansen.

 

Wat neem jij mee?

  • Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden;

Wat verzorgen wij?

arbeitnow:technical-architect-power-plat.title: Technical Architect Power Platform CE
arbeitnow:technical-architect-power-plat.description:
Als Technical Architect ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de technische architectuur op de korte en lange termijn in projecten en salestrajecten. Je beschrijft en ontwikkelt de technische architectuur inclusief bijkomende integraties. Naast het ontwerpen van migratiescenario’s, onderhoud je contact met de technische en inhoudelijke stakeholders bij de klant en HSO.

Join the journey

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zet technische best practices op voor klanten en (interne) collega's. Als Technical Architect ben je de motivator voor de technische collega's van het klantteam. Als digital leader naar de klant ben je in staat om breder te kijken dan de oplossing die wij leveren en zie je deze in het totale end-to-end klantproces.

Als Technical Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technische deel van de oplossing. Daarnaast:

  • Ben je betrokken in de designfase en bepaal je welke technologieën kunnen worden gebruikt in welke scenario's;
  • Draag je bij aan de technische best practices van HSO en draag je deze ook uit naar de klant en het team;
  • Fungeer je fungeer als technische vraagbaak voor de technische en functionele consultants;
  • Houd je je bezig met integraties met andere (third-party) applicaties, denk je mee over integration patterns;
  • Zorg je ervoor dat alles in source control terecht komt en dat er automatisch uitgerold wordt d,m,v, Azure DevOps pipelines;
  • Samen met de Product Owner stel je een roadmap op voor technische verbeteringen.


Wat vertellen onze huidige technische architecten over deze rol?

“Het werk als technische architect is heel erg uitdagend en gevarieerd. Je werkt samen met hele leuke collega’s op projecten. Op het project ben je verantwoordelijk voor de algehele kwaliteit en samenhang van het IT-landschap. Primair binnen de kaders van het project. Echter doordat je implementatie altijd samenhangt met andere systemen ben je ook veel bezig met het landschap buiten het Microsoft project. Je bepaalt samen met de klant waar je naartoe gaat over de jaren heen en ziet jouw plannen dan werkelijkheid worden.

Als je het leuk vindt is er ook altijd ruimte om op de inhoud in te gaan. Als je dat doet ben je vooral bezig met de complexe onderdelen van het project en dat is erg leuk en uitdagend. Naast de projecten houd je je bezig met de best practices van HSO. Je krijgt daardoor altijd de nieuwe ontwikkelingen mee en krijgt de kans om daar wat mee te doen.”

 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met Power Platform (Dynamics 365 CE, CRM) implementaties in een technische rol;
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring in programmeertaal C#;
  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden die je inzet bij het aansturen van de techneuten;
  • Je bent in staat om op basis van de behoeften van de klant een technisch ontwerp te maken en de structuur van de oplossing uit te denken;
  • Je bent in staat om de best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd hierbij leidend te laten zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten;
  • Je bent in staat de implementatie te begeleiden volgens de overeengekomen architectuur en infrastructuur;
  • Je bent inhoudelijk, analytisch, ondernemend, kwaliteitsbewust en creatief.

 

Wat bieden we jou?    
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:

Introductie van de rol

Als Senior Finance Consultant Professional Services sleutel je in wisselende projectteams aan het ontwerp, de realisatie en implementatie van Microsoft Dynamics 365 voor klanten in de Professional services industrie. Veel van onze projecten zijn zogenaamde platform projecten dit betekent dat we Dynamics 365 CE en Dynamics 365 FO integreren. Join us as a Senior Dynamics 365 Power Platform Developer!

As a Senior Dynamics 365 Power Platform Developer, you'll chart your own career and personal growth path with the backing of our organization. Collaborating closely with clients, you'll make a tangible impact while immersing yourself in the cutting-edge world of business consultancy and process optimization, empowered by the latest Microsoft solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Gather requirements and design, develop, and implement Dynamics 365 power platform solutions across Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Marketing, and Project Operations for AEC (Architecture, Engineering, Construction) and Legal industries.
  • Deliver superior business and software application services, crafting sustainable solutions that meet clients' needs.
  • Leverage your technical prowess in Dynamics 365 power platform Customization & Configuration.
  • Excel in Plugins, TypeScript, Power Automate, and Power Apps to extend and enrich core functionalities.
  • Uphold coding standards, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot complex issues, offering effective and timely solutions.
  • Conduct comprehensive code reviews, providing constructive feedback, and mentoring junior developers.
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations in terms of business knowledge, skills, and conduct, identifying and mitigating project risks as needed.
  • Communicate project progress updates to relevant stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
  • Participate in pre-sales activities as needed, while also assuming Architect roles and responsibilities as required.
  • Serve as a professional ambassador for HSO, proactively advising customers on industry best practices.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated ambition and eagerness to learn.
  • Proficiency in both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
  • Strong communication skills coupled with creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Proactive nature with strong analytical skills.
  • Customer-oriented mindset, capable of taking ownership and working autonomously.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, multicultural team environment.
  • Strong product knowledge, knowing the ins and outs of the Power Platform and do's and dont's.
  • Familiarity with configuring build and release pipelines using YAML in Azure DevOps, version control systems like GIT, and build automation/release management.
  • Optional experience with Azure Integrations (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus) and Power Pages.

Why should you choose HSO?

Freedom, Flexibility, and Fun
You work in an international environment with professionals from various nationalities. A flexible workweek of 40, 36, or 32 hours is possible because we believe that your way of working should match your lifestyle. HSO employs professionals who enjoy their work and support each other. To make our work even more enjoyable, we organize team outings and company parties, as well as weekly summer drinks on our rooftop terrace, various sports activities, and opportunities to contribute to our Corporate Social Responsibility efforts.

About HSO
HSO is the leading full-service Microsoft Partner in the Netherlands. Together with over 2,500 talented employees in Europe, Asia, and North America, we provide support at both local and international levels to industrial companies, retailers, financial and business service providers, and government institutions.

HSO is continuously looking for new talent. We are expanding our global community and take pleasure in working with performance-driven people with an entrepreneurial spirit—professionals who are eager to learn and innovate.

Join the journey

arbeitnow:ai-platform-engineer-veenendaa.description:
Ben jij de engineer die organisaties naar het volgende niveau tilt met de kracht van Microsoft Power Platform én AI? 

Join the journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Platform Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het Microsoft Power Platform team van HSO: een snelgroeiende afdeling met een ondernemende mindset waarin jouw expertise noodzakelijk is om verder te kunnen groeien. Jij ontwerpt de fundamenten waarop klanten hun digitale transformatie bouwen — van datamodel tot beveiliging tot ALM — en zorgt dat AI-gedreven oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn. 

Jij bent vanaf de salesfase betrokken om samen met het beoogde klantteam de klant op weg te helpen met onze aanpak en propositie. Jij kunt in alle vrijheid platform- en AI-implementatietrajecten uitdenken en begeleiden. In sommige gevallen opereer je alleen, in andere gevallen gesteund door een ervaren en gemotiveerd team — waaronder de AI Platform Consultant, die het business probleem, het functional design en de user journeys aanlevert als basis voor jouw technisch ontwerp. 

Kerntaken: 

  • Je ontwerpt Dataverse-modellen en de bijbehorende security-architectuur (tabellen, relaties, business rules, rollen en rechten), inclusief de datagrondslag (grounding) waarop AI-agents veilig kunnen redeneren. 
  • Je kiest en onderbouwt het juiste patroon per vraagstuk: app, portal, workflow of AI-agent, en ontwerpt de technische architectuur van Copilot Studio-agents (topics, plugins, connectoren, Azure OpenAI-integratie). 
  • Je bepaalt de ALM- en omgevingsstrategie (dev/test/acceptatie/productie, pipelines, release management), inclusief versiebeheer en promotie van AI-agents en hun kennisbronnen. 
  • Je richt governance en beveiliging voor AI in: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant- en environment-instellingen voor Copilot Studio, en monitoring/observability van agentgedrag. 
  • Je beoordeelt en valideert AI-gegenereerde oplossingsontwerpen en -code op kwaliteit, security, kosten en schaalbaarheid, en stuurt bij waar nodig. 

 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau. 
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie bij een IT-dienstverlener, consultancy of aan klantzijde. 
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen van Dataverse-datamodellen en security-architectuur (rollen, teams, business units, field-level security).

arbeitnow:enterprise-account-executive-i.title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
arbeitnow:enterprise-account-executive-i.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.
You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

• Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

• Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

• Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

• Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

• Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

• Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

• Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

• Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

• Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

• Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

• Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like
First 30 days

• Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

• Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

• Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

• Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

• Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

• Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

• Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

• Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

• Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

• Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

• Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

• Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

• Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

• Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

• Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring
Must-haves

• 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

• Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

• A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

• Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

• Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

• A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

• Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

• Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

• Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

• Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now
Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.
This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.
You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

arbeitnow:database-engineering-intern-ga.title: Database Engineering Intern
arbeitnow:database-engineering-intern-ga.description:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.
Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.
Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible
Tasks

• Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled.

• Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed.

• Improve our data models : reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

• Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application.

• Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

• Review our database access policies.

Requirements

• You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

• Comfortable in SQL : joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

• You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

• PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

• Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation .

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools .

• Humble, low ego , not afraid to get your hands dirty.

• Get things done mentality : prioritising results over process.

• Fluent in English, German is a plus.

Benefits

• Scaling from 0 to 1 : you shape how this company works, from the processes to the team around you.

• Work as a full team member of an interdisciplinary team of top performers that will both support and challenge your growth.

• Lunch allowance , a subsidized sports membership and modern tech.

• A new office in Garching , right on top of our own production floor.

Vetaion is building a fully automated production facility for control cabinets in Munich. We use digital twins and robotics to automate the manufacturing process, orchestrated by VetaionOS, our own operating system for the factory.
Our mission is to strengthen Germany as a leading industrial hub. Join our team and our mission, let's reinvent the future of production together!

Wir entwickeln Kollektionen mit einer klaren Identität, starken Grafiken, besonderen Fits und einem hohen Anspruch an Design und Qualität. Unsere Inspiration kommt aus Streetwear, Musik, Fashion und der Kultur, die diese Welten miteinander verbindet.
Für unser Designteam suchen wir einen Fashion & Graphic Designer (m/w/d) , der Streetwear nicht nur kennt, sondern wirklich versteht.
Du solltest ein Gespür dafür haben, was ein starkes Streetwear-Piece ausmacht – von der Silhouette über die Grafik bis zu den kleinsten Details.
Deine Aufgaben

• Streetwear Design: Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Kollektionen, insbesondere Hoodies, T-Shirts, Tracksuits, Denim, Knitwear und Outerwear.

• Garment Graphics: Gestaltung eigenständiger Prints, Typografien, Artworks, Stickereien und grafischer Konzepte für unsere Produkte.

• Fits & Colorways: Entwicklung von Silhouetten, Farbwelten, Washes und Materialkombinationen.

• Technical Design: Erstellung von technischen Zeichnungen, Tech Packs, Mockups und produktionsreifen Design-Dateien.

• Trend & Culture Research: Kontinuierliche Auseinandersetzung mit internationaler Streetwear, Fashion, Musik und relevanten kulturellen Entwicklungen.

• Product Development: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam, von der ersten Idee über Samples bis zum fertigen Produkt.

• Creative Input: Eigenständige Entwicklung neuer Ideen und aktive Mitgestaltung zukünftiger Drops.

Dein Profil

• Streetwear ist deine Welt. Du verstehst die Ästhetik und Produktphilosophie von Brands wie Stüssy, Supreme, Corteiz oder Palace und hast deinen eigenen Geschmack.

• Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Design von Streetwear oder vergleichbaren Fashion-Produkten gesammelt.

• Du bist stark in Graphic Design , insbesondere bei Garment Graphics, Prints, Typografie und Artworks.

• Du arbeitest sicher mit Adobe Illustrator und Photoshop.

• Du besitzt technisches Verständnis für Schnitte, Passformen, Materialien, Verarbeitung und Produktionsprozesse.

• Du kannst technische Zeichnungen und Tech Packs selbstständig erstellen und Designs für die Produktion vorbereiten.

• Du verstehst, wie man kreative Ideen in tragbare, kommerziell relevante Produkte übersetzt.

• Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und bringst aktiv neue Ideen ein.

• Du hast ein starkes Portfolio mit eigenen Streetwear-Designs und Garment Graphics.

Wichtig: Wir suchen keinen reinen Marketing-Grafiker und keinen klassischen High-Fashion-Designer. Wir suchen jemanden, der starke Streetwear-Produkte entwickeln und grafisch gestalten kann.

arbeitnow:senior-flight-dynamics-enginee.title: Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer, Orbits R&D
arbeitnow:senior-flight-dynamics-enginee.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer, you will work in a small team of dedicated engineers responsible for the Flight Dynamics and Mission Planning for Planet’s fleet of satellites. The Flight Dynamics disciplines of this team include mission design, orbit determination, maneuver design and execution (with propulsion and differential-drag), and conjunction assessment & mitigation. Mission Planning is concerned with optimal scheduling of imaging and contacts for Planet’s Dove, SkySat, Pelican, and Tanager constellations. This operations research problem has a direct impact on fulfilling the business needs for the world’s largest heterogeneous constellation of Earth Observation satellites. Your role will involve developing and automating tools to assess mission design trade-offs that will define the future of Planet's constellations.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Research, design, and architect new software solutions for managing Mission Design needs for Planet's increasingly diverse fleets of satellites.
  • Work on complex optimization problems with your knowledge of flight dynamics and software engineering.
  • Develop and automate tools to assess mission design trade-offs that will define the future of Planet's constellations.
  • Collaborate with mission planning, flight dynamics, and ground software teams to improve the operations of existing fleets and enable future missions.
  • Perform first-principles analysis to optimize scheduling of imaging and contacts for Planet's diverse satellite constellations.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, physics or related technical field
  • Expertise in orbital mechanics and space mission operations
  • Deep knowledge in software development, in C++ and Python
  • Experience carrying out first-principles analysis and operationalizing MVP solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with constellation and mission design trade studies
  • Experience implementing one or more of the following:
    • Orbit determination and high-fidelity propagation
    • Covariance realism
    • Low-thrust mission design
    • Maneuver automation 
    • Constellation management
  • Experience maintaining peer-reviewed code, attention to quality including automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off 
  • Employee Wellness Program 
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

Compensation:

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

Germany Salary Range
€86.600—€108.300 EUR

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

Product Manager – Finanzierung & Integrationen (m/w/d)

Die meisten Product-Rollen geben dir ein Backlog und ein Engineering-Team. Diese gibt dir zusätzlich einen Verhandlungstisch: Du überzeugst die Produktteams von Banken, ihr eigenes Engineering-Budget in eine Anbindung zu stecken. Danach gehört dir die Schnittstelle – auch nach dem Go-live.

 

Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

 

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Anbindung unserer Finanzierungs- und Bankpartner – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
  • Du überzeugst die Produktteams unserer Partner, eigenes Engineering-Budget in die Integration zu investieren, und führst diese Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung.
  • Du analysierst, wo Händler zwischen Fahrzeugansicht und abgeschlossenem Gebot abspringen, und erhöhst die Conversion messbar.
  • Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, begründest jede Priorisierung damit und verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch.
  • Du baust Prototypen, um eine Idee zu testen, bevor du Engineering-Zeit dafür einplanst.
  • Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen.

 

Die Stelle ist eine Nachbesetzung in einer gewachsenen Produktorganisation – acht Product Manager, zehn Engineering-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3–6 Jahre im Produktmanagement in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Du hast eine Funnel- oder Conversion-Kennzahl bewegt und kannst Ausgangswert und Ergebnis nennen – mit Daten, die du selbst gezogen hast
  • Erfahrung mit externen Partnern, deren Prioritäten du verstehen und beeinflussen musstest – nicht nur interne Stakeholder
  • Technisches Verständnis für API-Integrationen: Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber verstehen, worüber Engineering spricht
  • Eine klare Vorstellung davon, wo KI diese Arbeit konkret besser macht – ob dein aktueller Arbeitgeber dir die Tools zur Verfügung stellt, spielt für uns keine Rolle
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

 

Von Vorteil

 

  • Erfahrung mit einer zweiseitigen Plattform – du hast für Angebot und Nachfrage gearbeitet, nicht nur für eine Seite
  • Erfahrung mit Checkout-, Payment- oder Finanzierungsprozessen (z. B. BNPL)
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit dem Automotive-Umfeld

 

Was du nicht brauchst: Erfahrung im Banking oder Fintech. Die Finanzierungswelt lernst du hier – das Gespür für Partner bringst du mit.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Homeoffice – plus 10 Tage „Work from Anywhere" pro Jahr
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Bezahltes Deutschlandticket
  • FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss
  • Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events
  • Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk, Meditations- & Gebetsraum

 

Der Prozess: drei Gespräche, rund 2,5 Stunden. Kein Case-Study-Paket für zu Hause – die Aufgabe lösen wir gemeinsam im Raum.

 

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

Als Business Analyst Werkstudent:in bei Picnic bist du an vorderster Front der Innovation und stellst dich komplexen Herausforderungen mit bahnbrechenden Lösungen. Diese Rolle dreht sich um Innovation – du analysierst Daten, deckst Wachstumspotenziale auf und entwickelst strategische Lösungen, die unser Geschäftsmodell vorantreiben, Grenzen verschieben und das Einkaufserlebnis neu denken. Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen und kooperativen Teams in einem schnelllebigen, innovativen Umfeld. 

Das erwartet dich

  • Von Daten zu Business-Insights: Arbeite an echten Business Cases, analysiere datenbasierte Fragestellungen und gestalte unser Geschäftsmodell aktiv mit. Bereit, echten Impact zu schaffen?

  • Ermögliche: Erreiche operative Exzellenz, indem du Herausforderungen mit einem datengetriebenen und analytischen Ansatz meisterst

  • Entwickle: Erstelle und optimiere Modelle für Verbesserungen in Echtzeit

arbeitnow:supply-chain-analytics-project.description:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell

As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can tackle challenges and growth opportunities at Picnic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience
  • Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way
  • Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn

 

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.

arbeitnow:analytics-future-leaders-gradu.title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
arbeitnow:analytics-future-leaders-gradu.description:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading

Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

  • Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. 
  • Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

  • Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar
  • Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar
  • Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
  • Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
  • You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 
  • EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required.

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.

 Why Picnic?

  • Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours
  • Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)
  • Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

Our Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company
You will be joining a fast-growing, founder-led European signage company that designs, produces and installs custom branded signs and visual identity systems for businesses of every size, from start-ups to global brands. Growing 40–50% year-on-year, the company is on its way to becoming the first marketing-led player in a complex, traditionally offline industry. Its websites and online configurators are where most customer journeys begin, so the focus now is on turning them into even stronger digital sales engines.

The Role

This is a hands-on ownership role: you decide what to test, write the copy, shape the experience with a designer and AI tools, and turn data and customer insight into measurable gains in conversion.
You’ll report to the CEO and work closely with Performance Marketing, Content, Design and Tech. This role is ideal for a creative, analytically strong and entrepreneurial marketer who wants to own conversion rates end to end and moves fast without waiting to be managed.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and continuously improve the company’s websites, landing pages and conversion funnels

• Design intuitive, visually strong web experiences that convert, working alongside a designer and AI tools

• Plan, build and analyse A/B tests on full pages and individual sections

• Write sharp headlines, USPs, CTAs and website copy that turn visitors into customers

• Plan and develop SEO pages with support from the copywriting team

• Help shape the experience and build of a new online product configurator

• Run customer surveys and user research independently, and translate data and insights into prioritised growth experiments

• Drive execution across Performance Marketing, Content, Design and Tech, and report on the impact of every change

Ideal Candidate

• 3–5 years of experience in digital product management, growth design, CRO or e-commerce; exceptional candidates with less experience and a strong track record are also welcome

• Native German speaker with professional English, as website copy is a core part of the role

• Based in Berlin or willing to relocate, for a hybrid set-up

• Excellent UX/UI understanding and a strong aesthetic sense

• A proven talent for concise, sales-driven web copy and persuasive messaging

• Strong analytical thinking and commercial understanding: you tie every change back to conversion and revenue

• Uses AI tools natively in day-to-day work, from research to copy to design

1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

• Marketing & Kundenfeedback (Happy Calls): Deine zentrale Aufgabe sind sogenannte „Happy Calls“ an unsere Bestandskund:innen mit bereits installierten Systemen. Du kontaktierst Kund:innen aktiv telefonisch, erhebst systematisch die Zufriedenheit und sammelst strukturiertes Feedback. Die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse fließen direkt in die Optimierung unserer After-Sales-Prozesse sowie in neue Marketingkampagnen ein.

• Events & Community-Marketing: Du planst und begleitest kleine lokale Kunden-Events und stehst dort im persönlichen Austausch mit unserer Zielgruppe. Dabei bringst du eigene kreative Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundenansprache, Empfehlungsprogramme und Kampagnen ein.

• Sales Support & Prozessoptimierung: Du unterstützt unser Sales- und Marketing-Team an der Schnittstelle zum Kunden, analysierst Feedback-Daten und hilfst dabei, neue Best Practices für den Vertrieb deutschlandweit auszurollen.

• Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest standortübergreifend mit über 50 Standorten deutschlandweit zusammen und erhältst umfassende Einblicke in ein dynamisch wachsendes CleanTech-Unicorn.

Dein Profil

• Studium: Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student:in im Bereich Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Marketing, Vertrieb, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Kommunikationswissenschaften und suchst ein Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum (3 bis 6 Monate) ab sofort.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachen-Niveau sind für die tägliche Kommunikation mit unseren Kund:innen zwingend erforderlich.

• Stärken: Du bist sehr kommunikativ, überzeugungsstark und hast keine Scheu vor Telefonaten, Daten und Analysen.

• Eigeninitiative: Du packst gerne an, übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest selbstständig und willst aktiv dazu beitragen, die Energiewende voranzutreiben.

Benefits

• Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt und Berlin zu arbeiten und hybrid

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten , die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

• Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit

arbeitnow:horakustiker-fur-audiologische.description:
Du hast eine Ausbildung in der Hörakustik oder Audiologie, telefonierst gerne und hast Freude daran, andere mit deinem Fachwissen bei der Lösung audiologischer und technischer Herausforderungen zu unterstützen? Dann kannst du bei uns deine Expertise auf eine neue Art einsetzen.
In dieser Position bist du eine zentrale fachliche Ansprechperson für unsere Fachkundschaft und unterstützt insbesondere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik bei Fragen rund um unsere Hörlösungen der Marken Phonak, Unitron und Hansaton.
Wenn du gerne kommunizierst, Freude am Telefonieren hast und dein Wissen gerne an andere Fachkräfte weitergibst, bietet dir diese Position eine spannende Perspektive.
An unserem Standort in Fellbach wirst du Teil eines erfahrenen Teams und eines internationalen Unternehmens mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Mehr über deine Aufgaben
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist wesentlich durch die telefonische Beratung unserer Fachkundschaft geprägt. Über den Tag hinweg stehst du kontinuierlich im direkten Austausch mit Fachkräften aus der Hörakustik und bist für sie eine kompetente fachliche Ansprechperson.
Bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen berätst du unsere Kundschaft und unterstützt dabei, konkrete Herausforderungen direkt im Gespräch zu analysieren und zu lösen.
Bei Fragen zur Hörgeräteanpassung, zu unseren Produkten und zur Anpasssoftware sowie bei technischen Problemen und der Fehlerdiagnose unterstützt du kompetent und lösungsorientiert.
Fachliche Themen rund um Reparaturen, Reklamationen, ITE-/Im-Ohr-Lösungen und Remakes begleitest du und hilfst dabei, die passende Lösung zu finden.
Ergänzend zur telefonischen Beratung gehören die Bearbeitung schriftlicher Kundenanfragen sowie die Dokumentation relevanter Informationen und Lösungen zu deinen Aufgaben.
Produktschulungen und interne Trainings führst du eigenständig durch und vermittelst dabei dein Wissen verständlich und praxisnah.
Feedback und Anforderungen aus dem Markt nimmst du auf und bringst die Perspektive unserer Fachkundschaft in die Organisation ein.
Mehr über dich
Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Hörakustik oder eine Ausbildung bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Audiologie oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation bilden die Grundlage für diese Position.
Fundiertes audiologisches Fachwissen sowie praktische Kenntnisse rund um Hörgeräte, deren Anpassung und typische technische Fragestellungen zeichnen dich aus.
Telefonieren gehört für dich gerne und selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag: Der intensive telefonische Austausch mit unserer Fachkundschaft macht einen wesentlichen Teil deines Arbeitstages aus. Auch über längere Zeit am Telefon zu beraten und unterschiedliche Anfragen nacheinander zu bearbeiten, liegt dir.
Freude daran, dein Fachwissen weiterzugeben, zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe audiologische oder technische Zusammenhänge am Telefon verständlich und lösungsorientiert zu erklären.
Eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Geduld und Kommunikationsstärke gehören zu deinen Stärken.
Im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen bist du sicher und bringst eine gute Software- und Technikaffinität mit.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Beratung unserer Kundschaft erforderlich; Grundkenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.
Mehr über das, was wir bieten
Bei uns kannst du deine Erfahrung aus der Hörakustik in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen: Du bleibst nah an audiologischen Themen und der täglichen Praxis unserer Fachkundschaft. Gleichzeitig gibst du dein Fachwissen an andere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik weiter und unterstützt sie kompetent bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen.
Als Teil eines großen und erfahrenen Teams profitierst du vom regelmäßigen fachlichen Austausch und erhältst gleichzeitig Einblicke in die Arbeit eines der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörlösungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit bekannten Marken wie Phonak, Unitron und Hansaton und entwickelst dein Wissen über Produkte, Technologien und moderne Hörlösungen kontinuierlich weiter.
Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter im Bereich Hörversorgung mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur ein. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem du eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit deinen persönlichen Verpflichtungen und Interessen vereinbaren kannst. Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

arbeitnow:creative-director-hockenheim-1.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

• Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.

• Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.

• Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.

• Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.

• Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.

• Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

• Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage

• Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden

• Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze unserer Kunden

• Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht

• Wachstum: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Personal Brands, Formaten und Zielgruppen und entwickelst dich als Creator und Führungskraft kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringst du mit:

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads

• Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung

• Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention

• Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten

• Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator

• Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen

• Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey

• Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL

• Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht

• Souveräne Kundenkommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Unternehmern

• Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst

• Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

• Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

• du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen

• du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt

• du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst

• du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst

• du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln

• du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst

• du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern

• du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst

• du Kunden nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert

• dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken

• du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Stellenanforderungen

Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen – bewirb dich jetzt!

arbeitnow:head-of-strategy-operations-be.title: Head of Strategy & Operations
arbeitnow:head-of-strategy-operations-be.description:
About remove
remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment and Postcode Loterij Fonds.
About the role
We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.
What you will own
Strategy

• Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

• Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

• Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

• Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

• Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

• Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

People and team

• Line-manage our program managers: debottleneck daily operations, set priorities, manage workload, coach the team, manage development plans, etc.

• Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

• Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

• Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

• Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

• Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

• Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

• Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

• Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are
You must have

• 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

• Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

• A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

• Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

• Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

• Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

• Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

• Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

• Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

• Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

• A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

• Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

• Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

• Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

• Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

• A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

• This role reports to the two co-founders.

• Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

• Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

• Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

• A flexible and remote-first workplace.

• An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

• A unique opportunity to experience and shape strategy for a future billion-dollar industry in its early days.

• Exposure to a great network and community of CDR innovators and experts.

• A learning budget to develop yourself.

• Flexible holidays and biannual team off-sites.

How to apply
Submit your CV and a short cover letter (no more than one page) detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be the ideal candidate for the role. We will review applications on a rolling basis and aim to start interviews as soon as possible, latest by mid November 2026.
Our process: a 30-minute introductory call with Rawan Gebran (Senior Director @ remove) followed by a take home task that you will present, then an interview with both co-founders, Hans Westerhof & Marian Krueger and a conversation with the team. We aim to make a decision by January 2027 for a start in April 2027. In the final round, we will ask for the contact details of 3 references willing to speak about their experience with you, professionally.
If you’ve built and run the strategic and operating backbone for a small and agile team before and want to do it for the organization helping CDR startups globally get off the ground, we want to hear from you! We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

arbeitnow:consultant-informationssicherh.title: Consultant Informationssicherheit / IT-Risikomanagement – ISO 27001 (m/w/d)
arbeitnow:consultant-informationssicherh.description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software- und IT-Dienstleister mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und unterstützt dort das Informationssicherheits- und IT-Risikomanagement im laufenden Betrieb.

• IT-Risikoanalysen und Risk Assessments für Anwendungen und Infrastruktur durchführen

• Bedrohungsanalysen erstellen und daraus Maßnahmen ableiten

• Risiken bewerten, dokumentieren und mit den Verantwortlichen nachverfolgen

• Den ISMS-Prozess nach ISO 27001 und ISO 27005 unterstützen

• Abstimmung mit Fachbereichen, IT-Betrieb und Security-Verantwortlichen

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Kundentermine sind meist in Frankfurt, an einzelnen Präsenztagen.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Das erwarten wir:

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit

• Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung im IT-Risikomanagement

• Sicherer Umgang mit den Anforderungen der ISO 27001 und ISO 27005

• Erfahrung mit Bedrohungsanalysen

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

• Audit- oder Assessment-Erfahrung

• Werkzeuge für Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel risk2value

• Zertifizierung wie ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, BSI-Grundschutz-Praktiker oder -Auditor, CISSP oder T.I.S.P.
