VP of Technical Marketing – PQShield

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

Location: [Remote / UK / US] ·You must have the right to work in one the above countries in order to be considered for the role. 

 

💼 About the role

 

PQShield is looking for a VP of Technical Marketing to make PQShield the technology and the brand the industry thinks of first for post-quantum security.

You will be the commercial team's technical voice in the market. You'll build the solutions and partnerships that help our sales team grow the pipeline, develop the semiconductor ecosystem around our IP, and lead technical thought leadership with customers, partners, standards bodies, and industry analysts.

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, semiconductor companies, OEMs, and system builders across automotive, defense, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise face a hard and urgent transition. This role puts PQShield at the center of that transition — through the partners who build with our IP, the solutions customers deploy, and the industry relationships that shape how the market moves.

This is a senior role for someone who combines a security IP background with deep industry relationships, and who knows how to turn both into revenue.

 

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

  • Build solutions that grow pipeline: Create reference solutions, joint offerings, and use-case packages that give sales clear, repeatable ways into accounts. Combine PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib with partner technology into solutions customers can adopt quickly.

  • Develop the semiconductor ecosystem: Build and manage relationships with semiconductor suppliers, foundries, EDA and IP partners, processor and security-subsystem providers, and design services firms. Make PQShield IP the default choice for PQC in their roadmaps, reference designs, and platforms.

  • Drive partnerships that create demand: Identify, structure, and launch technical partnerships that open new markets and channels. Own the technical case for each partnership and ensure it produces pipeline, not just announcements.

  • Lead technical thought leadership: Be the senior technical voice of the commercial team. Speak at industry conferences, brief analysts and press, author white papers and technical articles, and represent PQShield in standards and industry forums.

  • Use industry relationships to build the brand: Leverage your network across semiconductors, security, and system OEMs to establish PQShield as the key technology and brand for post-quantum security.

  • Arm the commercial team technically: Give sales, FAEs, and partners the technical narratives, architectures, competitive positioning, and solution content they need to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Shape the market narrative: Define how the industry thinks about the post-quantum transition, cryptographic agility, side-channel and fault-injection protection, and certification (FIPS 140-3, SESIP, Common Criteria, ISO 26262) — and where PQShield fits.

  • Lead technical launches: Plan and deliver the technical go-to-market for new products, certifications, reference designs, and partner integrations.

  • Bring the market back in: Feed customer, partner, and competitive insight into product and engineering so our roadmap stays ahead of where the market is heading.

  • Build the team: Hire and lead a technical marketing team as the role scales.

 

What success looks like in your first 12 months

We will measure this role on the following deliverables:

  • Reference designs: Deliver 2 PQShield reference designs on widely used MCUs or SoCs, built with silicon partners and used in active sales opportunities.

  • Semiconductor ecosystem: Sign 5 ecosystem partners, such as silicon vendors, EDA and IP partners, or design services firms, that include PQShield IP in their roadmaps, reference designs or platforms.

  • Joint roadmap meetings and OEM requirements: Run 10 joint roadmap meetings that bring together an OEM, its silicon supplier and PQShield, and secure 5 OEM letters or RFQs that ask silicon suppliers for PQC capability.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline: Create identifiable silicon pipeline from ecosystem partners and joint roadmap meetings, tagged as influenced in CRM, that contributes to the company goals of 3x pipeline coverage and 15 design wins in 2027.

  • Solutions: Launch 3 solution packages that combine PQShield products with partner technology for priority use cases, each with a reference architecture, a solution brief and a demo.

  • Thought leadership: Deliver 6 conference talks or analyst briefings and 4 technical white papers or articles, and represent PQShield in at least one standards or industry working group.

  • Market insight: Deliver a quarterly report to product and engineering on partner, customer and competitive requirements.

 

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

 

We're looking for a senior technical marketing leader with a security IP background, a strong industry network, and a track record of turning partnerships and technical credibility into revenue.

  • 12+ years in semiconductor IP, security, or embedded technology, with at least 5 years in technical marketing, solutions, business development, or ecosystem leadership roles.

  • A background in security IP — for example, hardware security modules, root of trust, secure enclaves, cryptographic accelerators, or embedded security software.

  • Established relationships across semiconductor suppliers, IP and EDA vendors, system OEMs, and the security industry that you can use to open doors and build PQShield's position.

  • A proven record of building ecosystem programs and partnerships that measurably grew pipeline and revenue.

  • Credibility as a technical thought leader: experience speaking at industry events, writing for technical audiences, and engaging analysts, press, and standards bodies.

  • Ability to work in depth with cryptographers and engineers, and to explain complex security technology to engineers, architects, CISOs, CTOs, and business executives.

  • A strong commercial mindset: you measure success by pipeline, design wins, and revenue.

  • Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in semiconductor or OEM markets.

  • Comfortable building in a fast-moving company where the market narrative is still being written.

 

Strong advantages

  • Experience at Arm, or in the Arm ecosystem.

  • Knowledge of cryptography, post-quantum cryptography, side-channel and fault-injection countermeasures, or security certifications such as FIPS 140-3, SESIP, or Common Criteria.

  • Familiarity with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262, or with automotive, defense, or industrial IoT markets.

 

 

What we can offer you

  • A competitive compensation package.

  • Share options.

  • A remote first company. You will work from home most of the time, but will need to join us in the office for planning sessions and key meetings as required.

  • Travel for customer meetings and marketing events as needed. 

  • Health insurance.

  • Generous PTO and holiday package.

  • Company contributions towards 401K/pension

  • …and other great benefits.

 

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value the security of our daily digital lives, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you.

• One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team
Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.
Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

• Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

• Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

• Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

• AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe
AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.
Its flagship product is Joker , Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.
For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham , the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.
The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do
As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

• Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

• Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

• Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

• Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

• Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

• Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

• Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

• Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

• AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

• Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

• Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

• Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

• Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

• Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

• Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

• Location: Based in France or Spain.

• Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

• Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

• Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

• Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

• 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

• 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

• 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

Engine is where Juno meets the user. It owns the conversation itself: how someone expresses a vague intent, how the assistant narrows it down, and how a recommendation is presented so that it is actually trusted. Nobody has settled what a great shopping conversation looks like, so there are no patterns to borrow and the answers have to be found by building and testing.

• Define how Joko recruits: Inbound, outbound, RPO management, agency relationships, tooling (Ashby), and process are all yours. You will set the standards, not just execute against them — including upskilling hiring managers so the bar is applied consistently across every panel.

• Recruit senior and critical roles yourself: You will stay close to the hardest hires. You know when to delegate and when to own the desk.

• Build a global AI strategy for recruiting: The way recruiting is done is changing drastically with AI. You will define and roll out Joko's AI strategy for TA: which parts of the funnel to automate, which tools to deploy, how to keep human judgment where it matters most, and how to turn AI into a real competitive advantage in how we source, screen, and close. You will own this end to end.

• Drive an international employer brand: We are not well known enough yet, and that is costing us. You will build an employer brand strategy that reflects who we actually are, starting in France, scaling very soon to Spain, and preparing for the US and other markets.

The strongest candidate may not have done "just" Talent — a track record that spans ops, sales, consulting, or building things beyond recruiting is a real asset here.

• Coaching mindset: You know how to develop the resourcefulness and drive of the people you manage. You see growing recruiters as part of the job, not a tax on it.

• High-bar mindset: Joko's culture is built on talent density. Our hiring managers are involved, exacting, and not afraid to pass on a 90% candidate. You find that energizing, not frustrating.

• Ops-oriented and performance-driven: You think in systems, not one-offs. You instrument the funnel, care about the numbers, and build process that holds up as the team scales.

• Analytical skills: You reason with data — funnel metrics, conversion rates, capacity plans — and you use it to drive decisions, not to decorate slides.

But you have hands-on experience deploying AI tools into a TA function, you have strong opinions formed from real attempts (and real failures), and you genuinely enjoy figuring out what works.

arbeitnow:procurement-supply-chain-lead-.description:
About Hyperscale Power
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical.
The role
As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale.
This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components.
What you will do

• Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production.

• Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts.

• Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules.

• Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues.

• Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components.

• Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors.

• Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks.

• Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners.

• Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

What you bring

• BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience.

• Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing.

• Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing.

• Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus.

• Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships.

• Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities.

• Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

What we offer

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

arbeitnow:head-of-solution-consulting-rd.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW
R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.
In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

ROLE OVERVIEW
You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Act as senior sponsor on our largest EMEA opportunities, and use account-team introductions to open new R&D relationships.

• Lead the 10x conversation. Turn Benchling's vision, from AI agents to Science Foundries, into a credible plan R&D leaders can act on, including how their scientists move onto Benchling and what changes in the lab.

• Lead and develop two first-line leaders and their team of 10. Provide in-region leadership continuity, set the scientific bar for every customer engagement, and build a succession plan as the team grows.

• Shape EMEA strategy and the roadmap. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS
This is a commercial role with a scientific core. We'll look at EMEA revenue growth and influenced pipeline, technical win rate, forecast accuracy on the technical side of deals, regional ownership of our largest R&D relationships, and the strength of your leadership bench.
 
QUALIFICATIONS

• Substantial hands-on R&D experience in biotech or pharma, with a PhD or equivalent scientific depth. You've run experiments, led programmes and know how large R&D organisations make decisions and adopt change.

• A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D.

• Experience leading through other managers, and executive presence with VPs, Heads of R&D and C-level leaders.

• Commercial ambition and a growth mindset. We'll teach you how software is sold. We can't teach how a large R&D organisation works from the inside, and that's what you bring.

• Readiness for a field role: frequent on-site time with the largest pharma and biotech companies across EMEA, plus US travel three to four times a year for team offsites and our global sales kickoff.

• Fluency in English; German or French is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Benchling or a comparable R&D platform (ELN, LIMS or R&D data platform), including leading its evaluation or rollout

• Customer-facing scientific, internal consulting, or CRO/CDMO programme leadership roles

• Presales or solution consulting experience

 
HOW WE WORK
We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

arbeitnow:business-development-intern-sc.title: Business Development Intern
arbeitnow:business-development-intern-sc.description:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.
How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?
At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.
Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.
To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.
Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility
Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?
During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.
Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.
How you will make a difference

• Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

• Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

• Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

• Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

• Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

• Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

• Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

• Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring

• An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

• Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

• An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

• Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things.

• Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us.

• An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

• Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus.

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.
What you can expect
High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.
A view of the whole business.
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.
Direct access and room to take initiative.
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.
The opportunity to build a future with us.
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.
You will also benefit from:

• Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich.

• A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

• A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference?
Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself?
We look forward to meeting you.

The role works closely with FP&A Leadership and is cross-functional with the teams’ stakeholders to track performance, analyze variances, develop financial outlooks, and support key business initiatives.
The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist has the capacity to operate autonomously and maintain a high standard of accuracy and consistency in financial outputs and supports ongoing improvements to FP&A processes and reporting.

TASKS :
Financial Planning :
• Support the development of Distalmotion’s short-, medium-, and long-term financial plans by preparing analyses, models, and inputs that align with corporate objectives
• Assist in the annual budgeting, rolling forecast, and long-range planning processes by collecting inputs from departments, validating assumptions, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency
• Build, maintain, and update financial and forecasting models under guidance from FP&A Leadership, including scenario and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making
• Support the preparation and financial evaluation of business cases for new investments and strategic initiatives, including analysis of costs, benefits, and key risks
• Prepare financial analyses and summaries that provide management with forward-looking insights on performance, profitability, and resource allocation
Financial Analysis & Performance Management :
• Support month and quarterly performance reviews by preparing standard reports, ad hoc analyses, and management presentations ensuring accuracy within communicated timelines
• Support FP&A Leadership in the preparation of budgets and forecasts by completing analysis that is presented accurately and timely
• Develop ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decision making
• Perform financial and operational performance analysis across functions, programs, and projects, supporting management’s understanding of business results
• Prepare and maintain KPI reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to provide clear visibility into actuals versus budget and forecast
• Analyze variances and key performance drivers, clearly explaining results, risks, and opportunities
• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders
• Review historical budgets, expenditures, and forecasts to identify trends and opportunities to improve planning and forecasting accuracy
• Provide meaningful insights by challenging business assumptions and educating business partners on financial issues and concepts
• Contribute to competitor, market, and industry analyses by gathering data and assessing financial implications to support strategic planning

About Benetics AI
People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.
More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.
About the role
We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next.
What we're looking for

• Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels.

• High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video.

• Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign.

• Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social.

• Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel.

• Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round.

• Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful.

• AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters.

• Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale.

• Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change.

• Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site

Experience

• 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through.

• Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus.

• Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful.

Why Benetics AI

• A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan.

• Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work.

• Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns.

• Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work.

How we hire

• Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call

• A practical case with the team.

• Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role

• Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter.

Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. The Associate Director supports the development of external international partnerships and advocacy and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison to patient advocacy organizations in Latin America, Europe and other international markets as needed, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment
  • Support the development of the patient advocacy strategy and implement an international patient advocacy plan for skeletal dysplasia, aligned with the international plan and local priorities
  • Represent BridgeBio at patient advocacy and community meetings across Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, building and strengthening relationships with patient organizations and local communities
  • Bring patient and caregiver perspectives into clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory, market access, and commercial planning, as appropriate to the stage of each program
  • Plan and deliver appropriate engagement activities, such as advisory boards, patient organization meetings, educational initiatives, community surveys, patient videos and opportunities to provide input on patient-facing materials
  • Adapt engagement and communications for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking and other international communities, ensuring materials and interactions are culturally relevant and accessible
  • Support the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy in strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives
  • Work with local and international teams to understand differences in care pathways, access barriers, community priorities, and advocacy environments across international markets
  • Coordinate international grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and program budgets in line with applicable policies and local requirements
  • Share clear, actionable community insights with internal partners while protecting individual privacy, preserving patient trust, and maintaining appropriate boundaries
  • Monitor and report changes in relevant policies and industry requirements for patient organization engagement and ensure external activities meet company standards and local laws
  • Promote a patient-first culture by communicating patient and caregiver perspectives, unmet needs, and appropriately consented stories and imagery through internal activities and company materials

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with patient organizations across countries and cultures, ideally including Latin America.
  • Understanding of patient engagement requirements, healthcare systems, and access considerations across international markets; familiarity with Europe and Latin American markets is preferred.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies.

arbeitnow:senior-technical-architect-dev.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
arbeitnow:senior-technical-architect-dev.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.

What you will do
Data Architecture & Engineering

•
Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

•
Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

•
ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

•
Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

Technical Customization & Custom Development

•
Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

•
Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

•
Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

API & Ecosystem Integrations

•
Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

•
Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

•
Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

Platform Operations & System Health

•
Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

•
Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

•
Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.

Experience and qualifications
Core Technical Competencies

•
Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

•
Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

•
Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

•
MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

Experience

•
3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

•
Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

•
Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

Key Personality Traits

•
Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

•
Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

•
Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. You will own the full sales cycle on the opportunities you source: qualification, proof of concept, business case, negotiation with procurement and close.

On a daily basis, you will

•
Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

•
Generate new leads and opportunities in entities of key accounts that are not yet Sonar customers, using a multi-channel approach (LinkedIn, email, video, cold calls and meetings) to convert identified prospects into new logos

•
Work with channel partners to generate and grow pipeline within the accounts you cover

•
Engage and grow entities that already run Sonar instances, identifying new teams, use cases, products and editions

•
Qualify opportunities with BANT and MEDDPICC to understand the customer's needs, pains, decision process, economic buyer and champion

•
Run discovery calls and demos, and guide prospects through proofs of concept and trials with Solutions Engineers, validating Sonar's value against agreed success criteria

•
Size and quote customer software license needs

•
Build the business case and mutual action plan with the customer, then drive the deal through stakeholder alignment, security and legal review, negotiation with procurement, and signature

•
Capture all account and opportunity information accurately in Salesforce (stage, next steps, forecast category, MEDDPICC fields), and use it to set daily activity and forecast the pipeline

•
Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

•
Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly targets for pipeline creation and bookings

•
Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices

The skills you will demonstrate

•
Have 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B sales role (Inside Sales, SDR/BDR moving into an AE role, Account Executive or Account Manager), ideally in a SaaS or subscription model

•
Have a proven track record of creating pipeline and closing deals, with exposure to the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation

•
Know a structured qualification methodology such as BANT and MEDDPICC, and apply it consistently to understand customer needs, pains and decision processes

•
Have experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer, as well as to business stakeholders such as security teams and procurement

•
Have proven prospecting skills across channels and tools such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling and networking

•
Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

•
Communicate confidently with executive-level contacts and tailor value messages to the persona, with both bottom-up and top-down approaches

•
Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

•
Be able to negotiate commercial terms and navigate procurement, legal and security reviews through to signature

•
Have Salesforce expertise and be highly organized: manage many accounts and opportunities in parallel, with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting

•
Be customer-centric: we want happy customers

•
Show strong communication and listening skills, handle objections well, and welcome feedback and coaching

•
Be a self-driven, proactive and hungry team player who works well in a pod structure with senior Account Managers and cares about team and company goals

•
Have experience selling software development tooling or selling into the development side of IT, and closing deals internationally (a plus)

•
Be curious about how AI-assisted development changes code quality and security

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

arbeitnow:it-system-engineer-80-100-st-g.description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.
Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.
Über Dukers
Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.
Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.
Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.
Deine Rolle
Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.
Deine Aufgaben

• Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

• Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

• Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

• Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

• Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

• Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

• Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

• Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

• Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

• Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

• Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

• Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.
Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

• Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

• Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

arbeitnow:consultant-senior-manager-cons.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
arbeitnow:consultant-senior-manager-cons.description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant
Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.
Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.
Ce que vous ferez
Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

• Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

• Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

• Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

• Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

• Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

• Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

• Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons
Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.
Ce que nous cherchons

• Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.

• Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.

• La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.

• De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.

• Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.

• Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

• Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.

• Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.

• Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

• Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.

• Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.

• Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.

• Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons
Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

• 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.

• 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.

• 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.

Candidature
Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis.

arbeitnow:senior-documentation-specialis.description:
About this position
As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.
Your tasks:

• Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

• Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

• Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

• Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

• Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

• Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

• Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

• Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

• Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

• Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

• Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

• Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

• Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

• Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

• Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Work permit
Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland
Your path forward
If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients.

arbeitnow:remote-android-developer-utrec.description:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role
As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

• Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

• Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns.

• Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early.

• Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

• Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable.

• Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues.

• Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value.

Why Luscii?
Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

• Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

• Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii .

• Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…
… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.
And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.
Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.
Want to know more about us? Here you go.
Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps
We’re a small team, doing big things.
At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.
Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.
Your itinerary
What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.
Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.
You will:

• Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

• Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

• Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

• Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack
What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.
✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.
Bonus points if you have:
✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.
 
1st class extras
Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

• Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

• Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

• A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.
