arbeitnow:quantitative-trader-crypto-opt.title: Quantitative Trader | Crypto Options
arbeitnow:quantitative-trader-crypto-opt.description:
BlockTech is hiring a Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll take ownership of our trading systems and bring new direction to the desk.
We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech
BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.
Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do?
You'll own the systems that trade our capital, from day-to-day operation to the strategies that come next. As a senior trader, you'll also use what you've learned elsewhere to shape where the desk goes.
You will:

• Own the systems. Monitor, operate, and tune our automated trading systems in live markets.

• Manage the risk. Manage positions and risk, adjusting pricing and parameters as market behaviour shifts.

• Set new directions. Bring new ideas to the desk, drawing on your previous experience.

• Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

• Spot what’s next. Identify and research new business opportunities as markets change.

What we're looking for
You'll need:

• A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

• 3+ years of quantitative trading experience.

• Proficiency in Python, with excellent numerical and algorithmic skills.

• Focus and sound judgment behind the screen when markets get busy.

Bonus points for:

• Experience at a proprietary trading firm or hedge fund, particularly with mid-frequency strategies, prediction markets or DeFi.

You don't need: crypto experience. If you've successfully traded derivatives on other asset classes and want to bring that experience to BlockTech, we want to hear from you.

Pay, location, and relocation

• Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

• Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

• Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

• Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

• Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

• Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

• An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

• An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

• Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

• Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

• Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work
We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.
This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture
At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.
In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.
We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.
Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

About DataSnipper
We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-billi.description:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance.

About the role:

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy.
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.
We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Metering & Billing

• Build real-time usage metering and credit consumption for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run

• Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan

• Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. Stripe , CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled

Licensing & Onboarding

• Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience

• Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction

Engineering & Collaboration

• Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable : idempotent, auditable, observable and secure

• Own it end-to-end , from design to production in our Python stack on Azure through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked

• Influence across functions : partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation

• Raise the bar through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return

What You Bring:

Must-Have

• 6+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally Python )

• Experience building billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems in production

• Solid experience building data-driven web APIs and distributed systems on a major cloud platform

• A strong grasp of financial correctness : idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails

• Strong fundamentals in software architecture , system design and data modelling

• Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime

• Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told

Nice-to-Have

arbeitnow:backend-engineer-real-time-vid.title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
arbeitnow:backend-engineer-real-time-vid.description:
About Stream
Stream powers real-time Chat , Video , Activity Feeds , and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role
We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.
This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on
Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

• Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

• Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

• Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

• Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

• Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

• Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you
You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

• Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

• Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

• A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

• Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

• Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

• Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

• Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

• Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

What makes this role exciting

• Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

• Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

• Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

• Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?
We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).
We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. arbeitnow:senior-manager-technology-risk.title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Assurance
arbeitnow:senior-manager-technology-risk.description:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
 
How you'll make impact
You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

• Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

• Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

• Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

• Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

• Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

• Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

• Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.

What we're looking for
Essentials

• 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

• Big Four background.

• Experience building and testing risk controls.

• A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

• Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

• Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

• Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

• Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

• Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

• Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred

• Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

• Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

• People management experience.

• Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

• Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

• Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.

You'll thrive here if

• You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

• You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

• You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

• You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

• You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team
Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.
Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.
As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.
It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.
If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

arbeitnow:senior-ml-engineer-amsterdam-4.title: Senior ML Engineer
arbeitnow:senior-ml-engineer-amsterdam-4.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision
Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision
We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus!

What you will do

• Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring.

• Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing.

• Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar).

• Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle.

• Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously.

• Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation.

• Support and mentor team members.

• Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc.

• Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team.

Your profile

• 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Skills

• Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan.

• Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data.

• Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring.

• Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment.

• Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions.

• Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.

• Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Experience with mentoring and leading team members.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

• A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

• An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

• Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

• Unlimited skin checks for you

Internship: Talent Acquisition (HR Recruitment)

Sunweb Group is looking for an enthusiastic Talent Acquisition intern to join our People, Culture & Organization team. This is a work-along internship for a student who is currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree programme and is looking to complete an internship as part of their studies. You will become part of the team and gain hands-on experience; this is not a full-time thesis assignment.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/ February 2027
Availability : 32-40 hours
Duration: 5 months
Team: POC Talent Acquisition

Your impact
At Sunweb Group, we’re looking for an enthusiastic Talent Acquisition intern to strengthen our People, Organization & Culture (POC) team. Our goal is to deliver exceptional employee experiences through a service-oriented Employee Experience approach.
In this internship, you will gain hands-on experience in Recruitment, working closely with specialists focused on Processes, People Analytics, Business Partnering and broader HR topics such as Compensation & Benefits and Onboarding.

This is a unique opportunity to learn how HR and Recruitment works from A to Z while contributing your own ideas to help us attract, support, and engage our talented people.

• Assist the Talent Acquisition Specialist with recruitment activities such as drafting job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews, and supporting the candidate journey.

• Support the full employee life cycle by handling operational tasks related to contracts, employee data, and day-to-day HR queries.

• Maintain and update employee files with accuracy and attention to detail.

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across the People team and other departments on both daily tasks and project-based initiatives.

• Stay informed about the latest HR trends and best practices to help us continuously improve our processes.

What you bring

• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree programme in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing & Communication, or a related field, and this internship forms part of your studies.

• You have a strong interest in HR and are curious to learn more about Recruitment.

• You are detail-oriented, organized, and capable of handling multiple priorities.

• You are proactive, eager to learn, and not afraid to share your own ideas.

• You enjoy working with people and can build relationships across departments as well as with candidates.

• You are tech-savvy and comfortable working with HR systems and digital tools.

• You have good verbal and written communication skills in English (Dutch is a big plus).

Let us introduce Sunweb Group
Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.

Why join our journey?

• Working for an international, ambitious, and dynamic organization

• Internship remuneration of €500 per month on full-time basis (5 days)

• We work hybrid; we’d like to see you in our Rotterdam office 3 days per week

• Attractive discount when booking with our brands (Sunweb, Eliza was Here)

There is room to work on a study-related internship assignment for approximately one day per week, depending on the requirements of your study programme and in consultation with the team.

Ready for departure?
Do you want to become part of our team as our Talent Acquisition intern? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 15 November

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.

arbeitnow:account-executive-belgian-fren.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.
We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.
But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!
 
What will you be doing?

• Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market;

• Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

• Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

• Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

• Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

• Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

• Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

 
What we're looking for

• Native French speaker;

• Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

• Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

• Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

• Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

• Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

• Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

• Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

• Customer-centric mindset;

• You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 
What we offer

• 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

• An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

• A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

• Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

• Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

• Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

• Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

• Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

• 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

• Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

• A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

• Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 
Interview Process

• Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual

• Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

• Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

• Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Over District 70
District 70 ontwikkelt stijlvolle, functionele en kwalitatieve producten voor huisdieren. Met oog voor design, gebruiksgemak en detail creëren we producten die niet alleen prettig zijn voor huisdieren, maar ook mooi passen in het interieur van hun baasjes.
Van productontwikkeling en verpakkingsdesign tot de uiteindelijke presentatie: vormgeving speelt bij District 70 een belangrijke rol. Om ervoor te zorgen dat onze producten en verpakkingen er tot in de kleinste details goed uitzien, zoeken we versterking voor ons creatieve team.
De functie
Ben jij een nauwkeurige en creatieve student met gevoel voor grafische vormgeving? Werk je graag met Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop en heb je oog voor de kleinste details? Dan zoeken wij jou! Voor District 70 zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste werkstudent die ons parttime ondersteunt bij het aanpassen, opmaken en productieklaar maken van verpakkingsontwerpen en artworks.
Je werkt nauw samen met onze Visual Designer en houdt je bezig met uiteenlopende grafische en DTP-werkzaamheden. Van het verwerken van nieuwe teksten, logo's en productinformatie tot het aanpassen van bestaande verpakkingsdesigns en het voorbereiden van bestanden voor productie.
In deze functie draait het niet alleen om creativiteit, maar vooral ook om precisie. Je hebt oog voor de kleinste details, werkt gestructureerd en zorgt ervoor dat ieder artwork zowel visueel als technisch helemaal klopt.
Wat ga je doen?

• Bestaande verpakkingsontwerpen aanpassen en opmaken in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop

• Teksten, logo’s, iconen, barcodes en andere grafische elementen toevoegen, wijzigen of vervangen

• Productinformatie en meertalige teksten nauwkeurig verwerken en controleren

• Master carton- en inner carton-artworks (shipping marks) opmaken en aanpassen

• De bestaande huisstijl en consistentie bewaken op het gebied van typografie, compositie, uitlijning en verhoudingen

• Artworks drukwerk- en productieklaar maken, met aandacht voor kleurgebruik, afloop, resolutie en dielines

• Correcties en feedback verwerken en bestanden zorgvuldig controleren voordat ze naar productie gaan

• Bestanden, versies en correctierondes overzichtelijk beheren en archiveren

• Fouten, afwijkingen en ontbrekende informatie zelfstandig signaleren en bespreken

Wat breng je mee?

• Je volgt een mbo – of hbo – opleiding in de richting van Grafisch Vormgeven, Mediavormgeving, Graphic Design, DTP, Communicatie & Multimedia Design of vergelijkbaar

• Goede kennis van Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop

• Je hebt kennis van of affiniteit met DTP, verpakkingsdesign en drukwerkvoorbereiding

• Je bent bekend met technische begrippen zoals CMYK, Pantone, afloop, resolutie, vectorbestanden, dielines en drukklare PDF's

• Je hebt een goed gevoel voor typografie, compositie en visuele consistentie

• Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een afwisselende parttimefunctie van 8 tot 16 uur per week

• Een passend salaris afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

• Flexibele werktijden, goed te combineren met je studie

• Mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen met verpakkingsdesign, DTP en artworkproductie

• Ruimte om je grafische en technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen

• De kans om bij te dragen aan de uitstraling van een designgericht huisdierenmerk

arbeitnow:lead-backend-engineer-service-.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€93.500—€126.500 EUR

arbeitnow:senior-manager-commercial-sale.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead and inspire a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering diverse markets and segments across Southern EMEA, driving results through hands-on coaching, strategic pipeline management, and a relentless focus on exceeding targets. You will combine deep commercial expertise with a passion for developing people, building the programs, partnerships, and team culture needed to sustain high performance in a fast-moving, competitive cybersecurity market. If you are a creative self-starter who thrives on both leading from the front and investing in the success of those around you, this role is for you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, expand, and coach a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering multiple Southern EMEA markets and segments — providing the resources, training, and day-to-day guidance needed to consistently achieve and exceed targets, including active call shadowing and ad hoc feedback sessions.
  • Execute and supervise end-to-end sales activities including prospecting, lead follow-up, opportunity qualification, proof of concept management, commercial negotiation, and deal closure, while proactively managing the team’s funnel to ensure both quantity and quality of opportunities are on track for quota attainment.
  • Conduct and execute quarterly business plans, create and develop new programs and campaigns in conjunction with Marketing and Sales, and design incentive plans and SPIFFs that foster a competitive, collaborative, and high-energy team environment — operating with confidence and limited guidance.
  • Set accurate business expectations and maintain clear communication with senior sales management, measuring and reporting against KPIs and creating ad hoc reports as needed, while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of SentinelOne’s full product capabilities.
  • Assist in recruiting, hiring, and onboarding top commercial sales talent, and invest deeply in the growth and long-term success of each team member through mentoring, career development, and a genuine commitment to both individual and collective goal attainment.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Proven sales management experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of exceeding goals as both an individual contributor and a team leader — cybersecurity or endpoint security experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in an indirect, two-tier go-to-market model that includes channel partners and distributors, with a solid understanding of how to maximize reach and performance through partner ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead highly skilled, motivated, and results-oriented commercial sales teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring emerging sales talent and experience delivering both positive and constructive feedback that drives real growth.
  • Exceptional communication skills — verbal, written, and presentation — combined with strong interpersonal skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the organizational ability to create and track individual and team metrics with precision.
  • A creative, “roll-up-the-sleeves” self-starter attitude with the energy to thrive in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment, and the ability to inspire a collaborative team culture focused on collective lead generation and quota attainment.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Insurance and medical allowance
  • Pension scheme
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement
  • Commuter or work-from-home allowance

Wellness & Lifestyle

Omschrijving
Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie.
Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.
Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming.
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

• Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie.

• Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie.

• Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken.

• Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan.

• Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen.

• Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's).

• Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming.

• Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.

Wat vragen wij?
Eisen

• Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting.

• Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid.

• Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers.

• Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs.

• Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid.

• Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken.

Pré

• Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM.

• Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's.

• Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie.

• Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken.

• Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten.

• Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy.

Competenties

• Overtuigend en verbindend.

• Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief.

• Analytisch en doortastend.

• Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming.

arbeitnow:senior-aws-consultant-utrecht-.title: Senior AWS Consultant
arbeitnow:senior-aws-consultant-utrecht-.description:
CloudNation helpt organisaties om het maximale uit de cloud te halen. We combineren diepgaande technische expertise met een pragmatische aanpak en bouwen samen met onze klanten aan schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.
We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Onze consultants staan midden in de uitvoering, werken nauw samen met klanten en zoeken continu naar manieren om te verbeteren en te innoveren met cloud en AI.

Wat ga je doen?
Als AWS Cloud Consultant sta je midden in de uitvoering:

• Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

• Je onderzoekt samen met klanten waar AI echt waarde toevoegt, van slimme automatisering tot generatieve AI met Amazon Bedrock.

• Je neemt de rol van meewerkend voorman: je stuurt engineers aan en werkt zelf actief mee aan de implementatie van cloudoplossingen.

• Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de delivery binnen scope, stelt een Work Breakdown Structure op en bewaakt samen met de projectmanager de voortgang, kwaliteit en planning.

• Je coacht en ontwikkelt je team volgens het ‘To do, To participate, To do it yourself’-principe.

• Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

Over deze rol
Dit is een senior rol met een duidelijke Customer Lead-overlay. Naast een sterke basis als AWS Cloud Consultant ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en verantwoordelijk voor de waarde die we samen realiseren, over de hele lifecycle.
Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder.
Als Customer Lead:

• Ben je het vaste aanspreekpunt en escalatiepunt voor de klant.

• Neem je eigenaarschap over de klantroadmap en stuur je op bedrijfswaarde.

• Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitkomsten van de delivery en stuur je bij wanneer resultaten afwijken van de verwachtingen.

• Vorm je tijdens Continuous Delivery samen met de People & Process Officer het governance-model richting de klant.

• Vertegenwoordig je intern het perspectief van de klant en breng je collega’s en partners op één lijn.

• Signaleer je kansen om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen.

Onze gedachte
We werken volgens ons 6D Delivery Model. Als Customer Lead houd je de rode draad vast over alle fasen. Het zwaartepunt van jouw deliverywerk ligt hier:
DISCOVER, DEFINE & DESIGN
Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.
DEVELOP & DEPLOY
Als meewerkend voorman stuur je engineers aan en werk je zelf mee aan de implementatie en uitrol. Je bewaakt scope, voortgang en kwaliteit, stelt de Work Breakdown Structure op en neemt eigenaarschap over de delivery, in nauwe afstemming met de klant en projectmanager.
CONTINUOUS DELIVERY
Je zorgt voor een succesvolle oplevering en blijft betrokken bij optimalisatie, innovatie en doorontwikkeling. In deze fase komt de Customer Lead-rol het sterkst naar voren: je bewaakt de klantwaarde en geeft samen met de People & Process Officer richting aan de governance.

Wat neem je mee?

• Ruime ervaring, doorgaans 5+ jaar, met AWS-services, architectuur en cloudoplossingen.

• Ervaring met AWS-frameworks zoals Well-Architected, AWS CAF en landing zones, inclusief migraties en optimalisatie.

• Sterke hands-on ervaring met Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD en het realiseren van AWS-oplossingen.

• Ervaring met het aansturen van technische teams en het nemen van eigenaarschap over complexe klantprojecten.

• Je combineert technische expertise met sterk stakeholdermanagement en stuurt op bedrijfswaarde en resultaat.

• Ervaring met AI-assisted development en AI in je dagelijkse werk, bij voorkeur met een agentic way of working.

• Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Relevante AWS-certificeringen zijn een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een marktconform salaris van 66k-115k per jaar.

• Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop, telefoon, pensioenregeling en 26 vakantiedagen.

• Een persoonlijk opleidings- en certificeringsbudget voor jouw ontwikkeling in AWS en AI.

• Ondersteuning bij het behalen van certificeringen, waarbij behaalde certificeringen terugkomen in je salaris.

• Een rol met veel eigenaarschap, waarin je een eigen klantportfolio draagt en stuurt op waarde en groei.

• Volop ruimte voor innovatie, eigen initiatief en het werken met de nieuwste cloud- en AI-technologie.

• Hybride werken, met Bunnik als thuisbasis en vrijdag als gezamenlijke kantoordag.

• Een open en ondernemende cultuur waarin we samenwerken, van elkaar leren en successen vieren.

Over CloudNation
CloudNation, an IG&H company, helpt organisaties versnellen met cloud en AI. Als AWS Premier Tier Services Partner combineren we diepgaande technische expertise met strategisch inzicht om organisaties niet alleen te moderniseren, maar ook toekomstbestendig te maken.
We geloven dat echte impact ontstaat wanneer strategie en uitvoering samenkomen. Daarom adviseren onze consultants niet alleen, maar bouwen en realiseren ze ook: van de eerste strategie tot implementatie, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.
AI? Wij maken het werkend.
We geloven in AI voorbij de hype. We bouwen het, passen het toe bij klanten én gebruiken het iedere dag zelf.

• Claude op AWS: we bouwen veilige AI-gateways in het AWS-account van de klant, met EU-inference via Amazon Bedrock en een AI Center of Excellence eromheen.

• Een AI-agentframework: we ontwikkelen agentic AI die onze delivery versnelt, bijvoorbeeld met autonome agents die audit-ready Infrastructure-as-Code opleveren.

• Productie-AI voor klanten: samen met TOPdesk ontwikkelden we TicketBuddy, een GenAI-servicedeskassistent.

• AI in ons DNA: van AI Readiness Scans bij klanten tot interne hackathons en AI-literacy, we passen zelf toe wat we adviseren.

Interesse?
Wil jij AWS-expertise combineren met technisch leiderschap en verantwoordelijkheid voor langdurige klantwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

arbeitnow:principal-senior-consultant-eu.description:
Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research

About Panteia
Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations. Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States.
Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments.

As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence.

The role
To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.
This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.
The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

Key responsibilities
Project delivery & leadership

• Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements.

• Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

• Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

Team & quality leadership

• Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

• Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

Role in acquisition & transition
The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

• Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals.

• Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage.

• Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

Position in the organisation

• Reports to: Team manager.

• Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners.

• Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility.

Practicalities

• Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model
– Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week)
– Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations.

• Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks.

Why join Panteia?

• Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience.

• Combine analytical depth with real policy impact.

• Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets.

• Work in a compact, expert-driven team.

• Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered.

• Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials.

• Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc.

What Panteia is looking for:

• 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting.

• Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment.

• Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis.

• Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills.

• Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes.

• Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus.

• MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field.

• Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed.

arbeitnow:embedded-staff-engineer-de-lie.description:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 
About Priva  
Your Future Ecosystem  
Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  
 
What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  
Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  
 
With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 
 
If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.  
 
Why this role matters
At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.
As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.
This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer
You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.
You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team
You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

arbeitnow:senior-backend-engineer-energy.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own.

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production.

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions.
As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day.

Your work will directly contribute to:

• Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe

• Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets

• Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC)

• Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses

• Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD)

What You’ll Do

Priva Digital Services & product engineering

• Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart

• Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value

• Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration

Optimization & forecasting integration

• Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory

• Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps

• Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams

• Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation

• Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions

• Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring

What you will NOT do

• This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory

• You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar

• A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field

• Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one

• You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects)

• Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript)

• You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week

• Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems

• A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering

• Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning

• Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

• A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective

What We Offer You

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience
🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price 
🏦 Excellent pension contribution 
🎓 €1,000 education budget per year 
⏰ Flexible working hours, and location. 
🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2) 
🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer. 
🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself 
🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy 
🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

Building trust in the legal profession starts with understanding the people behind it. That's why we're looking for a legal professional who can help Saga build meaningful relationships, strengthen our presence in the Dutch legal market and connect with the communities where legal professionals exchange ideas and knowledge.
As Saga's first Legal AI Growth Manager , you'll join the Marketing & Growth team and work closely with Legal Engineering, Sales and Product. This role is an opportunity for a jurist, paralegal, legal counsel or lawyer who's curious about taking their career beyond traditional legal practice, bringing their legal expertise and professional network into the world of technology, marketing and growth.

Take your legal career in a new direction, without leaving your expertise behind.
