arbeitnow:influencer-marketing-manager-a.description:
Deine Rolle
Du bist auf Instagram oder TikTok unterwegs und denkst dir regelmäßig: Der Creator würde perfekt zu Funzy passen? Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hast Spaß daran, neue Kontakte zu knüpfen und aus einer ersten Nachricht eine richtig gute Zusammenarbeit entstehen zu lassen?
Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.
Als Influencer Marketing Manager bringst du Funzy mit den richtigen Influencern und Creatorn zusammen. Du findest spannende neue Kontakte, begleitest Kooperationen von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Content und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Ansätze für unser Influencer Marketing.
Dabei bist du nah at Social Media, Creatorn und Content – und kannst deine eigenen Ideen direkt einbringen und ausprobieren.
Aufgaben:

• Du identifizierst passende Influencer und Creator für Funzy, sprichst sie proaktiv an und gewinnst sie für eine Zusammenarbeit.

• Du betreust bestehende Influencer- und Creator-Kooperationen und entwickelst langfristige Beziehungen.

• Du koordinierst Kooperationen von der ersten Abstimmung über Briefings und Content-Produktion bis zur finalen Umsetzung.

• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Ideen und Formate für unser Influencer Marketing und setzt diese operativ um.

• Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von UGC Content und Ads und koordinierst dafür Creator, Briefings und Content-Produktionen.

• Du behältst laufende Kooperationen und deren Ergebnisse im Blick und nutzt deine Learnings, um unsere Aktivitäten kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Qualifikation
Must-have:

• Erste praktische Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

• Du bist kommunikativ und hast Spaß daran, Creator proaktiv anzusprechen und Beziehungen aufzubauen.

• Du bist gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kooperationen den Überblick.

• Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media, Creator und Content und bewegst dich sicher auf Instagram und TikTok.

• Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Nice to have

• Erste Erfahrung mit UGC Content oder UGC Ads.

• Erfahrung in einer DTC-Brand, einem E-Commerce-Unternehmen, Start-up oder einer Agentur.

• Interesse an der Familien-, Lifestyle- oder Interior-Welt.
Benefits

• Einblicke in die spannende Welt eines dynamisch wachsenden E-Commerce-Start-ups mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum

• Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, unsere Marke aktiv mitzuprägen.

• Verantwortung ab Tag eins statt Micromanagement.

• Schnelle Entscheidungen und kurze Wege.

• Ein Team, das Ideen ausprobiert und nicht in endlosen Abstimmungen stecken bleibt.

• Die Möglichkeit, eine der spannendsten Familienmarken im DACH-Raum mit aufzubauen

• Modernes Arbeiten: Anspruch auf Shared Office Desk, MacBook, flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Arbeiten aus dem Home Office

• Unvergessliche Team-Events, die den Zusammenhalt stärken und für Abwechslung sorgen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für dich sowie exklusive Vorteile für Family & Friends

arbeitnow:customer-success-manager-full-.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d), Full Remote
arbeitnow:customer-success-manager-full-.description:
Deine Aufgaben bei Varify

• Du übernimmst Neukunden nach dem Abschluss vom Sales-Team und bringst sie strukturiert zum ersten erfolgreichen Test.

• Du betreust ein eigenes Kundenportfolio, führst regelmäßige Check-ins und Strategie-Calls und hilfst bei Testideen und Priorisierung.

• Du erkennst Abwanderungsrisiken früh, anhand von Nutzungsdaten und Health-Score, und gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, bevor sie kündigen.

• Du identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale, etwa auf höhere Pläne oder neue AI-Features, und übergibst oder schließt sie selbst ab.

• Du führst Kündigungsgespräche, verstehst die echten Gründe dahinter und machst Rettungsangebote.

• Du gibst strukturiertes Kundenfeedback an Produkt und Entwicklung weiter und baust Customer-Success-Prozesse mit auf.

So sieht der Job konkret aus

• Du betreust Kundenaccounts, von KMU bis Mid-Market, plus Agenturen, die Varify für ihre Kunden nutzen.

• Deine Tools: HubSpot, ChartMogul und unsere eigenen Nutzungsdaten.

• Du berichtest an Frederick Mieke (CRO) und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Support und Produkt zusammen.

• Woran wir Erfolg messen: Net Revenue Retention, Logo-Churn, Time-to-First-Test

• Du baust den Bereich mit auf. Viele Prozesse entstehen gerade erst, du gestaltest sie mit

Was du mitbringst

• Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management oder Beratung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld

• Verständnis für Online-Marketing und Web-Analytics. Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing, CRO oder GA4 ist ein großes Plus.

• Technisches Grundverständnis: Du schreckst nicht vor einem Tracking-Setup oder einem Snippet zurück.

• Du arbeitest gern mit Zahlen und priorisierst nach Daten statt nach Bauchgefühl.

• Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch, auch wenn ein Kunde gerade unzufrieden ist.

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und verhandlungssicheres Englisch, denn ein großer Teil unserer Kunden ist international.

Ihre ersten Monate bei Varify
Du lernst unsere Plattform und unsere Kundenstruktur im Team kennen und übernimmst schrittweise die eigenständige Betreuung unseres Bestandsportfolios. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt unserer Anforderungen zu hundert Prozent erfüllen, freuen wir uns dennoch über deine Bewerbung.
Das bieten wir dir
Du erhältst ein variables Jahresgehalt von EUR 53,000–72,000, welches sich einem Fixgehalt und einer Provision zusammensetzen.
Du profitierst von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Unterkunft, der Möglichkeit zum Remote arbeiten, Mitarbeiterrabatten, Mentoring, kostenlosem Parken, kostenlosen Snacks, kostenlosen Getränken, Homeoffice, einer Home-Office-Ausstattung, erlaubten Haustieren, Gutscheinen und Ermäßigungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, einem Fitnesscenter vor Ort, einem Fitnessabo, einem Firmenlaptop, einem Firmenhandy, Entschädigung für Reisekosten, bezahlten Co-Working-Optionen, beruflicher Bildung, barrierefreiem Zugang, lockerer Kleiderordnung sowie Teamevents und Firmenfeiern.
Über uns
Varify ist die europäische A/B-Testing-Plattform für Teams, die ihre Website datenbasiert optimieren wollen: cookieless, DSGVO-konform mit Hosting in Frankfurt, tief integriert in GA4 und BigQuery und zum Festpreis statt nach Traffic abgerechnet. Über 450 Unternehmen und Agenturen testen bereits mit uns.
Unsere Kunden kündigen selten wegen des Preises. Sie kündigen, wenn im Alltag die Zeit fürs Testen fehlt, wenn ihnen die Testideen ausgehen oder die Ressourcen fehlen. Genau da setzt du an: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskunden mit Varify echte Ergebnisse erzielen, langfristig bleiben und mitwachsen.

arbeitnow:business-product-owner-full-ti.title: Business Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
arbeitnow:business-product-owner-full-ti.description:
Who Are We ?
🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.
Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.
💼 About This Role
We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.
🎖️What success looks like
In your first month

• You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

• You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

By 3 months

• Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

• You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

• You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

• You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

By 6 months

• You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

• You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

• You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

• You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

• You bring 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS.

• You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

• With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

• You have an interest in software development, are eager to learn new tools and technologies, and bring basic coding experience.

• You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

• You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

• You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

• Previous experience in the logistics industry.

• Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful
We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

• Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & COO, Ksenia, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

• Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

• HR onboarding, with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

• Product onboarding session with our Product Owner, Özgür.

• A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

• Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

• We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team
We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.
🤝 Why Us
💫 A mission that matters : Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.
🏝️ Workation : Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.
🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.
👊 Witness your actions shape our direction : You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.
🏔️ Company getaway : Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect – away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?
🏢 Multiple office locations : Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.
🎟️ Employee discounts : Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.
🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.
🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.
Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

• Application review

• Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

• Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our COO & hiring manager, Ksenia.

• Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

arbeitnow:account-executive-enterprise-b.description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

arbeitnow:working-student-quality-data-b.description:
About JawBuddy
JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.
We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.
How this internship works
We offer this role in exactly two ways:

• Mandatory internship at an EU university : you are enrolled at a university in the EU and your study regulations require an internship. You send us a document from your university that confirms this. Start as soon as possible .

• Prácticas at a Spanish university : you are enrolled at a university in Spain, and the internship runs through your university's internship agreement (prácticas extracurriculares with a convenio), full-time or alongside your studies. Start from December 2026 .

We can't offer working-student contracts, voluntary internships or freelance work.
The role
You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world. You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer.

• About 60 % app and computer vision quality: real-world testing, releases, accessibility, performance

• About 25 % data quality: making sure analytics data is complete and correct

• About 15 % automation with AI: building automated tests and checks, and reviewing what they find

What you'll do
Test our computer vision in the real world

• Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

• Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

Own app quality

• Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

• Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

• Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

• Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

Keep our data trustworthy

• Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

• Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

• Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

Automate with AI

• Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

• Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

• Enrolled at an EU university with a mandatory internship in your study regulations, or at a Spanish university that signs a convenio for prácticas

• Available 20 to 40 hours a week, remote, as your university allows

• Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

• Solid SQL

• A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

• You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

• Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

• Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

• Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

• dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

• Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

• Compensation: €300 per month

• Real ownership: you own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen

• Work with AI from day one: you learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill few people have yet

• Rare experience: computer vision, health data and quality in a health product, all in one role

• Mentorship: a weekly 1:1 with our CTO

• Hours that fit your studies: 20 to 40 hours a week, as your university requires

How we hire

• Send your CV and your university document (internship requirement, or confirmation that your university can sign a convenio).

• A 30-minute call with our team.

• A short trial task: we send you a test build of the app, and you spend about 2 hours finding and reporting what's wrong. Use any AI tools you like.

• A final conversation, and an offer within a week.

Details

• Type: mandatory internship (EU university) or prácticas (Spanish university)

• Hours: 20–40 per week, depending on your university

• Location: remote within the EU

• Compensation: €300 per month

• Start: as soon as possible; prácticas in Spain from December 2026

arbeitnow:senior-data-scientist-ml-ops-e.title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
arbeitnow:senior-data-scientist-ml-ops-e.description:
Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

• Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.

• Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.

• Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.

• Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.

• Build the Data Foundation : Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.

• Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.

• Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).

• Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.

• Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).

• Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).

• Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.

• Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.

• A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️
Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!
We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.
With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️
Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role
As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.
You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.

What you'll do
Product Vision & Strategy

• Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

• Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

• Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

• Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

• Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

• Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

• Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

About the User Insights & Support Team:
 
Our team is like a navigation system for the successful experience of our users.
We don't just improve performance. We consider individual needs to provide customized training and resources tailored specifically to our clients. Interaction is at the heart of what we do. We look forward to answering questions and getting to the bottom of uncertainties.
We are proud to have an open door for feedback, because our customers' opinions drive change and improvement. We have a few pre-defined solutions, because we believe that every path should be unique.
The UsIS team is more than ‘just’ support. We are comrades-in-arms, believing in the vision and encouraging each other to take each step with confidence.
 
You will be taking care of

• Splitting your time between AI and automation projects (75%) and hands-on support (25%), working closely with our support and product teams.

• Maintaining and expanding the internal knowledge base for Fin, the AI agent that answers our customers’ questions in Intercom, our customer support platform. You’ll write and update articles, get facts verified by product owners, and keep content up to date.

• Reviewing real Fin conversations to spot failure patterns like wrong answers, missing content, or dead ends, fixing the root cause, and testing every change in Fin Operator or Betterbot before it goes live.

• Owning Fin’s escalation, routing, and automation logic, and implementing changes when the team wants the bot to behave differently.

• Helping our users directly by answering support requests, keeping you close to real customer questions and giving you firsthand insight into where Fin can improve.

You check these boxes

• You’re an enrolled student based in Berlin, available for around 20 hours per week.

• You have hands-on experience building workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. Uni projects and side projects count too!

• You have an eye for accuracy and like to get things right. Checking facts comes naturally to you, and you’d rather ask a question than make a guess.

• You’re self-sufficient and enjoy taking ownership of your work, while staying open to ideas and feedback from your teammates. When something doesn’t work, you focus on finding a solution together.

• You’re fluent in English, written and spoken, and write clear, precise documentation. German is not required.

Take your chance
Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing, and quick decision-making that moves things forward.

At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.

Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.

• Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

  • Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

  • Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

  • Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

  • Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

  • Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

  • Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

  • Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

  • Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

  • An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

  • Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • GPU or AI accelerator programming..

  • Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

  • Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

  • LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

  • Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

  • Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

  • Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

  • Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

  • Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

arbeitnow:senior-software-engineer-ml-in.description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

arbeitnow:team-lead-sales-steuerkanzleie.description:
Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment entwickelst du ein wachsendes Team regionaler Account Executives weiter: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln.

Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

• 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

• 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

• 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden.

• 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission
Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.
In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team

• Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

• Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

• Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

• Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

• Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

• Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

• Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen Kanzleimarkt.

• Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

• Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

• Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

• Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

• Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

• Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

• Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

• Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

• Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil

• Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

• Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

• Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

• Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

• Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

• Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

• Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

• 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

• 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

• 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

• 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

• 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

• 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

• 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

• 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.
Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. arbeitnow:sdr-sales-development-represen.title: SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)
arbeitnow:sdr-sales-development-represen.description:
SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)
Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office (Montag und Donnerstag)
Du hast bereits mindestens zwei Jahre B2B-Sales-Erfahrung und willst im Inbound-Vertrieb für den deutschen Mittelstand richtig Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Pennylane in Berlin qualifizierst du Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, verstehst ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup und ihre Herausforderungen und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise.
Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?
Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?
Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision
Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.
Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.
Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.
In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

• 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

• 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

• 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

• 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

• 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

• 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?
Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.
Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.
Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du berichtest direkt an Jacob, unseren Global Head of Sales SME, und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau unseres deutschen SME-Vertriebs ein – mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing bringen wir dich schnell auf Pennylane-Niveau.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?
Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.
Die größte Herausforderung: Tempo, Volumen und Qualifizierungstiefe in Balance halten. Du reagierst schnell auf deutsche Interessent:innen und gehst gleichzeitig tief genug, um ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup, ihre geschäftlichen Herausforderungen und die Komplexität ihres Falls wirklich zu verstehen.
Konkret heißt das:

• Du qualifizierst deutsche KMU-Leads: Unternehmensprofil, aktuelle Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Tools, Pain Points, Bedarf und Kaufkontext

• Du machst aus qualifizierten Leads hochwertige Termine mit dem passenden Account Executive – relevant, sauber terminiert und mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass sie stattfinden

• Du sorgst für eine saubere Übergabe und dokumentierst Qualifizierung, Use Cases, Stakeholder, Dringlichkeit, aktuelles Setup und nächste Schritte in Salesforce

• Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

• Du entwickelst unseren deutschen SME-Vertrieb mit: Du teilst Marktfeedback, verbesserst unser Messaging und arbeitest eng mit AEs, Marketing und dem gesamten Sales-Team zusammen

• Optional, je nach Erfahrung: Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales-Zyklus für Self-Sign-up-Abbrecher – du reaktivierst Interessent:innen, die ihre Registrierung nicht abgeschlossen haben, zeigst ihnen die passende Lösung und schließt die Opportunity selbst ab

Dein Erfolg misst sich vor allem an stattgefundenen qualifizierten Terminen, Show-Rate, Akzeptanz durch die AEs, der Conversion von Termin zu validierter Opportunity und der beeinflussten Pipeline. Die Ziele kalibrieren wir gemeinsam am Volumen und der Reife des deutschen Marktes.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?
So sieht dein Einstieg bei uns aus:
Die ersten 30 Tage

• Du lernst Pennylanes Produkt, unseren Ideal Customer, den deutschen Marktkontext, unsere Qualifizierungsmethodik, Salesforce und unsere internen Sales-Prozesse kennen und begleitest SDR- und AE-Calls (Shadowing)

Bis Tag 60

• Du qualifizierst deutsche Leads eigenständig, erkennst ihre zentralen Pain Points und übergibst sie mit vollständigen, verwertbaren Notizen an den richtigen AE

Bis Tag 90

• Du verantwortest den gesamten Qualifizierungsprozess für deutsche SME-Leads, erfüllst die vereinbarten Aktivitäts- und Qualitätsstandards, lieferst einen verlässlichen Fluss hochwertiger Termine und identifizierst erste Hebel für bessere Conversion und besseres Messaging

Nach 12 Monaten

• Du bist ein verlässlicher, autonomer SDR für den deutschen SME-Markt, erreichst oder übertriffst deine KPIs, kennst deutsche Kundenprofile, Buchhaltungs-Workflows und typische Einwände aus dem Effeff und wirst von den AEs als Quelle hochwertiger Opportunities geschätzt

• Du prägst unser deutsches Sales-Playbook mit und beschleunigst den Aufbau unseres SME-Go-to-Market in Deutschland

• Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

• Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit – als SDR/BDR, im Inside Sales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise in SaaS, Fintech, Buchhaltungssoftware oder einem anderen beratungsintensiven Vertriebsumfeld

• Du führst starke Discovery- und Qualifizierungsgespräche: Du verstehst das Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Setup eines Unternehmens, erkennst Pain Points, Dringlichkeit und Entscheider:innen und beurteilst, ob eine Anfrage zu Pennylane passt

• Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, Follow-up-Disziplin und CRM-Sorgfalt: hohes Lead-Volumen, saubere Salesforce-Daten, hochwertige Übergaben an die AEs

• Du bist neugierig, kundenorientiert und ein:e starke:r aktive:r Zuhörer:in – du stellst die richtigen Fragen und gibst dich nicht mit Oberflächenantworten zufrieden

• Du bist resilient, diszipliniert und proaktiv: Du gehst souverän mit Absagen um, bleibst beim Nachfassen dran und hältst in einem schnellen Sales-Umfeld ein hohes Tempo

• Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache)

• Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Inbound-Qualifizierung und Salesforce, Verständnis für Buchhaltungs-, Finanz- oder ERP-Prozesse, Erfahrung im Verkauf an Steuerberater:innen, Finanzteams oder Geschäftsinhaber:innen – und Französischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

• 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher

• 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche (Montag und Donnerstag) in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel; gelegentliche Reisen

• 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

• 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

• 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

• 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

• 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

• 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

• 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

• 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

• 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Ver

About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

At Staffbase, security is at the heart of everything we build. Our Product Security team helps keep our products and customer data secure while enabling engineering teams across the company. We believe the best security work happens when people bring their authentic selves and diverse perspectives to the table and we’re proud of the unique mix of talents and backgrounds in our team.

As an enablement team, we provide tools, guidance, and insights that allow developers to integrate security early in the development process. We see security not as a blocker but as a trusted partner that is the foundation for better products. With us, you’ll get hands-on experience with modern security practices, mentorship from experienced engineers, and the chance to make a visible impact in a global SaaS environment.

We work together with curiosity, humility, and a growth mindset, supporting each other, taking ownership of our contributions, and celebrating progress along the way. Here, your ideas matter, your work will shape how we build secure products, and you’ll have space to grow into new challenges.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Take ownership of tasks that improve our security automation and strengthen our product security pipelines
  • Proactively explore the use of AI for vulnerability detection and remediation
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge about how vulnerabilities apply in our specific product context
  • Support the team by enhancing our services with software engineering solutions
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders across the product department and gain broad exposure to how a growing SaaS company operates
  • Maintain our outbound e-mail security by regularly reviewing the related metrics
  • Maintain our Web Application Firewall ruleset
  • Kubernetes security
  • CI/CD pipelines security
  • Maintain our central HTML sanitization service written in TypeScript

What you need to be successful 

  • Practical knowledge of security topics (e.g. penetration testing, secure software development, vulnerability management, SAST, DAST)
  • Strong programming skills, preferably one of the following: TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, Go, or Python
  • Practical knowledge of Unix and Kubernetes infrastructure, preferably managed via Terraform and Kustomize
  • Strong communication skills in English (German is a plus)

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we’re offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

About the Team
The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.
The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex) , leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.
As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights.
Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.
This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

• Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts.

• Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption.

• Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures.

• Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges.

• Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities.

• Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development.

• Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams.

• Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering.

• Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact.

• Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

• Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

• Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers.

• Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

• Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

• Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained.

• Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions.

• Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

• Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles.

• Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

• Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Customer Success Advisors exist to help customers sustain value .

arbeitnow:corporate-security-engineer-be.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman
Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com .

The Opportunity
Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.
We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.
This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.
In this role, you will:

• Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

• Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

• Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

• Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

• Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

• Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

• Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

• Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

• Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

• Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

• Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

• Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, and Coupa.

• Strong experience with both macOS and Windows endpoint security.

• Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

• Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

• Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

• A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

• Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Compensation and Benefits

• Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

• A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

• Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

• Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply
At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.
For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here .
