arbeitnow:moodle-e-learning-specialist-d.title: Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)
arbeitnow:moodle-e-learning-specialist-d.description:
Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)
Schwerpunkt: Interaktive Lernmedien, Didaktik und digitale Lernplattformen
Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche)
Arbeitgeber: XRbit gUG (haftungsbeschränkt)
Arbeitsort: Dortmund - 100 Prozent Home Office eventuell möglich
Über uns
Die XRbit gUG entwickelt innovative digitale Anwendungen für Bildung, Forschung und Kultur. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen auf Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und interaktiven Lerntechnologien.
Gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungseinrichtungen, Unternehmen und Bildungspartnern entwickeln wir neue Wege der Wissensvermittlung – von virtuellen Trainingsumgebungen bis hin zu digitalen Weiterbildungsangeboten.
Für den Aufbau und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Moodle-basierten Lernplattform suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit.
Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Lernangebote. Dabei verbindest du technische Möglichkeiten mit kreativer Mediengestaltung und didaktischem Verständnis.
Deine Schwerpunkte:

• Moodle-Plattform: Du gestaltest die Struktur unserer Lernplattform, entwickelst Kurskonzepte und nutzt die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten von Moodle und seinen Erweiterungen.

• Interaktive Lerninhalte: Du erstellst abwechslungsreiche Lernmodule mit H5P, interaktiven Videos, Quizformaten, Lernspielen, Verzweigungen und multimedialen Übungen.

• 2D-Animation und Mediengestaltung: Du entwickelst anschauliche Grafiken, einfache Animationen, Erklärsequenzen und visuelle Elemente für unsere digitalen Kurse.

• Didaktische Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe Fachinhalte in verständliche, motivierende und zielgruppengerechte Lernangebote. Dazu gehören Lernziele, Lernpfade, Übungen und Feedbackmechanismen.

• Weiterentwicklung und Innovation: Du erprobst neue Moodle-Funktionen, Plugins und Autorentools und entwickelst Ideen, wie KI, Gamification und perspektivisch auch VR-/AR-Inhalte sinnvoll in Lernprozesse eingebunden werden können.

• Qualitätssicherung: Du testest Lernangebote mit Blick auf Verständlichkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Barrierearmut und Lernerfolg.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und den fachlichen Projektpartnern zusammen. Bei komplexeren technischen Aufgaben, beispielsweise Serveradministration, Programmierung oder Schnittstellenentwicklung, wirst du von unseren Softwareentwicklern unterstützt.
Dein Profil
Wir suchen eine vielseitige Persönlichkeit, die technische Neugier, Kreativität und Freude an der Wissensvermittlung miteinander verbindet.
Das solltest du mitbringen:

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Moodle oder vergleichbaren Lernmanagementsystemen und die Bereitschaft, dich intensiv mit Moodle auseinanderzusetzen.

• Erfahrung mit der Erstellung digitaler Lerninhalte, insbesondere interaktiver Übungen, Quizformate oder multimedialer Kurse.

• Kenntnisse in H5P oder vergleichbaren Autorentools.

• Fähigkeiten in der visuellen Gestaltung und idealerweise praktische Erfahrung bei der Erstellung von 2D-Animationen, beispielsweise mit After Effects, Adobe Animate, Rive oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.

• Didaktisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Inhalte in sinnvoll strukturierte Lernprozesse zu überführen.

• Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, neue Werkzeuge und Technologien auszuprobieren.

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse zur Erstellung und Abstimmung deutschsprachiger Lerninhalte.

Besonders interessant sind außerdem:

• Erfahrungen mit Gamification, adaptiven Lernpfaden oder spielerischen Lernformaten.

• Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript oder der Anpassung von Moodle-Themes und Plugins.

• Erfahrungen mit SCORM, xAPI oder der Einbindung externer Lernanwendungen.

• Kenntnisse in der beruflichen Bildung, Erwachsenenbildung oder Medienpädagogik.

• Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Werkzeugen für die Erstellung von Lernmaterialien, Grafiken und Animationen.

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Ob du deine Fähigkeiten im Studium, in einer Ausbildung, im Beruf oder autodidaktisch erworben hast: Entscheidend ist, was du praktisch umsetzen kannst.
Du musst nicht alles bereits beherrschen. Wichtig ist uns, dass du mehrere dieser Bereiche miteinander verbinden kannst und dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest.
Das erwartet dich bei XRbit

• Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet an der Schnittstelle von Bildung, Technologie und Mediengestaltung.

• Die Möglichkeit, eine digitale Lernplattform von Beginn an maßgeblich mitzugestalten und langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.

• Viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen und die Erprobung neuer Lerntechnologien.

• Die Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Softwareentwicklung, 3D-Gestaltung, Forschung und Bildung.

• Spannende Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte, unter anderem in der beruflichen Bildung, im Handwerk und in der Kreislaufwirtschaft.

• Die Möglichkeit, neue Werkzeuge und KI-Anwendungen in die eigene Arbeit einzubinden.

• Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem gemeinnützigen Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, Bildung innovativer und zugänglicher zu gestalten.

Deine Bewerbung
Du findest dich in diesem Profil wieder und möchtest digitale Bildung aktiv mitgestalten?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
Schicke uns bitte einen Lebenslauf und, soweit vorhanden, Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeiten. Besonders interessant sind für uns selbst entwickelte Moodle-Kurse, H5P-Anwendungen, interaktive Lernmodule, Animationen oder vergleichbare Projekte.
Ein Bewerbungsfoto oder Angaben zu deinem Geburtsdatum benötigen wir nicht.

Möglicher Eintrittstermin: 15.01.2027
Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung sowie sexueller Identität.

arbeitnow:lead-ai-engineer-remote-berlin.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
arbeitnow:lead-ai-engineer-remote-berlin.description:
Worum es geht
MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.
Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.
Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.
Was du bei uns machst
Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.
Deine Schwerpunkte:

• Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

• Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

• Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

• Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

• Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

• Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

• Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

• Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

• Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

• Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

• Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

• Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

• Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

• Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA
Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.
Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

• Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

• Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

• Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung
Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.
Bewerbung und nächste Schritte
Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?
Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.
Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

arbeitnow:senior-product-engineer-ai-rem.title: (Senior) Product Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
arbeitnow:senior-product-engineer-ai-rem.description:
What we do
MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.
On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.
Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.
What you'll do
As a Product Engineer, you own features from start to finish: from conversations with customers and concept work through to implementation and continuous improvement in production.
What you can work on:

• Understanding customers and the market. You talk to users, join customer meetings and analyse usage data. This way, you find out where MAIA can help most in people's daily work. You work closely with product management and customer success.

• From problem to concept. You write concepts, build prototypes to test ideas quickly, and slice features so they reach users early.

• Building across the full stack. You write the implementation plan, let coding agents implement it, and own architecture and quality, from the data model to the user interface.

• AI that people understand. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context, letting agents complete multi-step tasks and following their results.

• Measuring and improving. After a release, you check whether a feature is used and actually helps, and you keep improving it based on feedback, usage data and evals.

What we're looking for

• Solid software engineering. You have built products that people use every day and operated them in production, across backend and frontend. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

• Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

• Product experience. You have talked to customers, questioned requirements and taken features from the first idea to daily use. You listen closely and recognise the problem behind a request.

• A feel for good usability. You notice when an interface overwhelms people, and you'd rather build a simple solution that people understand than a powerful one that nobody finds.

• At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects, and you know their quirks: answers vary, take time, and agents fail in unexpected places. You build products that deal with this honestly.

• Measure, don't guess. You check whether a feature works using usage data, feedback and evals. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem.

• Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

• Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

• Clear communication. People understand your concepts on first read. You enjoy talking to customers as much as to engineers. You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, as many of our customer conversations are in German.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.
Working at MAIA
We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.
Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

• Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

• Support for training that fits your professional development

• Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation
The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.
Application and next steps

arbeitnow:senior-devops-platform-enginee.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer – AI Infrastructure (m/w/d)
arbeitnow:senior-devops-platform-enginee.description:
Worum es geht
MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.
Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.
Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.
Was du bei uns machst
Als unsere erste dedizierte DevOps-Person verantwortest du Infrastruktur und Betrieb von MAIA und entwickelst unsere bestehende Plattform für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt weiter. Die Rolle lebt von enger Abstimmung mit dem Engineering-Team.
Woran du arbeiten kannst:

• Plattform und Deployments. Der Großteil unserer Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner, auf dedizierten Servern und Cloud-VMs. Du betreibst diese selbst administrierten Linux-Systeme und bindest ergänzend Dienste von AWS, Azure und GCP an, vor allem für KI-Services. Mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und erprobten Rollbacks machst du Änderungen sicher und reproduzierbar.

• PostgreSQL im Betrieb. Du verantwortest Performance, Connection Pooling und Kapazitäten und stellst mit getesteten Backups und Restores sicher, dass wir Daten zuverlässig wiederherstellen können.

• Observability. Du entwickelst unseren selbst betriebenen Observability-Stack weiter, verbindest Metriken, Logs und Traces und etablierst Alerting, das zu konkreten Handlungen führt.

• Sicherheit und Compliance. Du setzt Least Privilege, Secrets Management, Vulnerability Scanning und Patch Management konsequent um. Für unser laufendes ISO-27001-Vorhaben automatisierst du prüfbare Nachweise.

Was wir suchen

• Selbst betriebene Systeme. Du hast produktive SaaS-Systeme auf selbst administrierten Linux-Servern betrieben. Erfahrung ausschließlich mit vollständig gemanagten Cloud-Diensten reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus. Erfahrung mit Hetzner ist ein Plus.

• Container und Automatisierung. Docker und Docker Compose setzt du sicher in Produktion ein, ebenso Reverse Proxies oder API Gateways wie Traefik oder Kong. Infrastruktur verwaltest du mit Terraform, NixOS oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen, CI/CD baust du mit GitHub Actions oder ähnlichen Systemen.

• PostgreSQL in Produktion. Backups und Restores hast du selbst eingerichtet und getestet. Performance-Analyse und Connection Pooling sind dir vertraut.

• Observability und Sicherheit. Du hast einen Observability-Stack selbst betrieben, etwa mit Grafana, Loki und Prometheus. Sicherheit setzt du im Alltag um, von Berechtigungen und Secrets bis zu Sicherheitsupdates.

• Verständnis für KI-Systeme. Du kennst die Grundlagen von RAG-Systemen und ihre typischen Fehlerquellen im Betrieb. Bei LLM-Serving kannst du Zielkonflikte zwischen Latenz, Durchsatz, Kosten und Betriebsaufwand einordnen. Neue Modelle und Anbieter verfolgst du aus eigenem Interesse.

• Eigenständig und sorgfältig. Du treibst Themen selbst voran, untersuchst unbekannte Systeme, bis du sie verstehst, und priorisierst nach Risiko und Wirkung. Komplexität hältst du beherrschbar, und Verbesserungen bringst du bis in den laufenden Betrieb.

• Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag, auch bei Infrastruktur. Du prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch, besonders bevor etwas in Produktion geht.

• Klar kommunizieren. Auch bei Störungen bleibst du ruhig und klar. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du verständlich, auch Menschen ohne technischen Hintergrund. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle ist eine Senior-Rolle ohne Personalverantwortung.
Arbeiten bei MAIA
Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.
Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

• Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

• Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

• Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung
Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 80.000 bis 90.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.
Bewerbung und nächste Schritte
Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?
Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.
Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

arbeitnow:verkaufsleiter-lk-1145-cologne.description:
Unser Mandant ist eines der mit Abstand erfolgreichsten Handelsunternehmen der Sanitär-, Haustechnik- und Tiefbaubranche in Deutschland.
Als zukünftiger Stelleinhaber (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie in dieser verantwortungsvollen Schlüsselposition die Gesamtverantwortung für das Rheinland und steuern und gestalten die vertriebliche Entwicklung im Vertriebsgebiet mit insgesamt 11 Standorten inklusive der 3 Hauptstandorte in Köln, Aachen und Bonn sowie der Ausstellungen und Profi-Stores. In Summe sind Ihnen im Innen- und Außendienst 82 Mitarbeiter unterstellt, für deren Führung und Förderung Sie verantwortlich zeichnen werden.
Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die über die Fähigkeit verfügt, eine gewachsene Region kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und strategisch wie operativ entscheidend zu prägen. Dabei bietet unser Kunde viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
Arbeitsort: Niederlassungen in Köln plus Reisetätigkeit
Aufgaben

• Führung, Steuerung und Entwicklung sämtlicher Vertriebsaktivitäten für die Region

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der Ihnen unterstellten MitarbeiterInnen (teils über Teamleiterstrukturen)

• Unterstützung der Kundenbetreuung im Außendienst durch Begleitung, Coaching und Schulung der Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie im Einzelfall eigene Besuche

• Betreuung und Beratung von Großkunden und Gewinnung von Neukunden

• Planung von Absatz, Umsatz, Kosten und Ergebnis sowie deren Controlling

• Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie Ausbau neuer Marktpotenziale

• Sicherstellung effizienter vertrieblicher Abläufe und klarer Verantwortlichkeiten

• Weiterentwicklung von Strukturen, Führungsprozessen und Arbeitsweisen

• Impulsgebung für eine moderne, kundenorientierte und leistungsstarke Vertriebs-organisation

• Erarbeitung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien und verkaufsfördernden Maßnahmen

• Durchführung von Marktrecherchen und Wettbewerbsanalysen

Qualifikation
Aufgrund Ihres beruflichen Ausbildungs- und Werdegangs verfügen Sie sowohl über fundierte kaufmännische als auch technische Kenntnisse und konnten mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung in einer Führungsposition im Bereich der Haustechnik oder gerne auch angrenzenden Branchen sammeln. Wichtig sind Erfahrungen aus Unternehmen mit vergleichbaren Handelsstrukturen bzw. aus mehrstufigen Vertriebsorganisationen wie beispielsweise in den Bereichen Baustoffe/ Bauelemente oder Gebäudetechnik/ Elektro.
Sowohl der Umgang mit Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung, als auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln sind Ihnen vertraut.
Persönlich zählen zu Ihren Stärken eine strukturierte, ergebnis- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine ausgeprägte Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
Sie sind durchsetzungsfähig, konfliktfähig und verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Überzeugungskraft.
Ebenso punkten Sie mit hoher sozialer Kompetenz und der Fähigkeit, Menschen zu motivieren und zu begeistern.
Gute Kenntnisse in den MS-Office Programmen und vorzugsweise in SAP R/3 sind wünschenswert.
Eine natürliche Führungskompetenz, Teamorientierung sowie eine ausgeprägte analytisch-strategische Kompetenz runden Ihr Profil ab.

arbeitnow:sector-lead-insights-consultin.description:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate. 
 
Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow. 
 
Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you. 

The role

As Sector Lead, Insights Consulting, you will report to the Regional Head of Insights Consulting and be responsible for the success, growth and retention of our strategic clients within your assigned sector across the region.

You will provide strategic leadership for the sector, taking direct responsibility for key accounts while supporting Client Leaders in managing and developing medium-sized and smaller accounts. You will play a key role in driving client satisfaction, business growth and team performance.

Acting as a senior research strategist and thought leader in communications and marketing measurement, you will help clients understand the value of their measures through data-driven insights and strategic advice

Alongside your client responsibilities, you will lead, coach and develop a team of senior professionals, ensuring the delivery of high-quality insights and consulting services that meet the needs of both domestic and global clients.

Duties and responsibilities

The role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Drive sector growth and client retention: Develop and implement strategies to grow client relationships, strengthen retention and identify opportunities for account development within your sector.
  • Lead and develop the team: Manage, coach and mentor a team of Senior Insights Consultants and Insights Consultants, supporting their professional development and overall performance.
  • Provide strategic client leadership: Lead key accounts and support Client Leaders in developing and delivering effective strategies for medium-sized and smaller clients.
  • Support business development: Act as a senior communications and marketing research strategist and thought leader, contributing to new business opportunities, client pitches and upselling initiatives.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality products and services that meet client needs.
  • Drive innovation: Identify opportunities to improve our products and services, champion new approaches and support the adoption of innovative solutions across your sector.

Essential skills and experience

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Fluency in both English and German, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
  • At least 5 years' experience in driving strategic customer growth, retention and account development.
  • 2–3 years' experience managing client relationships and leading or developing small teams.
  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to identify opportunities for business growth and long-term client partnerships.
  • Excellent client relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to coach and develop team members while maintaining high standards of client service and delivery.
  • A willingness to travel approximately 5–10% of the time.

What We Offer

arbeitnow:forward-deployed-engineer-muni.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
arbeitnow:forward-deployed-engineer-muni.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

arbeitnow:outcome-testing-and-controls-a.description:
About Allica Bank
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
Role Description
This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.
The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.
Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities

• Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 

• Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 

• Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 

• Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

• Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 

• Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 

• Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 

• Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 

• Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

• Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 

• Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 

• Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

• Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 

• Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 

• A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 

• Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 

• Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 

• Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 

• Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 

• Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

• Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

Working at Allica Bank
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

• Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

• Options for flexible working

• Regular social activities

• Pension contributions

• Discretionary bonus scheme

• Private health cover

• Life assurance

• Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
Flexible working
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
Diversity
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

arbeitnow:senior-engineering-manager-age.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
arbeitnow:senior-engineering-manager-age.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.
  • Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.
  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.
  • A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.
  • Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.
  • Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.
  • Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. arbeitnow:learning-design-training-produ.title: Learning Design & Training Product Manager
arbeitnow:learning-design-training-produ.description:
Location: Bracknell, UK (hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Type: Full-time, 37.5 hour
Reports to: Head of Portfolio
The role in brief
Most learning designers build courses. In this role, you will own them.
As our Instructional Design & Training Products Manager, you will take a portfolio of professional training products from first idea to finished, quality-assured release, and keep them at their best for as long as they are in use. The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters.
You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better.
If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you.
Why this role matters
This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.
Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.
What you will do

• Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

• Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

• Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation.

• Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

• Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

• Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

• Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

• Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

• Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.

What you will bring

• At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

• A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery.

• A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis.

• A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading.

• Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once.

• Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning.

• Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat.

• Excellent written English, to publication standard.

Nice to have

• Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry.

• E-learning or blended learning development experience.

• A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification.

• An understanding of IP and contract frameworks.

• Experience using AI in content development.

What success looks like

• 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time.

• 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards.

• A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks.

• Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year.

• AI used effectively across the development process.

• Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality.

Join Baines Simmons
Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.
We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance.
We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you.
One organisation, four brands
Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four .
Why people stay
We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work.
Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need.
If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be.
How we work with AI
TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role. In this role that means using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gamma) to draft and structure content, accelerate documentation and reports, and support knowledge management, while critically reviewing and refining every AI-generated output for accuracy, clarity and professional quality. You will design and apply AI-enabled workflows that make product development faster and more consistent, look for new places to integrate AI into our processes, and share what works with the team. You will complete our AI fluency onboarding within your first 30 days and spend four hours a month experimenting with AI tools and building your skills.
Where and how you will work

• Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00

• Work pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in our Bracknell office

• Travel: Occasional travel as required

• On-call or shift work: None

• Screening or clearance: Criminal record check required

What we offer

• Competitive salary of £38,000 to £44,000

• Generous holiday allowance

• Company pension contribution

• Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical

• Support for personal career development

• Flexible working arranged with your manager

Ready to apply?
Send us your CV. We would also love a short cover letter telling us about a training product you designed and are proud of: what the need was, how you approached it, and what difference it made.

arbeitnow:remote-devops-engineer-cimar-l.description:

Our technology empowers healthcare organisations to optimise image management processes, enhance patient care, and streamline workflows through seamless integration and actionable data insights.

Job Summary

The DevOps Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within the Platform Engineering team, responsible for supporting and evolving DeepHealth's AWS-based infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD tooling, and operational processes. Working closely with the Senior Platform Engineer, this role focuses on infrastructure automation, cloud operations, platform reliability, and continuous improvement. The DevOps Engineer plays an important part in helping development teams deliver software efficiently while ensuring that DeepHealth's infrastructure remains secure, scalable, and resilient.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
· Design, build, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tooling (Terraform or equivalent), ensuring consistency, repeatability, and version control.
· Manage and improve Kubernetes platforms (EKS or similar), including cluster configuration, scaling, upgrades, and reliability.
· Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable software delivery across development teams.
· Monitor platform health and performance, respond to incidents, and drive root cause analysis and resolution to maintain high availability.
· Automate operational processes and repetitive tasks to reduce toil and improve team efficiency.
· Implement and maintain cloud security best practices including IAM policies, network security, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
· Support development teams with platform tooling, onboarding to infrastructure services, and resolving environment-level issues.
· Manage container image pipelines and registry, including security scanning and lifecycle management.
· Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure, processes, runbooks, and architectural decisions.
· Contribute to cost monitoring and optimisation across cloud services, identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience:
· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).
· 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure role (required).
· Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, and related) (required).
· Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments (required).
· Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent (required).
· Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform (required).
· Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar for automation (required).
· Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and VPNs (required).
· Security-conscious approach to infrastructure design and operations (required).
· Preferred: Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar).
· Preferred: Familiarity with GitOps practices and tooling (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux).
· Preferred: AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect).
· Preferred: Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare or finance.

Quality Standards
• Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
• Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
• Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
• Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
• Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
• Practices universal safety precautions.
• Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
• Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
• Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
• Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Physical Demands
This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.

Travel
This position may require occasional travel.

Working Environment
Remote

“The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Salary
£60,000 - £70,000 per year

This is a Hybrid role working from any of our UK offices (Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh and London) 2 days a week

arbeitnow:technical-account-manager-uk-l.description:
The Role

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.
You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.
This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.
We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

• Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

• Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

• Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

• Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

• Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

• Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

• Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

• Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

• Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

• Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function.

What We're Looking For

• You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

• You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

• You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

• You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

• You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room.

• You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

• You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

• You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

• You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

• 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

• Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

• Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

• Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

• Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

• Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

• Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently.

• Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through.

• Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

• Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice to Haves

• Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers.

• Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents.

• Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

• Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman.

• Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent).

• Bring in Legal Intelligence, Support Engineering, Product and Engineering when the engagement needs them

• Help customers prepare their teams for change, working with Enablement on rollout and training

• Turn what you learn into delivery templates, governance models and planning standards for complex engagements

• Share patterns and recurring blockers with the wider Transformation team and Product

What we're looking for

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication

Typical Backgrounds Include

Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead long-term market research and scenario modeling: Spearhead Kpler's multi-decade (5 to 25+ year) research coverage and fundamental supply, demand, and trade scenarios for crude oil, refined products, NGLs, and low-carbon fuels.

• Analyze structural market drivers and transition pathways: Deliver in-depth research on upstream capital investment, OPEC+ and non-OPEC capacity shifts, refinery configuration trends, transport electrification, and evolving environmental policies.

• Anchor macro projections in granular trade flows: Leverage Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level tracking to translate multi-decade macro perspectives into actionable implications for regional balances, trade routes, refining margins, and midstream infrastructure.

• Author authoritative research publications: Produce regular, high-impact outlook publications, strategic research notes, and thematic market commentary under Kpler’s Insights banner, clearly framing key assumptions and structural uncertainties.

• Synthesize cross-commodity dynamics: Collaborate with Kpler’s Gas, LNG, and Power research analysts to ensure cohesive, system-wide market assumptions, while benchmarking models against international agencies such as the IEA, EIA, and OPEC.

• Serve as a trusted market authority: Represent Kpler’s research in executive client briefings, commercial advisory sessions, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements.

Experience & Background

Essential:

• 5+ years of prior experience in energy market analysis, energy modelling or strategy, with a focus on oil and liquids markets

• Proven experience building and maintaining supply and demand or scenario models, including a good understanding of the drivers of long-term outlooks

• Strong understanding of the oil and refined products value chain and of energy transition dynamics

• Experience in producing independent market analysis and insights

• Skilled at conducting complex analyses across multiple datasets using advanced data analytics tools

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Desirable:

• Knowledge of gas, LNG, power or low-carbon fuels and how they interact with liquids markets

• Previous experience using Kpler data or other cargo tracking tools

• Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data science tools

Job Title: Account Executive

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years

What about us?

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀

The Role

As an Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own new-business revenue from first contact to signed contract, working entirely from our office. You will source your own leads, run cold outreach by phone and email, deliver product demos, and close deals remotely, with no field visits.

This is a full sales cycle role. You will do the prospecting, the qualification, the demo, the negotiation and the close yourself, and show SME owners how INFINIT's AI-driven operating system transforms the way they run their business. We are looking for a self-starter with a hunter mentality, who is energised by a high-activity, phone-based sales environment and has a record of hitting and beating targets.

What do we want to achieve together?

•
You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demo, negotiation and close, with a clear monthly and quarterly revenue target.

•
You will generate your own pipeline through cold calling, email and various outreach methods, and by researching and sourcing new leads in our target SME segments.

•
You will deliver tailored product demos by video call, uncovering each prospect's needs and showing how INFINIT's platform solves them.

•
You will build trusted relationships with business owners and decision-makers over the phone and online, and handle objections with confidence.

•
You will keep the CRM accurate and up to date, and forecast your pipeline reliably.

•
You will work closely with Product and Customer Success to hand over new customers smoothly and feed back what you hear in the market.

•
You will help refine our outbound playbook, messaging and value proposition based on what works.

What do you need to be successful in this role?

•
3+ years of B2B sales experience in a full-cycle or inside sales role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding quota.

•
Demonstrated experience prospecting your own leads through cold calling and outbound outreach, and closing deals without field visits.

•
Confidence delivering live product demos and running sales conversations by phone and video.

•
Strong communication, negotiation and objection-handling skills.

•
A hunter mentality: proactive, resourceful, resilient and driven by results.

•
Experience thriving in a fast-paced startup or scale-up with evolving processes.

•
An analytical mindset and attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).

•
Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations to ensure a seamless customer handover.

What will you find working at INFINIT?

• Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

• Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.

• Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.

• Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance via Alan as well as gym discount.

• Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.

• Personal Time Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.

• Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working with 3 days a week at our London office and 2 days optional from home.

Diversity and Inclusion

INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Qualifications

Experience:
 8+ years of embedded software development experience.

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!
🌱 Our People Team
At Joko, we believe that our people are our strongest asset, and the People Team is one of the core pillars of the company. We span Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Business Partnering, and Workplace, and we work hand in hand with every team to make Joko efficient, scalable, and a place people genuinely love working at. We don't just run people processes — we design, challenge, and rethink them.
Today, Joko is 100+ people across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, and we are set to grow to 200+ within 18 months. That kind of growth only holds up if the office, the rituals, and the daily fabric of the company scale with it — which is where the Workplace Manager comes in.

🎯 What you will do
As Workplace Manager, your mission is to make Joko a place people genuinely love coming to every day, and to hold our culture together as we double in size. You will report to the VP People and partner closely with the rest of the People team, Finance, and Legal.

• Own the Paris office end-to-end: Our Paris office is your canvas. You will manage service providers, supplies, and facilities, keep the space impeccable and organized, and be the first point of contact for anything office-related. You will also be the go-to resource for our remote teammates across France and abroad, so the experience of working at Joko feels consistent regardless of where people sit.

• Bring the team together through events: From All Hands to Joko Academies, Team Events, Joko Drinks, offsites, and our legendary Christmas Party, you will design and run each gathering so it is not just well-organized, but a genuine moment of connection. As we grow into an international company, you will make sure our rituals scale with us and keep bringing the team together across geographies.

• Own onboarding end-to-end: First impressions matter, and onboarding is one of the most consequential parts of the Joko experience. You will run the process from employment contract to IT setup to team introductions to custom Joko goodies, so every new hire lands seamlessly and feels welcome from day one.

• Hold the culture as we scale: Doubling in size is precisely when a company culture can slip. The office you run, the events you design, and the way new joiners are welcomed are where Joko's culture gets rebuilt every day. You will be one of the people who keeps Joko Joko as we grow.

• Keep admin and compliance airtight: You will track expenses, make sure invoices are recorded correctly for our accounting team, and partner with Finance and Legal on our compliance routines so nothing falls through the cracks.

👀 Who we're looking for

• Experience: You have 3+ years in Workplace, Office Management, People Operations, Event Management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. You have already owned an office and a set of team rituals end-to-end — you know what it takes to make them impeccable, not just functional.

• Ownership mindset: You take full ownership of your scope, from strategy down to the smallest detail, and run complex projects from start to finish with little supervision.

• Attention to detail: You spot what others miss. A crooked frame, a missing supply, a rough onboarding email — none of it gets past you, because you know these details are what people actually feel.

• Organized and efficient: You are structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at juggling many priorities without dropping any of them. You care about deadlines and you meet them.

• Interpersonal skills: You build strong relationships across the team and foster a real sense of belonging. People feel comfortable coming to you, and you make them feel taken care of.

• Confident communicator: You are comfortable engaging with the team every day and speaking in front of large groups when the moment calls for it.

• Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You welcome feedback, you go the extra mile by default, and you are not afraid of taking initiative on topics that were not in your job description.

• Location: Based in Paris.

• Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language).

💎 Our perks
(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)
At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

• Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

• Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

• 💸 Top-market compensation

• 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

• 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

• 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

• 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

• 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

• …and much more, check the full list here !

🤝 Our hiring process

• Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

• Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
