arbeitnow:cdi-responsable-chef-de-produi.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Techniquement, Winamax c’est :

C'est quoi l'équipe Produit Poker ?

Notre mission est de concevoir et faire évoluer l'expérience poker chez Winamax. Nous définissons la roadmap produit, aussi bien pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités (Reveal, Moods, Shots, Winamax Legends...) que pour les grands projets structurants de l'application (refonte des lobbys, nouveaux parcours utilisateurs, nouvelles variantes de jeu, etc.).

Ton grand défi sera d'imaginer une solution innovante pour améliorer l'expérience des nouveaux joueurs. Un objectif ambitieux que tu concrétiseras grâce à l'apprentissage progressif de notre métier et de nos méthodes.

L'un de nos principaux enjeux est de lever les barrières à l'entrée et de proposer une expérience utilisateur fluide et engageante, capable de renforcer l'attractivité de notre application et de maximiser la rétention des nouveaux utilisateurs.

Dès ton arrivée, tu seras pleinement intégré aux réflexions menées sur les projets les plus stratégiques de l'équipe (refonte de parties de l'application, nouvelles fonctionnalités, nouveaux parcours joueurs...). • Participer aux recettes et à la validation d'un projet avant son lancement

• Découvrir toutes les étapes de conception d'un produit digital, de l'idée jusqu'à sa mise entre les mains de plusieurs centaines de milliers de joueurs.

Ce que tu vas accomplir :

Au fil du stage, tu seras donc progressivement intégré au processus de définition et de pilotage de nos projets produits. Cette montée en compétence te conduira à ton projet de fin de stage : repenser et optimiser l'expérience d'accueil et d'intégration du nouveau joueur.

Ton objectif : t'appuyer sur l'identification des barrières à l'entrée et l'analyse des faiblesses de notre application pour concevoir, en collaboration avec un UI/UX Designer, une solution capable d'augmenter durablement la rétention des nouveaux joueurs sur notre application.

Tu es étudiant en Bac+5 (école de commerce, marketing, management ou formation équivalente)
et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études avec de vraies responsabilités.

ce qui te permet d'analyser nos offres avec un regard critique de joueur et de comprendre finement
les tendances, les attentes et les comportements des joueurs.

Ce stage est pensé comme un tremplin : sous réserve d'une montée en compétences réussie et de
la qualité de tes réalisations, une opportunité au sein de l'équipe pourra t'être proposée.

• Curieux et créatif

• Rigoureux

• Autonome

• Proactif

• A l'aise pour travailler en équipe

• Doté d'un bon esprit d'analyse

Et si en plus de ça...

• Tu apportes ta bonne humeur au quotidien

Dans ce cas-là c'est ALL-IN

Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team
Yuzu is building a portfolio of real money gaming apps, combining accessible mobile gameplay with competition and real cash prizes. We’re currently developing our first games, with the ambition to launch and grow several apps.
We’re a small team working across product, creative production and growth, using AI to prototype ideas, create content and test quickly. Joining Yuzu means getting involved before launch, taking ownership of projects and helping shape both the games we build and the way we work.

Role
You will work closely with the team building the product and launching the business. You will contribute across creative production, AI workflows and early growth, with room to suggest ideas and take them through to execution.
Your role is to turn ideas into things we can use and test: creative assets, playable prototypes, useful workflows and experiments that help us move towards launch.

• Produce creative content. Develop concepts and create videos, visuals, animations and gameplay content for our marketing. Take an idea from a first draft to an asset we can put in front of users.

• Build systems with AI. Turn repetitive work into practical workflows for research, content production and testing. Create reusable templates and lightweight automations, and check the quality of the outputs.

• Benchmark widely. Explore competing games and relevant consumer apps. Study their creatives, onboarding, gameplay and reward systems, then turn your observations into ideas we can try.

• Prototype interactive experiences. Use AI, no-code or coding tools to build demos, small game concepts and playable ads. Learn the tools needed to get a first version working.

• Run frequent experiments. Quickly test different creative angles, formats and interactions. Be clear about what you want to learn, review the results and recommend what to try next.

• Help get the business ready to launch. Produce and organise launch assets and materials, spot gaps and pick up practical tasks with the team. Follow through until they are done.

 
Profile

• You are a final-year student or recent graduate, ideally from an engineering school or a leading business school . You learn quickly, enjoy unfamiliar problems and want to help launch a new business in real money gaming.

• You build things on your own. You have side projects to show: a small product, a website, a content project, a game prototype or an automation. You can explain what you made and how you approached it.

• You are comfortable working with AI. You already use AI to research, create and solve practical problems. You enjoy combining tools into repeatable workflows and improving how work gets done.

• You have a knack for content. Experience with image and video generation, editing tools, AI coding assistants, no-code workflows or simple scripting will be useful. A good visual eye and an interest in consumer products will also help.

• You are curious and analytical. You like exploring products, comparing approaches and testing ideas. You can break down a problem, identify a useful first experiment and explain what you learned.

• You take initiative and follow through. You are comfortable switching between creative, technical and business tasks. You can make progress independently, ask for feedback and flag blockers early.

• You work well in French and English. You speak fluent French and have strong written and spoken English. You can communicate your ideas clearly and research unfamiliar topics independently.

Nice to have: You have a feel for games. You explore new games and notice what makes a mechanic satisfying or an experience engaging. Card games, tournament formats and risk-and-reward mechanics are familiar territory.

We will value your ability to learn, choose the right tools and deliver work that we can use.
 
Benefits

• Competitive salary upon experience, plus bonus

• Swile Lunch voucher

• Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

• Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family, 100% covered by Voodoo

• Wellness activities in our Paris office

About The Role
Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.
You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

What You’ll Achieve

• Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

• Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

• Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

• Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

• Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

Skills You’ll Need to Bring

• Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

• Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

• AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

• Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

• Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

• Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

• Fluency in English and French.

Nice to Haves

• Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.

• Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

• Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

• Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

About Marble
Marble is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers, and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries.
Our first 15 companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture.

About The Role
We are hiring a Growth Apprentice to join the Marble team and support our recruitment and marketing activities.
You will work directly with senior team members, Partners, and brilliant founders on a mission to turn the tide on the climate crisis. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between developing cutting-edge climate technologies and effectively communicating their impact to our target audiences.
You will also gain exposure to the journey of building startups, including thesis development, venture building, and founder support.
Location: Paris.
Language: English fluency; French fluency is preferred.
Contract Type: Apprenticeship ( Contrat d’Apprentissage ).
Duration: 12 months for the apprenticeship
Start date: October, 2026

Responsibilities
The Growth Marketing apprenticeship is focused on running a 360° marketing process for Marble:

• Campaign Execution: Plan, launch, and monitor performance-driven marketing campaigns (organic and paid) across Google Ads, LinkedIn, and X to drive measurable user acquisition.

• A/B Testing & Optimisation: Constantly test ad copy, landing pages, and creative assets to lower our Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) for both talent and portfolio interest.

• Tracking & Conversions: Implement and manage audience tags and tracking pixels across all platforms to maximise conversion rates and ensure accurate data attribution.

• Data & KPI Dashboards: Analyse marketing performance data and maintain comprehensive KPI dashboards to track campaign effectiveness and generate actionable insights.

• Outbound Talent Sourcing: Optimise Marble’s talent pipeline by building targeted lists to strengthen outreach and ensuring seamless data coordination between outbound marketing efforts and CRM systems.

• PR & Brand Visibility: Support press outreach, pitch media angles to tech and business publications, and integrate PR efforts into broader growth campaigns to amplify brand reach.

Requirements
This is an exciting opportunity for a tech-savvy, creative individual passionate about climate tech and startup ecosystems:

• Currently enrolled in a degree or certification program eligible for an apprenticeship ( Contrat d’Apprentissage )

• You are fluent in English. French is preferred but not mandatory.

• You have 5+ hours of screen time.

• Solid understanding of paid media platforms , including Google Ads, LinkedIn, and X, with experience in campaign setup, targeting, and optimisation.

• Experience running campaigns and SEO optimisation across Hootsuite, Ahrefs, and similar platforms.

• You can write high-converting ad copy, PR pitch, or a witty, viral social media hook, adjusting your voice seamlessly.

• You are experienced in making complex ideas accessible through independent projects (running your own science communication initiatives, creating educational content, managing technical documentation). You know how to maintain brand consistency while experimenting with different content formats.

• You thrive in fast-paced environments (startups, agencies, research labs, NGOs, etc.) where you've demonstrated a quick adoption of new tools and processes and adapted to new platforms and workflows.

Your ability to learn on the job is more important than ticking every single box. However, we would especially love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

• You are passionate about climate tech, startups, and venture capital (VC). You are familiar with some climate deep tech startups.

• You know what it takes to market things well and can execute end‑to‑end: from ideation to design, ads, and launch .

• You move quickly and proactively. You're quick to recognise when things aren't on track and seamlessly transition into problem-solving mode.

• You are highly organised, able to juggle competing priorities.

• You have impeccable attention to detail and excellent written and verbal communication. When it comes to representing Marble, your communications, both written and spoken, are top-notch.

• You can quickly understand and transform complex technical concepts into engaging content forms. You have worked with tools like Canva, Figma, CapCut, etc.

• You are AI-savvy and comfortable experimenting with the latest AI tools. You know how to use tools like Hootsuite, Ahrefs, Claude , etc., have a good understanding of prompting, and keep up with the latest developments in AI.

What We Offer

• A monthly compensation aligned with French legal standards

• Office located at Station F in Paris. Flexible remote days are possible

• 1 week of vacation

• Meal vouchers (Swile), 50% transport refund

• Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

• Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you’ll meet

• Rapid learning curve and personal development

How To Apply
You will be asked for:

• Your LinkedIn profile + a CV (please make sure to include your portfolio within the CV)

• A few short questions about you (your evaluation as a candidate will be dependent on your portfolio)

We believe that a diverse group of minds is key to solving the climate crisis. We encourage women and people of colour to apply. Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply for an opportunity unless they feel they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and mission-driven cohort. Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.
Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Language : Fluent English required. French or German is a plus.

• Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

• Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements
This role is ideal for an engineer or computer scientist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various domains where intelligent systems interact with the physical world:

• Technical expertise in AI/ML applied to physical systems, robotics and autonomy. You hold a PhD or MS in Computer Science (ML/RL), Robotics, or related (EEng, MechEng), with applied experience in startup or industry.

• Experience shipping systems in a real-world environment. You understand operational constraints such as safety, uptime and latency, human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations with other systems.

• Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

• First principles reasoning . You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

• Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

• You have prior experience working with early stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

• You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

• You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

• You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

• You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in physical industries, AI and climate infrastructure.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

• €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

• Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

• Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

• Rapid learning curve and personal development

• Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

arbeitnow:founding-product-manager-paris.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

The Role
This is Dust's first PM hire. You'll work closely with the product team, turning raw GTM signal, company priorities, and user feedback into well-formed problems the team can act on.

What you will change:

• A lot of product signal doesn't reach the team in an actionable shape today. You'll create and run the process that connects signal to shaping to prioritization.

• Implementing company strategies across functions requires ownership and orchestration. You'll translate company priorities into an intelligible, trackable set of product, marketing, and operations initiatives.

• You'll enrich prioritized projects with distilled business and user context and market perspective so that the people building them make better decisions.

Our designers and engineers stay close to product decisions from conception to delivery. You're here to make their context richer and their priorities sharper. You enable distributed ownership, you don't replace it.

What You'll Do

• Qualify and synthesize feedback : Sit at the intersection of GTM, users, and product. Turn high-volume, unstructured input into a small set of well-framed problems worth solving.

• Shape initiatives : Work with engineers and designers to translate validated problems into initiatives ready for Stack Rank — with clear objectives, KPIs, and scope.

• Drive outcome tracking : Own reporting on whether what shipped actually moved the needle. Feed that back into the next round of decisions.

• Improve internal coordination : Connect Marketing, Comms, GTM, and Product — reduce the friction that slows things down when multiple functions need to move together.

• Own outcomes, not outputs : For cross-functional initiatives, you'll own the goal — objectives, KPIs, orchestration, reporting.

• Own artefacts in the Dust platform (agents, skills, data, etc..) to continuously rewire and augment the above for yourself and the team

What You Can Expect

Team
Dust is a growing team of about a 100 people. Most of the product and engineering team is based in Paris, with close collaboration across our teams in New York, San Francisco, and London.

The interview process
The process is designed to understand how you think, collaborate, and operate in an ambiguous, technical environment:

• Recruiter conversation: motivation, background, logistics, and fit for an early-stage environment.

• Hiring DRI conversation: discussion with a senior member of the product team.

• Product exercise: collaboration exercise based on a real company priority.

• Founder conversation: discussion with one of our founders on product judgment, attitude, and ability to operate with distributed authority.

• Onsite: working sessions with members of Engineering, Design, and GTM. We’ll look at how you gather context, identify the important problems, collaborate on possible approaches, and leave ownership with the people closest to the work.

We care more about the quality of your reasoning and collaboration than about arriving at a predetermined answer.

What We're Looking For

• Founding PM mentality: Senior individual contributor and builder balancing capacity to build the practice in the company while being hands-on.

• 5–8+ years of product experience, including time at an early-stage company where you had to build process from scratch.

• Genuine product taste. You know great from good in the world of tech products, and you bring deep perspective, judgment and conviction to any preferences you voice.

• Excellent information synthesis skills, distilling a messy pile of customer feedback, sales calls, and Slack threads into sharp problems.

• Technical proficiency earn the respect of engineers. You don't need to code, but you understand systems and tradeoffs easily deeply.

• Builder mindset at heart. You use AI tools fluently and you're excited about what they unlock for how PMs operate. You've thrived in environments where everyone is a builder and you want to strengthen that.

• Effective communication. You'd rather say one clear thing than three vague things.

• Comfort with distributed authority. You influence by being right, not by being in charge.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.

Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.

The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.

Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.

With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users.

About the Role:

As a Technical Product Owner, you will be the driving force behind the delivery and lifecycle of our product features. Working within an Agile engineering team and partnering closely with our Tech Lead/Architect, you will act as the essential link between our customer-facing Product Managers and the development team.

While the Tech Lead drives architectural decisions and manages the engineers, you will take full ownership of the team's backlog, feature planning, and post-deployment success.

Because our current technical leadership leans heavily into complex systems architecture, we are looking for a proactive, communicative leader to champion Agile processes and cross-team relationships.

This role is perfect for a product-minded technical expert who enjoys being hands-on—regularly contributing to code and prototypes—while ensuring seamless delivery and alignment across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

•
Take end-to-end ownership of feature delivery and product health , managing pre-release planning, priorities, and timelines, as well as post-release success, including deployment coordination, feature activation, and production monitoring.

•
Act as the definitive technical bridge between non-technical stakeholders and developers , actively participating in and contributing to Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Review) to ensure continuous alignment, clear communication, and team momentum.

•
Partner closely with strategic Product Managers to understand business roadmaps, translating high-level business goals into well-defined epics and user stories.

•
Own, prioritize, and maintain the sprint backlog , partnering with the PMs, Tech Lead and Infrastructure teams to balance new feature delivery against technical debt, optimizations, and scalability.

•
Serve as the primary liaison for internal teams (Support, Customer Success, Expert Services) to field product inquiries, triage and investigate production bugs, and gather operational feedback to continually improve the product.

•
Contribute hands-on to code and technical initiatives , rolling up your sleeves to build prototypes, develop proof-of-concepts, and assist in technical investigations across our polyglot stack (spanning diverse frontend and backend environments).

•
Collaborate closely with the QA team to define robust Acceptance Criteria and evaluate completed sprint deliverables, ensuring everything meets quality benchmarks and the team's Definition of Done.

•
Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize Agile workflows, draft user stories, analyze backlog health, and streamline cross-functional communication.

Required qualifications

•
10+ years of experience in the software industry, ideally transitioning from an engineering role into a Product Owner or Technical Program Manager.

•
Proven track record of successfully managing technical backlogs, delivering complex projects, and demonstrating measurable impact on product performance or stability.

•
Deep understanding of API design, system architecture, database interactions, and object-oriented programming principles.

•
Ability to use AI tools across the product lifecycle (requirement analysis, story generation, acceptance testing definition, and workflow automations).

•
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and enterprise integrations (e.g., Salesforce).

•
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee technical bottlenecks and effectively sequence development work.

•
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to "translate" between business-focused Product Managers and deeply technical engineering teams.

•
Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and optimize team delivery.

•
Fluent in English and French

Why Join Us?
We offer a challenging environment where your contributions will be highly valued.

You'll have the opportunity to guide the development of critical and non-critical systems, collaborate with talented individuals across Product and Engineering, and directly influence the technical success and scalability of our products.

Where You'll Be

You will own the end-to-end solution design for Xstore Point of Service and Xstore Office, so each market is designed on the global template with minimal, well-governed customisation, completing design for 3 to 4 work packages a year.

You will be measured on low design-related defects, template conformance and on-time design delivery.

• Fit-gap and Adopt-vs-Adapt assessments per market, with documented standard vs. custom recommendations

• Solution designs and FSDs for POS flows: sales, returns, exchanges, clienteling, payments, tax and receipts

• Country localisation: fiscalization, tax, e-invoicing, fiscal printers and Oracle country-pack usage or gaps

• Technical design inputs for customisations, extensions and integrations, traceable to requirements and tests

• Integration designs between Xstore and payments, tax, order management, CRM, ERP, e-commerce and SIOCS

• Design hand-over packs to delivery PODs that meet Definition of Ready and design-gate criteria

• Contribution to the Base Template roadmap, including upgrade planning (for example v24 to v26)

• Design reviews, quality gates and root-cause input on design defects; coaching of POD engineers

• 15+ years in retail technology and 8+ years designing Oracle Xstore solutions (Senior Principal: 18+ years, several global rollouts as lead architect)

• Lead or chief architect on a multi-country POS rollout, ideally 10+ countries

• Strong luxury, fashion or premium retail background: clienteling, high-touch boutique processes, multi-brand and multi-currency

• Experience governing a standard-first template and working across multiple vendors; Oracle Retail or Xstore certification is a plus

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

arbeitnow:stage-commerciale-sales-busine.description:
Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale.
Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution.
Tu rejoins l'équipe SDR, et ton objectif principal sera d'accompagner et de convaincre nos prospects à poursuivre le processus de vente en organisant des rendez-vous avec les Account Executives.
En tant que SDR, tu représentes le premier contact client, tu es le premier maillon de notre processus de vente ; ainsi, tu participes activement à l'atteinte de nos objectifs commerciaux.
En rejoignant le département Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents !
Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !
Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Tes missions :

En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR).

• Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance.

• Comprendre les besoins : T’entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera.

• Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives.

• Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi.Organiser des rendez-vous de démonstration avec les Account Executives,

• Contribuer à l’amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux.

Déroulement du stage :

• Deux semaines d’immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale.
• Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ton stage, tu bénéficieras d’un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente).
• Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages.
• Perspective d’évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d’apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives.
À la fin de ton stage, tu maîtriseras les techniques de vente, les cycles de vente complexes et les meilleurs outils utilisés par les start-ups. Tu participes au lancement de nouvelles offres, ce qui te permet de comprendre comment fonctionne l'entrepreneuriat.

Les avantages :

• Salaire : 1 000€ (Césure) - 1 200€ (fin d'études de master) + une variable selon l’atteinte de tes objectifs

• Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l'environnement start-up et immobilier,

• Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite,

• Une demi-journée de congé par mois

• Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

• Carte ticket restaurant Swile (France)

• Abonnement à Gymlib (France),

Informations pratiques :

• Localisation : Paris 10e

• Type de contrat : Stage conventionné

• Durée : 6 mois

• Date de démarrage : janvier

• Télétravail : selon les modalités en vigueur au sein de l’équipe

Idéalement, tu :

• As un bon relationnel, tu es à l’écoute et tu te sens à l’aise au téléphone

• Aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu aimes convaincre ton audience

• As envie de monter en compétences et d'évoluer sur les métiers Sales

• Recherches un stage de 6 mois (césure ou fin d'études) et tu parles français couramment

• Bonus : tu as déjà réalisé des jobs étudiant/ jobs d'été/ missions d'interim' (restauration, vente, accueil, événementiel, animation, etc.)

Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ?
Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ?
Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ?
Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre !

Processus de recrutement :

Pour postuler, il te suffit d’un CV, mais pas de lettre de motivation classique et interminable, dis-nous simplement pourquoi tu souhaites rejoindre Matera à ce poste !
1️⃣ Premier entretien téléphonique de 20 à 30 mn avec notre recruteuse
2️⃣ Entretien avec 2 Sales Manager, pour une mise en situation (30 en visio)
3️⃣ Last round dans nos bureaux avec la VP sales
4️⃣ Prise de références puis offre

À savoir :
🕑 Nous nous efforçons de faire un retour sur ta candidature le plus rapidement possible (sous une semaine). Que le retour soit positif ou négatif, tu recevras un mail de notre part - pense à regarder tes spams au cas où.
🤝 Si tu as besoin de prédispositions particulières pour réaliser les entretiens dans les meilleures conditions, tu peux le notifier lors de ta candidature et en informer l’équipe Recrutement.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role
As an IT Support apprenticeship at Harmattan AI, you are the local first point of contact for colleagues in Paris. You handle onboarding and offboarding, hardware, software access and everyday requests, following the procedures set by the central IT team. As the company grows, you also help improve the service through small automation projects.
Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day local IT support to Harmattan AI colleagues, resolving standard requests quickly and courteously.

• Handle employee onboarding and offboarding, including hardware and software access requests.

• Prepare, configure and deploy laptops and mobile phones, and keep the equipment inventory up to date.

• Follow the standard operating procedures documented by the central IT team, flagging gaps or improvements.

• Log, track and close every request in the ticketing system with clear, accurate updates.

• Contribute to small IT projects and automation initiatives that improve the service to end users.

• Work closely with the IT team and escalate complex issues with the right context.

Candidate Requirements

• Currently enrolled in an IT-related program (BTS, engineering school or university).

• Good understanding of IT fundamentals, such as laptop configuration and basic troubleshooting, plus basic development skills.

• Strong sense of service and a welcoming attitude towards users of all technical levels.

About the Role
As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy.

Responsibilities

• Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions.

• Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries.

• Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture.

• AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum.

• Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis.

• Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers.

• Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions.

Candidate Requirements

• Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

• 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications.

• Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing.

• Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation.

• Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems.

• Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines.

arbeitnow:finance-and-operations-zurich-.description:
People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.

More than 400 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.

We are now hiring someone to run finance and legal while we expand across Europe and into the US.

Tasks

You report to the CEO and take over finance and legal. Today this work is split between the founders, our fiduciary and outside counsel. You bring it into one place and build it out.

Finance

You own the numbers we run the company on. We are bootstrapped, so no investor money covers a bad month.

• Monthly close on a fixed date, with our fiduciary and auditors

• Operating model, cash forecast and runway in CHF, EUR and USD

• SaaS metrics and billing: ARR, retention, CAC, payback

• Cohort analysis, quote-to-cash and revenue recognition

• Payroll, insurance and tax

Legal

Sales closes a standard deal without you. When a deal is not standard, they hear back from you within a day.

• Contract templates, fallback positions and redlines for order forms, MSAs, partner and supplier agreements and NDAs

• GDPR and revDSG, DPAs, subprocessors, TOMs, and the security questionnaires that come with every enterprise deal

• Insurance, employment law in CH, DE, FR and the US, and the decision on ISO 27001 or SOC 2

Building the group

We are setting up the US subsidiary right now, and you will own it.

• Incorporation, intercompany agreement and transfer pricing between the Swiss parent and the international entity

• Registered agent, state registrations, payroll and sales tax nexus

• A consolidation that stays clean as we add entities

• Choosing the finance and legal tools, and deciding what to automate, what to outsource and what to keep in-house

Requirements

• 5+ years in finance and in either legal or commercial contracting

• Hands-on experience with accounting, payroll and tax

• You redline a SaaS contract yourself and know when to call counsel

• SaaS finance: subscription revenue, retention cohorts, unit economics, quote-to-cash

• Fluent German and English at work. Our customers, our fiduciary and our contracts use both.

• You are happy to be the first hire in the function. You build the model and chase the invoices yourself, with no team under you at the start.

Nice to have

• You have set up a foreign subsidiary before, including intercompany pricing

• Experience with SMB customers and with getting them to pay on time

• Views on finance tools and a habit of automating routine work

The role is hands-on for a while and covers both finance and legal. The title will grow with the company.

Benefits

• You report to the CEO from day one, and your analysis feeds straight into decisions on pricing, hiring and new markets

• A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. You set the spending rules.

• Finance and legal in one role, with the international entities and the group structure as your own build project

• Freedom to pick your tools and to automate or outsource anything that does not need you

• Office in Zürich, on site Monday to Thursday, flexible hours and holiday planning

• A salary band stated upfront, plus participation

How we hire

• Introduction, 15-minute video call

• Conversation with one of the founders, 30 minutes, about the company, the numbers and the role

• A practical case with the team, remote or in Zürich. We work through our real model and one open question together. There is no homework to hand in.

• Final conversation and decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

Don't you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about the messiest finance or legal situation you have sorted out. You don't need a cover letter.

arbeitnow:senior-sales-manager-in-80-100.description:
Wir haben das Produkt. Wir haben die Kunden. Jetzt bauen wir den Vertrieb strukturell aus.

PEAX digitalisiert und automatisiert die Administration von Schweizer KMU, Treuhändern und Privatpersonen. Post digital empfangen, Rechnungen bezahlen, Dokumente sicher ablegen. Statt Bundesordner und Papierberge.

In den nächsten zwölf Monaten verstärken wir unser Vertriebsteam um mehrere Personen. Du bist eine davon. Du verkaufst selbst und prägst mit, wie bei uns verkauft wird.

Aufgaben

WAS DU MACHST

• Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf: Zielkunden identifizieren, Entscheider finden, Erstkontakt herstellen. Keine Warteschlange aus Marketing-Leads.

• Du führst Discovery-Gespräche mit Inhaberinnen, Treuhändern und Finanzverantwortlichen. Und du rechnest ihnen vor, was ihre Papieradministration wirklich kostet.

• Du verantwortest den ganzen Zyklus bis zur Unterschrift: Qualifizierung, Business Case, Offerte, Verhandlung, Abschluss.

• Du führst Pipeline und Forecast in HubSpot und entwickelst den Vertriebsprozess mit uns weiter.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Produkt und Customer Success zusammen und bringst zurück, was du im Markt hörst.

Qualifikation

Ohne diese vier Punkte wird es nicht funktionieren:

• B2B-Softwarevertrieb mit eigener Neukundenakquise, nicht Bestandskundenbetreuung.

• Abschlüsse, die du selbst eröffnet hast.

• Erfahrung mit kurzen Verkaufszyklen und hoher Schlagzahl im KMU-Segment.

• Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und Schweizer Gesprächskultur. Bei einem Treuhänder mit acht Mitarbeitenden entscheidet das in den ersten drei Sätzen.

Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss:

• Treuhand-, Buchhaltungs-, ERP-, Payroll- oder Versicherungsumfeld

• HubSpot oder ein vergleichbares CRM, das du nicht nur benutzt, sondern mitgestaltet hast.

• Französisch, weil die Romandie für uns wichtig wird.

Ein Studienabschluss ist willkommen, aber keine Bedingung. Uns interessiert, was du verkauft hast. Nicht, wo du studiert hast.

WAS DAS HIER NICHT IST

Damit niemand von uns Zeit verliert. Diese Rolle passt nicht zu dir, wenn du:

• lieber bestehende Kunden betreust als neue zu gewinnen.

• Leads aus dem Marketing erwartest, statt sie selbst zu erzeugen.

• Verkaufszyklen von 18 Monaten mit Ausschreibungen und Bid-Teams gewohnt bist.

• ein Presales-Team, einen Bid-Manager und ein fertiges Playbook brauchst, um loszulegen.

• seit Jahren keine eigene Zahl mehr verantwortet hast.

Hast du bei dieser Liste genickt? Dann passen wir nicht zusammen. Hast du gedacht «genau deshalb will ich weg»? Dann schreib uns.

Benefits

WAS DU BEKOMMST

• Ein Produkt, das ein reales Schweizer Problem löst.

• Eine Vertriebsorganisation, die gerade wächst. Deine Ideen zu Prozess und Vorgehen landen nicht in einer Schublade.

• Kurze Wege. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns in Tagen, nicht in Gremien.

• Ein Lohnmodell mit echtem variablem Anteil, rund 70 zu 30. Nach oben ist der variable Teil nicht gedeckelt.

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und ein Büro mitten in Luzern, in das man auch gerne kommt.

• Weiterbildung, die du dir selbst aussuchst.

SO LÄUFT ES AB

1 Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Recruiting. 20 Minuten, gegenseitiges Abtasten.

2 Gespräch mit der Geschäftsleitung. Wir reden über Deals, die du gewonnen und verloren hast.

3 Eine praktische Sequenz: Wie würdest du unsere Pipeline weiterentwickeln, und wie verkaufst du einem Treuhänder einen Termin?

4 Kennenlernen des Teams in Luzern. Danach entscheiden wir beide.

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann brauchen wir kein Motivationsschreiben. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze dazu, wie du an deinen letzten Neukunden herangekommen bist. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

arbeitnow:kundenverantwortlicher-m-w-gel.description:
Die Brevalia AG ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen, welches sich auf die individuelle und umfassende Beratung von in der Schweiz lebenden Privatpersonen fokussiert und dank seiner FINMA-Lizenz als Vermögensverwalterin agieren kann. Für den weiteren Ausbau wenden wir uns an eine sehr proaktive und gut vernetzte Persönlichkeit, welche die nächste Wachstumsphase der Firma mit verantworten will.
Aufgaben
Als Kundenverantwortliche/r beraten und betreuen Sie Ihre Kunden selbständig in den Themenbereichen der Geldanlage (Vermögensverwaltung und Anlageberatung inkl. Aktien, Obligationen, Fonds/ETF’s sowie Derivate/Strukturierte Produkte), deren Finanzierungsbedürfnissen (Hypotheken und Lombardkredite) und decken auch die Grundbedürfnisse bezüglich Vorsorge (keine Versicherungen) Steuern und Güter & Erbrecht ab. Sie koordinieren zusammen mit internen/externen Fachexperten die zeitgerechte, umfassende Bearbeitung der Kundenbedürfnisse aller Finanzthemen und sorgen damit für ein hochwertiges Beratungserlebnis. Eine Ihrer Hauptaufgaben wird die proaktive Neukundenakquisition sein, um Ihren Kundenstamm auf- und auszubauen. Dabei werden Sie vom Team unterstützt und Ihre Stellvertretung ist jederzeit sichergestellt.
Qualifikation
Sie sind seit mind. 5 Jahren als Kundenberater/in für Schweizer Kunden tätig, betreuen eigene Kunden und verfügen nach Ihrer Grundausbildung über mindestens einen Weiterbildungsabschluss (AZEK, CFA, MAS PB&WM, MAS Financial Consulting). Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihrer kundenorientierten Art konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren bei Kunden wie auch Kollegen einen Namen als wissender Leistungsträger aufbauen und streben heute eine Position an, in welcher Sie Ihre Kontakte, Ihre Erfahrungen und Ihr Wissen einbringen können sowie in der Sie weiter gefördert werden. Zudem konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren über die proaktive Neukundenakquisition beweisen und verfügen über ein gutes Netzwerk, da Sie sich neben Ihrer beruflichen Tätigkeit in diversen Netzwerken persönlich engagieren. Sie wollen sich aktiv einbringen und Verantwortung übernehmen.
Benefits
Wir bieten Ihnen die Chance, dass Sie sich auf die umfassende Beratung und Betreuung konzentrieren und ohne Verkaufsziele, Mehrwert für Ihre Kunden schaffen können. Dazu bieten wir ein umfassendes Dienstleistungsangebot, viele Fachexperten und etablierte Beziehungen zu Partnerinstituten. Unsere moderne IT-Infrastruktur sowie unsere moderne Arbeitsweise unterstützten Sie in der Akquisition sowie in der Kundenbetreuung. Zudem können Sie jederzeit ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Sie arbeiten in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld in einem kleinen Team in welchem sehr persönlich und menschlich agiert wird. Der Wissenstransfer zwischen den Persönlichkeiten ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Angebots, um ein fruchtbares Klima zu schaffen. Sie erhalten die Chance, in einem kleinen Unternehmen sehr viel mitzugestalten, zu bewegen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich weiterzuentwickeln. Ihr Arbeitsplatz in der Stadt Zürich ist nicht an starre Arbeitszeiten gekoppelt, wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der gegenseitigen Rücksichtnahme, der offenen Kommunikation und der Leistungsfokussierung.
Ihre persönlichen Ziele sind die Grundlagen der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, welche wir laufend zusammen besprechen und in deren Erreichung wir Sie aktiv unterstützen.
Trauen Sie sich diese unternehmerische Aufgabe zu? Dann lassen Sie uns darüber sprechen, wie wir gemeinsam Grosses bewegen können. Ihre Kontaktaufnahme mit Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen ist der erste Schritt in die Richtung Ihrer spannenden Zukunft. Zeigen Sie uns, warum Sie unser Team gut ergänzen und kontaktieren Sie uns.

Starte deine eigene Internet-Agentur oder erweitere dein bestehendes digitales Angebot mit einem bewährten Webmaster-Konzept und persönlicher Unterstützung.
Du interessierst dich für Websites, Online-Marketing und digitale Lösungen? Du möchtest dir ein zweites Standbein aufbauen, dich selbstständig machen oder deine bestehenden Dienstleistungen erweitern?
Dann könnte unser Webmaster- und Agenturkonzept genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Unser Konzept richtet sich an motivierte Quereinsteiger sowie an erfahrene Fachpersonen aus Webdesign, Webentwicklung, Grafik, Marketing, IT, Verkauf und Beratung.
Seit über 25 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen auf ihrem Weg in die digitale Selbstständigkeit. Du profitierst von professionellen Werkzeugen, praxisnaher Ausbildung, bewährten Marketinglösungen und persönlicher Begleitung.
Wichtig: Es handelt sich nicht um eine Festanstellung. Du baust deine eigene selbstständige Tätigkeit auf oder erweiterst dein bestehendes Unternehmen. Dabei bestimmst du selbst über Arbeitszeit, Umfang und Entwicklung deiner Tätigkeit.
Als Webmaster-Partner unterstützt du Unternehmen, Selbstständige und KMU mit modernen Websites, digitaler Sichtbarkeit, Online-Marketing und digitalen Geschäftslösungen.
Du musst nicht bei null anfangen. Unser Gesamtkonzept bietet dir die Grundlage, um professionell am Markt aufzutreten, eigene Kunden zu gewinnen und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.
Aufgaben
Als Webmaster-Partner begleitest du Unternehmen und Selbstständige bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Präsenz.
Je nach Erfahrung, persönlichen Stärken und Interessen übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

• Webdesign: Konzeption, Erstellung, Optimierung und Betreuung moderner, responsiver Websites.

• Individuelle Kundenlösungen: Anpassung von Design, Struktur und Inhalten an die geschäftlichen Ziele deiner Kunden.

• Online-Marketing und SEO: Beratung zu Suchmaschinenoptimierung, digitaler Sichtbarkeit und Kundengewinnung.

• Lokale Sichtbarkeit: Unterstützung von KMU bei ihrer regionalen und überregionalen Online-Präsenz.

• Digitale Geschäftslösungen: Einsatz von CRM, E-Mail-Marketing, Formularen, Terminbuchungen und Marketing-Automationen.

• Digitalisierung: Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Vereinfachung digitaler Abläufe und der Kundenkommunikation.

• Kundenbetreuung: Persönliche Beratung, Projektbegleitung und langfristige Betreuung deiner eigenen Kunden.

• Kundengewinnung: Nutzung eines bewährten Marketing- und Vertriebssystems mit professionellen Vorlagen und Verkaufsunterlagen.

• Unternehmensaufbau: Entwicklung deiner eigenen Internet-Agentur oder Ergänzung deines bestehenden Dienstleistungsangebots.

• Weiterbildung: Kontinuierlicher Kompetenzaufbau durch Schulungen, Webinare, Workshops und den Austausch mit erfahrenen Partnern.

Du entscheidest selbst, welche Dienstleistungen du anbieten und welche Schwerpunkte du setzen möchtest.
Dabei unterstützen dich ein erprobtes Gesamtkonzept, professionelle Werkzeuge und ein erfahrenes Partnernetzwerk.
Qualifikation
Für den Einstieg benötigst du keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Webmaster oder Programmierer.
Wichtiger sind deine Motivation, Lernbereitschaft, Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie die Bereitschaft, eigenverantwortlich und unternehmerisch zu arbeiten.
Die notwendigen fachlichen Kenntnisse kannst du dir im Rahmen unserer praxisorientierten Aus- und Weiterbildung aneignen.
Du passt zu unserem Konzept, wenn du:

• Interesse an Websites, Online-Marketing und Digitalisierung mitbringst.

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

About the role
AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.

You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.

What you'll Do

• Keep leadership aligned: explain your priorities and trade-offs from decision to launch.

• Stakeholder trust: you earn it with senior stakeholders and explain decisions plainly.

• Technical comfort: you’re comfortable with code, data models, and integrations, even if engineering was never your title.

Bonus: connected hardware or IoT experience.

You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!

Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

 

 

At ASM, we are shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing through innovation and technology leadership. Our success depends on attracting and hiring exceptional talent across engineering, commercial, service, and leadership functions. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our European Talent Acquisition team and serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders across Europe and North America. 

The Role 

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead the end-to-end recruitment of experienced professionals and senior leaders across multiple business functions and geographies. This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management, market intelligence, and proactive sourcing capabilities. 

You will partner closely with senior leaders to identify, attract, and secure top talent in a highly competitive semiconductor market. Success in this role requires a strong executive presence, the ability to influence at all levels, and a proactive, data-driven approach to talent acquisition. 

This role is based in Almere and will serve as a key Talent Acquisition partner supporting hiring across Europe and the United States. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment processes for experienced, senior, and executive-level positions across Europe and North America. 
  • Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage passive talent across highly competitive industries. 
  • Enable ASM’s long-term business strategy by shaping future-focused talent pipelines, recruiting for emerging organizational capabilities, and partnering with leaders to anticipate workforce needs in a rapidly evolving industry 
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and hiring managers, providing market insights, talent intelligence, and strategic hiring recommendations. 
  • Drive high-quality candidate experiences throughout the recruitment lifecycle. 
  • Conduct in-depth candidate assessments, evaluating capability, leadership potential, and organizational fit. 
  • Utilize market data and competitive intelligence to support hiring decisions and workforce planning discussions. 
  • Influence stakeholders and challenge hiring assumptions where appropriate to improve hiring outcomes. 
  • Partner closely with HR Business Partners and global Talent Acquisition colleagues to support organizational growth initiatives. 
  • Represent ASM professionally in the external market, enhancing our employer brand and talent community presence.

The role gives leadership a clear, data-driven view of compliance exposure and makes sure risks are identified, prioritized and mitigated before they affect the business. In doing so, it protects market access, revenue and reputation. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  1. Global Risk Assessment Framework
  • Design, implement and maintain a risk-based framework for export control and general compliance across all regions and business units. 
  • Define the risk methodology, including scoring, likelihood and impact criteria, risk appetite and escalation thresholds. 
  • Run the annual global compliance risk assessment and targeted assessments when the business or regulations change. Examples include new markets, products, customers and export control developments. 
  1. Export Control Risk (Primary Focus)
  • Assess risks under U.S. (EAR), EU (Regulation 2021/821), Japanese, Singapore, Korean and Chinese export control regimes.

  • Licensing 
  • End-use and end-user due diligence screening 
  • Technology transfer and deemed exports 
  • Spare parts and service 
  • U.S. Persons Rules 
  • Assess the business impact of new regulations, such as BIS rules, entity list expansions and China countermeasures, and translate it into concrete mitigation actions.

Wat ga je doen?

• Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies

• Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands

• Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben

• Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek

• Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten

• Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen

De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft.

Wie ben jij?

• Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels

• Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn

• Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel

• Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit

• Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen

Mooi meegenomen

• Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden

• Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS

Wat krijg je?

• Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert

• Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter

• Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken

• Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation"

Over Eye Security
Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden.
We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers.
Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst.

Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl ) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen.

De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart.
· Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie.
· Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content).
· Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales.
· Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen.
· Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata.
· Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat.
· Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in.
· Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV).

Wat biedt Snelstart jou?

· Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.
· 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur)
· Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland.
· Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.
· Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten.
· Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid.
· Een betrokken en dynamisch team.

Wat is de procedure?
Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.
De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT.

Slotopmerking
Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!
Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Jouw profiel

· Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet).
· Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech.
· Bewezen succes met leadfunnel‑bouw en marketingautomatisering.
· Aantoonbare resultaten met product‑led growth.
· Sterk in performance marketing (paid search/social, SEO/SEA, e‑mailautomatisering, retargeting).
· Datagedreven, ROI‑gedreven, vertaalt inzichten naar actie.
· Pré: HubSpot, Dynamics, Userpilot, AI in marketing (o.a. Breeze AI), B2B‑contentstrategie.

Qua motivatie en ambitie zoeken we iemand om marketingkennis intern op te bouwen en afhankelijkheid van bureaus te verkleinen. Die het team neerzet, begeleid en ontwikkeld. Die het ruime marketingbudget inzet en optimaliseert. Daar zit de change en de uitdaging.

Qua persoonlijkheid zoeken we iemand die verbinding maakt met de rest van de organisatie, die kwaliteit, energie en humor brengt; cultuur omarmt en ownership heeft. De cultuur is professioneel en no nonsens, dus we zoeken iemand die daar goed bij past.

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.

How you embrace curiosity daily.

•
Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

•
Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

•
Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

•
Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

•
Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

•
Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.

How you make your mark.

•
Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

•
Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

•
Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

•
Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

•
Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.

What you bring to the team.

•
Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

•
Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

•
Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

•
Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

•
Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

•
Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.

What sets you apart.

•
Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

•
Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.
